    public function testConnection(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado. Atualize a página e tente novamente.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }

        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $appKey = trim((string)$request->input('app_key', $config['app_key'] ?? ''));
        $appSecret = trim((string)$request->input('app_secret', ''));
        if ($appSecret === '' || str_starts_with($appSecret, '***') || str_starts_with($appSecret, '•••')) {
            $appSecret = (string)($config['app_secret'] ?? '');
        }
        $accessToken = trim((string)$request->input('access_token', ''));
        if ($accessToken === '' || str_starts_with($accessToken, '***') || str_starts_with($accessToken, '•••')) {
            $accessToken = (string)($config['access_token'] ?? '');
        }
        $gatewayUrl = (string)($config['gateway_url'] ?? 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync');

        if ($appKey === '' || $appSecret === '') {
            $msg = '❌ O AppKey e o AppSecret são obrigatórios para testar a conexão com o servidor do AliExpress.';
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'status' => 'error', 'message' => $msg], 400);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }

        try {
            $client = ($this->apiClient !== null && !$this->apiClient instanceof \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressApiClient)
                ? $this->apiClient
                : new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressApiClient(
                    appKey: $appKey,
                    appSecret: $appSecret,
                    gatewayUrl: $gatewayUrl,
                    timeout: 10,
                    accessToken: $accessToken !== '' ? $accessToken : null
                );

            // Testa endpoint de detalhes de produto no gateway oficial do AliExpress
            $res = $client->getProductDetails('1005006093867086');

            // Sucesso Total
            $msg = "✔️ Conexão e sincronização 100% estabelecidas com o servidor do AliExpress! Protocolo HMAC-SHA256 validado e credenciais operantes.";
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse([
                    'success' => true,
                    'status'  => 'ok',
                    'message' => $msg,
                ]);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');

        } catch (\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Exceptions\AliExpressApiException $e) {
            $errCode = (string)$e->type;
            $errMsg = $e->getMessage();

            if (str_contains(strtolower($errMsg), 'access_token') || str_contains($errCode, 'MissingParameter') || str_contains($errCode, 'IllegalAccessToken') || str_contains($errCode, 'InvalidAccessToken') || str_contains($errCode, 'InvalidSession')) {
                $status = 'warning';
                $msg = "⚠️ Conexão física OK com o servidor do AliExpress (api-sg.aliexpress.com), mas a aplicação está em modo TEST ou o Access Token OAuth ainda não foi fornecido. Gere/cole o Access Token no campo abaixo ou clique em 'Apply Online' no portal openservice.aliexpress.com.";
            } elseif (str_contains($errCode, 'InvalidAppKey') || str_contains($errMsg, 'AppKey') || str_contains($errCode, 'IncompleteSignature') || str_contains($errCode, 'Signature')) {
                $status = 'error';
                $msg = "❌ Credenciais inválidas. O servidor do AliExpress rejeitou o AppKey ou AppSecret informados. Verifique se foram digitados corretamente ou gere novas credenciais no portal openservice.aliexpress.com.";
            } else {
                $status = 'warning';
                $msg = "⚠️ Resposta do Servidor AliExpress: {$errMsg}. Verifique as permissões da aplicação no painel de desenvolvedores.";
            }

            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse([
                    'success' => false,
                    'status'  => $status,
                    'message' => $msg,
                    'code'    => $errCode,
                ]);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash($status === 'warning' ? 'warning' : 'error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $msg = "❌ Falha de rede ao conectar com o servidor do AliExpress: " . $e->getMessage() . ". Verifique se o servidor possui saída HTTPS para api-sg.aliexpress.com.";
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'status' => 'error', 'message' => $msg], 500);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Inicia o fluxo OAuth2 Server-side oficial do AliExpress Open Platform.
     */
    public function oauthAuthorize(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $appKey = trim((string)($config['app_key'] ?? ''));
        $appSecret = trim((string)($config['app_secret'] ?? ''));

        if ($appKey === '' || $appSecret === '') {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Informe e salve o AppKey e AppSecret antes de autorizar via OAuth2.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }

        $state = $this->generateSignedState($appSecret);
        $this->session->set('dropship_oauth_state', $state);

        $callbackUrl = $this->resolveOAuthCallbackUrl($baseUrl);
        $urlBuilder = $this->authUrlBuilder ?? new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth\AliExpressAuthorizationUrlBuilder($appKey);

        return Response::redirect($urlBuilder->build($callbackUrl, $state));
    }

    /**
     * Recebe o retorno OAuth2 (?code=...) do AliExpress e troca por access_token + refresh_token.
     */
    public function oauthCallback(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $code = trim((string)$request->input('code', ''));
        $state = trim((string)$request->input('state', ''));
        $expectedState = (string)$this->session->get('dropship_oauth_state', '');
        $this->session->remove('dropship_oauth_state');

        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $appKey = trim((string)($config['app_key'] ?? ''));
        $appSecret = trim((string)($config['app_secret'] ?? ''));

        $isLoggedIn = $this->session->has('user_id');
        $isSuccess = false;
        $errorMessage = null;
        $account = null;
        $expiresInDays = 30;

        // Validação estrita do State OAuth2 (Claude Audit Item 1)
        // Rejeita categoricamente requisições sem state, state forjado ou expirado.
        $isStateValid = false;
        if ($state !== '') {
            if ($expectedState !== '' && hash_equals($expectedState, $state)) {
                $isStateValid = true;
            } elseif ($appSecret !== '' && $this->verifySignedState($state, $appSecret)) {
                $isStateValid = true;
            }
        }

        if (!$isStateValid) {
            $errorMessage = 'Falha de segurança OAuth2 (state inválido, expirado ou ausente). Tente conectar novamente.';
        } elseif ($code === '') {
            $errDesc = trim((string)($request->input('error_description', '') ?: $request->input('error', 'Autorização cancelada ou código ausente.')));
            $errorMessage = 'AliExpress OAuth2 não retornou o código de autorização: ' . $errDesc;
        } else {
            $config = $this->loadConfig();
            $appKey = trim((string)($config['app_key'] ?? ''));
            $appSecret = trim((string)($config['app_secret'] ?? ''));

            if ($appKey === '' || $appSecret === '') {
                $errorMessage = 'AppKey ou AppSecret não configurados para concluir a troca de token OAuth2.';
            } else {
                try {
                    if ($this->tokenExchangeService !== null) {
                        $token = $this->tokenExchangeService->exchangeCode($code);
                    } elseif ($this->apiClient !== null && !$this->apiClient instanceof \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressApiClient) {
                        // Compatibilidade com Mocks de testes que injetam AliExpressApiClientInterface
                        $tokenData = $this->apiClient->createAccessToken($code);
                        $token = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::fromApiResponse($tokenData);
                        $tokenRepo = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth\ConfigOAuthTokenRepository($this->basePathRoot);
                        $tokenRepo->store($token);
                    } else {
                        // Resiliente com IoP SDK oficial e injeção de dependências
                        $httpClient = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth\IopSdkHttpClient(
                            appKey: $appKey,
                            appSecret: $appSecret,
                            gatewayUrl: (string)($config['gateway_url'] ?? 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/rest')
                        );
                        $tokenRepo = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth\ConfigOAuthTokenRepository($this->basePathRoot);
                        $service = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth\TokenExchangeService($httpClient, $tokenRepo);
                        $token = $service->exchangeCode($code);
                    }

                    $account = $token->account;
                    $expiresInDays = max(1, (int)round($token->expiresIn / 86400));
                    $isSuccess = true;
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    $errorMessage = 'Falha ao trocar o código OAuth2 pelo Access Token: ' . $e->getMessage();
                }
            }
        }

        // Auditoria em arquivo de log
        try {
            $logDir = dirname($this->configFile, 3) . '/storage/logs';
            if (!is_dir($logDir)) {
                @mkdir($logDir, 0755, true);
            }
            $logLine = sprintf(
                "[%s] IP: %s | Code: %s | State: %s | Status: %s | Msg: %s\n",
                date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                (string)($request->server['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? 'unknown'),
                $code !== '' ? (substr($code, 0, 10) . '...') : 'empty',
                $state,
                $isSuccess ? 'SUCCESS' : 'ERROR',
                $errorMessage ?? 'Access token exchanged and saved successfully'
            );
            @file_put_contents($logDir . '/aliexpress_oauth.log', $logLine, FILE_APPEND);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
        }

        if ($isSuccess) {
            $this->session->setFlash('success', '✔️ Conta AliExpress autorizada via OAuth2! Access Token salvo com sucesso.');
        } else {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $errorMessage ?: 'Erro desconhecido na autorização OAuth2.');
        }

        if ($isLoggedIn) {
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }

        // Se a sessão interativa não estiver aberta no contexto cross-site, renderiza a tela visual informativa
        ob_start();
        $success = $isSuccess;
        $error = $errorMessage;
        $codeSnippet = $code !== '' ? (substr($code, 0, 12) . '...') : null;
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/admin/oauth_status.php';
        $content = ob_get_clean();

        return new ViewResponse($content ?: '', wrapLayout: false);
    }

    private function resolveOAuthCallbackUrl(string $baseUrl): string
    {
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $configuredUri = trim((string)($config['oauth_redirect_uri'] ?? ''));
        if ($configuredUri !== '') {
            return $configuredUri;
        }

        if (str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'http://') || str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'https://')) {
            return rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '/admin/dropship/callback';
        }
        $isHttps = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off')
            || strtolower((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] ?? '')) === 'https'
            || (int)($_SERVER['SERVER_PORT'] ?? 80) === 443;
        $scheme = $isHttps ? 'https' : 'http';
        $rawHost = (string)($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? ($_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'] ?? 'localhost'));
        $host = preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(?::\d{1,5})?$/', $rawHost) ? $rawHost : 'localhost';
        return $scheme . '://' . $host . $baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/callback';
    }

    public function orders(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $status = (string)$request->input('status', '');
        $search = (string)$request->input('q', '');

        $filters = [];
        if ($status !== '') {
            $filters['status'] = $status;
        }
        if ($search !== '') {
            $filters['search'] = $search;
        }

        $orders = $this->orderRepo !== null ? $this->orderRepo->list($filters, 50, 0) : [];
        $registeredCustomers = $this->customerRepo !== null ? $this->customerRepo->listAll(200, 0) : [];
        $customersByEmail = [];
        foreach ($registeredCustomers as $cust) {
            $em = strtolower(trim((string)($cust['email'] ?? '')));
            if ($em !== '') {
                $customersByEmail[$em] = $cust;
            }
        }

        $orderRefs = array_values(array_filter(array_map(static fn (array $o): string => (string)($o['order_ref'] ?? ''), $orders)));
        $disputesByOrder = $this->disputeRepo !== null ? $this->disputeRepo->mapByOrderRefs($orderRefs) : [];
        $slaCalc = $this->slaService ?? new OrderSlaProgressService();

        foreach ($orders as &$ord) {
            $ref = (string)($ord['order_ref'] ?? '');
            $em = strtolower(trim((string)($ord['customer_email'] ?? '')));
            $ordDisputes = $disputesByOrder[$ref] ?? [];
            $ord['disputes'] = $ordDisputes;
            $ord['is_registered_customer'] = isset($customersByEmail[$em]);
            $ord['sla'] = $slaCalc->calculate($ord, $ordDisputes);
        }
        unset($ord);

        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashMsg = $flash['msg'] ?? null;
        $flashType = $flash['type'] ?? null;

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/admin/orders.php';
        $content = ob_get_clean();

        return new ViewResponse($content ?: '');
    }

    public function updateFulfillment(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $orderRef = (string)$request->input('order_ref', '');
        $status = (string)$request->input('status', 'paid');
        $aeOrderId = trim((string)$request->input('aliexpress_order_id', ''));
        $tracking = trim((string)$request->input('tracking_code', ''));
        $sellerOrigin = strtoupper(trim((string)$request->input('seller_origin', '')));
        $expectedDays = (int)$request->input('expected_delivery_days', 0);
        $sellerEmail = trim((string)$request->input('seller_email', ''));

        if ($this->orderRepo !== null && $orderRef !== '') {
            $existingOrder = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
            $this->orderRepo->updateFulfillment(
                $orderRef,
                $status,
                $aeOrderId !== '' ? $aeOrderId : null,
                $tracking !== '' ? $tracking : null
            );

            if ($sellerOrigin !== '') {
                $days = $expectedDays > 0 ? $expectedDays : ($sellerOrigin === 'CN' ? 25 : 7);
                $this->orderRepo->updateSellerAndSla(
                    $orderRef,
                    $sellerOrigin,
                    $days,
                    null,
                    $sellerEmail !== '' ? $sellerEmail : null
                );
            }

            // Notifica o cliente por e-mail automaticamente caso haja novo código de rastreio
            if ($this->notificationService !== null && $tracking !== '' && is_array($existingOrder)) {
                $prevTracking = trim((string)($existingOrder['tracking_code'] ?? ''));
                if (strcasecmp($prevTracking, $tracking) !== 0) {
                    $existingOrder['order_ref'] = $orderRef;
                    $this->notificationService->notifyOrderShipped($existingOrder, $tracking);
                }
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Status de envio do pedido atualizado com sucesso!');
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
    }

    /**
     * Consulta o SDK oficial do AliExpress para verificar se o item chegou ao destino.
     */
    public function checkOrderSdk(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isAjax = $this->isAjaxOrJson($request);

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $orderRef = trim((string)$request->input('order_ref', ''));
        $order = ($this->orderRepo !== null && $orderRef !== '') ? $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef) : null;
        if ($order === null) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pedido não encontrado.'], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Pedido não encontrado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $trackingCode = trim((string)($order['tracking_code'] ?? ''));
        $aeOrderId = trim((string)($order['aliexpress_order_id'] ?? ''));

        if ($trackingCode === '' || $this->apiClient === null) {
            $msg = 'Informe o código de rastreio do pedido antes de consultar o SDK logístico.';
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $msg], 422);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        try {
            $sdkRes = $this->apiClient->queryTrackingInfo(
                logisticsNo: $trackingCode,
                origin: 'ESCROW',
                outRef: $aeOrderId,
                serviceName: preg_match('/BR$/i', $trackingCode) ? 'CORREIOS' : 'CAINIAO',
                toArea: 'BR'
            );

            $slaCalc = $this->slaService ?? new OrderSlaProgressService();
            $parsed = $slaCalc->parseSdkTracking($sdkRes);
            $summaryJson = json_encode($sdkRes, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?: '{}';

            if ($parsed['delivered']) {
                $this->orderRepo->updateSdkTracking(
                    $orderRef,
                    date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                    $summaryJson,
                    'delivered'
                );
                $msg = 'SDK AliExpress confirmou: item entregue no local! Pedido atualizado para "Tudo Ok".';
            } else {
                $this->orderRepo->updateSdkTracking($orderRef, null, $summaryJson, null);
                $msg = 'SDK consultado: encomenda ainda em trânsito (' . ($parsed['last_event'] !== '' ? $parsed['last_event'] : $parsed['status_code']) . ').';
            }

            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => true, 'delivered' => $parsed['delivered'], 'message' => $msg, 'tracking' => $parsed]);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $msg = 'Falha ao consultar SDK logístico: ' . $e->getMessage();
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $msg], 500);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
    }

    /**
     * Botão único de intermediação com o fornecedor (PT-BR se Brasil, traduzido para Chinês se China).
     */
    public function mediateDispute(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isAjax = $this->isAjaxOrJson($request);

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $orderRef = trim((string)$request->input('order_ref', ''));
        $disputeId = (int)$request->input('dispute_id', 0);

        $order = ($this->orderRepo !== null && $orderRef !== '') ? $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef) : null;
        if ($order === null) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pedido não encontrado.'], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Pedido não encontrado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $dispute = null;
        if ($this->disputeRepo !== null) {
            $dispute = $disputeId > 0 ? $this->disputeRepo->findById($disputeId) : null;
            if ($dispute === null) {
                $list = $this->disputeRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
                $dispute = $list[0] ?? null;
            }
        }

        if ($dispute === null || $this->mediationService === null) {
            $msg = 'Nenhuma reclamação aberta encontrada para intermediar.';
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $msg], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $overrideOrigin = strtoupper(trim((string)$request->input('seller_origin', '')));
        if (in_array($overrideOrigin, ['BR', 'CN'], true)) {
            $dispute['seller_origin'] = $overrideOrigin;
        }

        $result = $this->mediationService->sendMediation($order, $dispute, $baseUrl);
        $langLabel = ($result['seller_language'] ?? '') === 'zh-CN'
            ? 'Chinês Simplificado (zh-CN)'
            : 'Português (pt-BR)';

        $msg = "Intermediação enviada ao fornecedor em {$langLabel}!";
        if ($isAjax) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'success'            => true,
                'message'            => $msg,
                'seller_language'    => $result['seller_language'] ?? 'zh-CN',
                'channel'            => $result['channel'] ?? 'aliexpress_mediation_log',
                'translated_message' => $result['translated_message'] ?? '',
            ]);
        }

        $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
    }

    public function syncImages(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isAjax = $this->isAjaxOrJson($request);

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        if ($this->mediaSync === null) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Serviço de sincronização de mídia indisponível.'], 503);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Serviço de sincronização de mídia indisponível.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        try {
            $updated = $this->mediaSync->syncProductMedia((int)$id);
            $images = $this->filterImageUrls(array_merge([$updated->mainImageUrl], $updated->images));
            $mainImageUrl = $updated->mainImageUrl ?: ($images[0] ?? '');
            $imgCount = count($images);
            $msg = "🔄 Produto '{$updated->title}' sincronizado com sucesso! {$imgCount} foto(s) em alta resolução carregada(s).";

            if ($isAjax) {
                $rate = $this->currencyConverter->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
                if ($rate <= 0) {
                    $rate = 5.50;
                }
                return new JsonResponse([
                    'success'        => true,
                    'message'        => $msg,
                    'title'          => $updated->title,
                    'main_image_url' => $mainImageUrl,
                    'images'         => $images,
                    'count'          => $imgCount,
                    'sale_formatted' => 'R$ ' . number_format($updated->salePriceBrl, 2, ',', '.'),
                    'cost_formatted' => 'R$ ' . number_format($updated->costPriceUsd * $rate, 2, ',', '.'),
                    'cost_price_usd' => $updated->costPriceUsd,
                ]);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $prodId = (int)$id;
            $isNotFoundOnSupplier = str_starts_with($e->getMessage(), 'PAGINA_NAO_ENCONTRADA:');
            if ($isNotFoundOnSupplier && $prodId > 0) {
                $this->catalogRepo->delete($prodId);
                $delMsg = "🗑️ Página Não Encontrada no fornecedor: o produto #{$prodId} foi excluído automaticamente (mesmo com imagem indexada).";
                if ($isAjax) {
                    return new JsonResponse([
                        'success'    => false,
                        'deleted'    => true,
                        'reason'     => 'not_found',
                        'product_id' => $prodId,
                        'message'    => $delMsg,
                    ], 200);
                }
                $this->session->setFlash('success', $delMsg);
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
            }

            if (str_starts_with($e->getMessage(), 'SDK_NAO_AUTORIZADO:')) {
                $authMsg = "🔑 Access Token OAuth do AliExpress não autorizado em Configurações & API: o produto #{$prodId} foi preservado publicado sem recorrer a scraping.";
                if ($isAjax) {
                    return new JsonResponse([
                        'success'         => false,
                        'temporary_block' => true,
                        'product_id'      => $prodId,
                        'message'         => $authMsg,
                    ], 200);
                }
                $this->session->setFlash('warning', $authMsg);
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
            }

            if (str_starts_with($e->getMessage(), 'BLOQUEIO_TEMPORARIO_FORNECEDOR:')) {
                $tempMsg = "⏳ Verificação anti-robô temporária (captcha) do AliExpress: o produto #{$prodId} foi preservado publicado sem alterações.";
                if ($isAjax) {
                    return new JsonResponse([
                        'success'         => false,
                        'temporary_block' => true,
                        'product_id'      => $prodId,
                        'message'         => $tempMsg,
                    ], 200);
                }
                $this->session->setFlash('warning', $tempMsg);
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
            }

            // Regra de Integridade: Se houve erro de conteúdo sem fotos, move para Rascunho
            if ($prodId > 0) {
                $this->catalogRepo->updateStatus($prodId, 'draft');
            }

            $errMsg = "⚠️ Fornecedor não encontrado ou sem fotos reais: {$e->getMessage()}. O produto foi despublicado da loja e movido para Rascunho / Fila de Exclusão.";
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse([
                    'success'      => false,
                    'message'      => $errMsg,
                    'unregistered' => true,
                    'product_id'   => $prodId,
                    'new_status'   => 'draft'
                ], 422);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('warning', $errMsg);
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    public function updateImages(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isAjax = $this->isAjaxOrJson($request);

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $product = $this->catalogRepo->findById((int)$id);
        if ($product === null) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Produto não encontrado.'], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Produto não encontrado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $rawImages = $request->input('images_json');
        $parsedImages = [];
        if (is_string($rawImages) && trim($rawImages) !== '') {
            $decoded = json_decode($rawImages, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $parsedImages = $decoded;
            }
        } elseif (is_array($request->input('images'))) {
            $parsedImages = $request->input('images');
        }

        $mainImageInput = trim((string)$request->input('main_image_url', ''));
        $validImages = $this->filterImageUrls($parsedImages);
        $validMain = $this->filterImageUrls([$mainImageInput])[0] ?? ($validImages[0] ?? '');

        if ($validMain === '' && empty($validImages)) {
            $errMsg = 'Informe pelo menos 1 URL de imagem HTTP/HTTPS válida.';
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $errMsg], 422);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $errMsg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        // Garante que a imagem principal esteja na lista (em primeiro lugar)
        $orderedImages = $this->filterImageUrls(array_merge([$validMain], $validImages));

        $updatedDto = new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: $product->aliexpressId,
            title: $product->title,
            slug: $product->slug,
            costPriceUsd: $product->costPriceUsd,
            salePriceBrl: $product->salePriceBrl,
            mainImageUrl: $validMain,
            images: $orderedImages,
            category: $product->category,
            description: $product->description,
            rating: $product->rating,
            ordersCount: $product->ordersCount,
            attributes: $product->attributes,
            status: $product->status,
            id: $product->id
        );

        $this->catalogRepo->save($updatedDto);

        $count = count($orderedImages);
        $msg = "🖼️ Galeria de '{$product->title}' atualizada! {$count} foto(s) salva(s).";

        if ($isAjax) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'success'        => true,
                'message'        => $msg,
                'main_image_url' => $validMain,
                'images'         => $orderedImages,
                'count'          => $count,
            ]);
        }

        $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, mixed> $urls
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function filterImageUrls(array $urls): array
    {
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($urls as $raw) {
            if (!is_string($raw)) {
                continue;
            }
            $url = trim($raw);
            if ($url === '' || !filter_var($url, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL)) {
                continue;
            }
            $scheme = strtolower((string)parse_url($url, PHP_URL_SCHEME));
            if ($scheme !== 'http' && $scheme !== 'https') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!in_array($url, $clean, true)) {
                $clean[] = $url;
            }
        }
        return $clean;
    }

    public function syncQueue(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $products = $this->catalogRepo->list([], 500, 0);
        $items = [];
        $totalSingleOrEmpty = 0;
        $totalMulti = 0;

        foreach ($products as $p) {
            if ($p->id === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $images = !empty($p->images) ? array_values(array_filter($p->images)) : [];
            $imgCount = count($images);
            $hasMultiple = $imgCount > 1;

            if ($hasMultiple) {
                $totalMulti++;
            } else {
                $totalSingleOrEmpty++;
            }

            $items[] = [
                'id'            => (int)$p->id,
                'title'         => $p->title,
                'aliexpress_id' => $p->aliexpressId,
                'images_count'  => $imgCount,
                'needs_sync'    => !$hasMultiple,
                'category'      => $p->category,
                'main_image'    => $p->mainImageUrl,
            ];
        }

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success'               => true,
            'total'                 => count($items),
            'single_or_empty_count' => $totalSingleOrEmpty,
            'multi_count'           => $totalMulti,
            'items'                 => $items,
        ]);
    }

    public function updatePrice(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $productId = (int)$id;
        $product = $this->catalogRepo->findById($productId);
        if ($product === null) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Produto não encontrado.'], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Produto não encontrado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $rate = $this->currencyConverter->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
        if ($rate <= 0) {
            $rate = 5.50;
        }

        // Preço de venda em BRL
        $salePriceBrl = max(0.01, $this->parseCurrency($request->input('sale_price_brl')));

        // Custo pode ser informado em BRL ou USD
        $costPriceUsd = null;
        if ($request->input('cost_price_brl') !== null && $request->input('cost_price_brl') !== '') {
            $costBrl = max(0.0, $this->parseCurrency($request->input('cost_price_brl')));
            $costPriceUsd = round($costBrl / $rate, 2);
        } elseif ($request->input('cost_price_usd') !== null && $request->input('cost_price_usd') !== '') {
            $costPriceUsd = max(0.0, $this->parseCurrency($request->input('cost_price_usd')));
        }

        $this->catalogRepo->updatePrice($productId, $salePriceBrl, $costPriceUsd);

        $finalCostUsd = $costPriceUsd ?? $product->costPriceUsd;
        $finalCostBrl = $finalCostUsd * $rate;
        $profitBrl = $salePriceBrl - $finalCostBrl;
        $marginPercent = ($salePriceBrl > 0) ? round(($profitBrl / $salePriceBrl) * 100, 1) : 0;

        $msg = "💰 Preço de '{$product->title}' atualizado com sucesso! Venda: R$ " . number_format($salePriceBrl, 2, ',', '.') . " (Margem: {$marginPercent}% / R$ " . number_format($profitBrl, 2, ',', '.') . ")";

        if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'success'        => true,
                'message'        => $msg,
                'sale_price_brl' => $salePriceBrl,
                'sale_formatted' => 'R$ ' . number_format($salePriceBrl, 2, ',', '.'),
                'cost_price_usd' => $finalCostUsd,
                'cost_price_brl' => round($finalCostBrl, 2),
                'cost_formatted' => 'R$ ' . number_format($finalCostBrl, 2, ',', '.'),
                'profit_brl'     => round($profitBrl, 2),
                'margin_percent' => $marginPercent,
            ]);
        }

        $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    private function isAjaxOrJson(Request $request): bool
    {
        return str_contains((string)$request->header('Accept', ''), 'application/json')
            || (bool)$request->input('ajax', false)
            || ($request->header('X-Requested-With') === 'XMLHttpRequest');
    }

    private function parseCurrency(string|float|int|null $value): float
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            return (float)$value;
        }
        $str = trim((string)$value);
        $str = str_replace(['R$', '$', ' '], '', $str);

        if (str_contains($str, ',')) {
            // Formato brasileiro: 1.234,56 -> remove pontos, substitui vírgula por ponto
            $str = str_replace('.', '', $str);
            $str = str_replace(',', '.', $str);
        }

        return (float)$str;
    }

    public function runDailyCycle(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Token CSRF inválido']), 403, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return new Response('', 302, ['Location' => $baseUrl . '/admin/dropship']);
        }

        try {
            $itemsPerCategory = max(1, min(20, (int)$request->input('items_per_category', 10)));
            $result = $this->miningService->runDailyAutomatedRotation($itemsPerCategory);
            $cycleInfo = $this->miningService->getDailyCycleInfo();

            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success' => true,
                    'message' => "Ciclo diário 24h finalizado com sucesso! Total minerado: {$result['total_mined']} produtos.",
                    'result'  => $result,
                    'cycle'   => $cycleInfo,
                ]), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Ciclo diário 24h concluído com sucesso! {$result['total_mined']} novos produtos minerados nas 9 categorias oficiais.");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]), 500, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Falha ao executar ciclo diário: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return new Response('', 302, ['Location' => $baseUrl . '/admin/dropship']);
    }

    public function clearCatalog(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $action = (string)$request->input('action', 'clear_all');
        try {
            if ($action === 'purge_drafts') {
                $count = $this->catalogRepo->purgeDrafts();
                $this->session->setFlash('success', "🗑️ {$count} produtos em rascunho / despublicados foram removidos do catálogo.");
            } else {
                $count = $this->catalogRepo->clearAll(preserveOrdered: true);
                $this->session->setFlash('success', "✔️ Catálogo limpo com sucesso! {$count} produtos foram removidos. (Produtos com pedidos ativos foram preservados).");
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Falha ao limpar catálogo: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    public function acquireNew(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $replaceCatalog = (bool)$request->input('replace_catalog', true);
        $itemsPerCategory = max(1, min(20, (int)$request->input('items_per_category', 10)));

        try {
            $purgedCount = 0;
            if ($replaceCatalog) {
                $purgedCount = $this->catalogRepo->clearAll(preserveOrdered: true);
            }

            $result = $this->miningService->runDailyAutomatedRotation($itemsPerCategory);

            // Garante que todos os produtos minerados estejam 100% ativos para venda
            $this->catalogRepo->publishAll();

            $totalMined = (int)($result['total_mined'] ?? 0);
            $msg = "🚀 Aquisição concluída com sucesso! {$totalMined} novos produtos oficiais ativos em venda para as próximas 24 horas.";
            if ($purgedCount > 0) {
                $msg .= " ({$purgedCount} produtos antigos foram limpos previamente).";
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Falha ao adquirir novos produtos: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    /**
     * Gestão Administrativa de Clientes Cadastrados (semelhante a Alunos & Matrículas do Academy).
     */
    public function customers(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $search = trim((string)$request->input('q', ''));
        $status = trim((string)$request->input('status', 'all'));
        $page = max(1, (int)$request->input('page', 1));
        $perPage = 15;

        $customers = [];
        $total = 0;
        $metrics = [
            'total_customers'     => 0,
            'active_customers'    => 0,
            'suspended_customers' => 0,
            'linked_orders'       => 0,
        ];

        if ($this->customerRepo !== null) {
            if (method_exists($this->customerRepo, 'listCustomers')) {
                $res = $this->customerRepo->listCustomers(
                    $page,
                    $perPage,
                    $search !== '' ? $search : null,
                    $status !== 'all' ? $status : null
                );
                $customers = $res['items'] ?? [];
                $total = (int)($res['total'] ?? count($customers));
            } else {
                $customers = $this->customerRepo->listAll($perPage, ($page - 1) * $perPage);
                $total = count($customers);
            }

            if (method_exists($this->customerRepo, 'getCustomerMetrics')) {
                $metrics = $this->customerRepo->getCustomerMetrics();
            }
        }

        $totalPages = max(1, (int)ceil($total / $perPage));
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $currentSearch = $search;
        $currentStatus = $status;
        $recentDisputes = ($this->disputeRepo !== null && method_exists($this->disputeRepo, 'listRecent'))
            ? $this->disputeRepo->listRecent(30)
            : [];

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/admin/customers.php';
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return new ViewResponse($content, true);
    }

    /**
     * Ativa ou suspende a conta de um cliente cadastrado no DomainDrop.
     */
    public function updateCustomerStatus(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/customers');
        }

        $customerId = (int)$id;
        $newStatus = trim((string)$request->input('status', 'active'));
        if (!in_array($newStatus, ['active', 'suspended', 'blocked'], true)) {
            $newStatus = 'active';
        }

        if ($this->customerRepo !== null && method_exists($this->customerRepo, 'updateStatus')) {
            $this->customerRepo->updateStatus($customerId, $newStatus);
            $label = $newStatus === 'active' ? 'ativado' : 'suspenso';
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Status do cliente #{$customerId} atualizado ({$label}).");
        } else {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Repositório de clientes não disponível.');
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/customers');
    }

    /**
     * Tela de Inteligência de Demanda e Livro de Presença: GET /admin/dropship/demand
     */
    public function demandLedger(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $selectedPeriod = trim((string)$request->input('period', date('Y-m')));
        if (!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $selectedPeriod)) {
            $selectedPeriod = date('Y-m');
        }

        $livePulse = $this->metricsRepo ? $this->metricsRepo->getLivePulseMetrics() : [
            'period'                => date('Y-m'),
            'active_products_count' => 0,
            'total_detail_clicks'   => 0,
            'total_buy_clicks'      => 0,
            'total_conversions'     => 0,
            'total_demand_score'    => 0,
            'top_products'          => [],
        ];

        $rankings = $this->metricsRepo ? $this->metricsRepo->getMonthlyRankings($selectedPeriod, 30) : [];
        $categoryProfile = $this->metricsRepo ? $this->metricsRepo->getAudienceCategoryProfile($selectedPeriod) : [];

        // Prioriza leitura em JSON estruturado mensal (sem poluir o banco relacional)
        if ($this->logStorage !== null) {
            try { $this->logStorage->purgeExpiredLogs(2); } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
            $recentActivities = $this->logStorage->getRecentInteractions($selectedPeriod, 50);
        } else {
            $recentActivities = $this->metricsRepo ? $this->metricsRepo->getRecentActivityLogs(50) : [];
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/admin/demand.php';
        $content = ob_get_clean();

        return new ViewResponse($content ?: '');
    }

    private function verifyCsrf(Request $request): bool
    {
        $token = (string)$request->input('csrf_token', (string)$request->input('_csrf', (string)($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? '')));
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        return $token !== '' && hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    /**
     * Gera um state OAuth2 assinado criptograficamente com HMAC-SHA256 e timestamp (Claude Audit Item 1).
     * Imune à perda de sessão decorrente de redirecionamentos cross-site (SameSite Lax/Strict).
     */
    public function generateSignedState(string $appSecret): string
    {
        $nonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $timestamp = (string)time();
        $payload = $nonce . '.' . $timestamp;
        $sig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $appSecret);
        return $payload . '.' . $sig;
    }

    /**
     * Valida um state assinado com checagem de assinatura HMAC-SHA256 e TTL (padrão 600 segundos / 10 minutos).
     */
    public function verifySignedState(string $state, string $appSecret, int $ttl = 600): bool
    {
        if ($state === '' || $appSecret === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $parts = explode('.', $state);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return false;
        }

        $nonce = (string)$parts[0];
        $timestampStr = (string)$parts[1];
        $sig = (string)$parts[2];
        if (!ctype_digit($timestampStr)) {
            return false;
        }

        $timestamp = (int)$timestampStr;
        $now = time();
        if ($timestamp < ($now - $ttl) || $timestamp > ($now + 60)) {
            return false;
        }

        $payload = $nonce . '.' . $timestampStr;
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $appSecret);

        return hash_equals($expectedSig, $sig);
    }

    private function loadConfig(): array
    {
        $config = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AtomicConfigStorage::read($this->configFile);
        if (!empty($config)) {
            return $config;
        }
        return [
            'app_key' => '558628',
            'app_secret' => '',
            'default_markup_percent' => 100.0,
            'min_profit_margin_brl' => 30.0,
        ];
    }

    public function saveConfig(array $config): void
    {
        $saved = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AtomicConfigStorage::write($this->configFile, $config);
        if (!$saved) {
            $dir = dirname($this->configFile);
            @chmod($dir, 0775);
            @chmod($this->configFile, 0664);
            $saved = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AtomicConfigStorage::write($this->configFile, $config);
        }
        if (!$saved) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Permissão negada ao gravar '{$this->configFile}'. Verifique as permissões de escrita na pasta 'config/plugins/'.");
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressApiClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Controlador Público da Loja Virtual de Dropshipping (SRP / DIP).
 */
class DropshipFrontController
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $catalogRepo,
        private readonly ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        private readonly ?ProductMiningServiceInterface $miningService = null,
        private readonly ?DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo = null,
        private readonly ?AliExpressApiClientInterface $apiClient = null,
        private readonly ?\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandTrackerInterface $demandTracker = null,
        private readonly ?\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface $session = null,
        private readonly ?\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface $customerRepo = null
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Resolve a identidade do usuário da sessão atual de forma unificada:
     * 1. Cliente da loja DomainDrop (customer_id / customer_email / customer_name)
     * 2. Aluno da Academy (academy_student_id / academy_student_email / academy_student_name)
     * 3. Administrador ou usuário do sistema (user_id / user_name / user_email)
     */
    private function resolveSessionIdentity(): array
    {
        $session = $this->session;
        if ($session === null && isset($GLOBALS['app'])) {
            try {
                $session = $GLOBALS['app']->getContainer()->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface::class);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }

        $customerId = null;
        $customerName = null;
        $customerEmail = null;
        $userType = 'externo';

        if ($session instanceof \DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface) {
            // 1. Cliente da Loja DomainDrop
            $cId = (int)($session->get('customer_id') ?: 0);
            $cEmail = strtolower(trim((string)($session->get('customer_email') ?: '')));
            $cName = trim((string)($session->get('customer_name') ?: ''));

            if ($cId > 0 && ($cEmail === '' || $cName === '')) {
                if ($this->customerRepo !== null) {
                    try {
                        $cust = $this->customerRepo->findById($cId);
                        if ($cust) {
                            if ($cEmail === '' && !empty($cust['email'])) {
                                $cEmail = strtolower(trim((string)$cust['email']));
                            }
                            if ($cName === '' && !empty($cust['name'])) {
                                $cName = trim((string)$cust['name']);
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
                }
            }

            // 2. Aluno da Academy
            if ($cId <= 0 && $cEmail === '') {
                $cId = (int)($session->get('academy_student_id') ?: 0);
                $cEmail = strtolower(trim((string)($session->get('academy_student_email') ?: '')));
                $cName = trim((string)($session->get('academy_student_name') ?: ''));
            }

            // 3. Usuário / Administrador logado no sistema
            if ($cId <= 0 && $cEmail === '') {
                $uId = (int)($session->get('user_id') ?: 0);
                if ($uId > 0) {
                    $cId = $uId;
                    $cName = trim((string)($session->get('user_name') ?: ''));
                    $cEmail = strtolower(trim((string)($session->get('user_email') ?: $session->get('email') ?: '')));
                }
            }

            if ($cId > 0 || $cEmail !== '') {
                $customerId = $cId > 0 ? $cId : null;
                $customerName = $cName !== '' ? $cName : 'Cliente Cadastrado';
                $customerEmail = $cEmail !== '' ? $cEmail : null;
                $userType = 'cliente_logado';
            }
        }

        return [
            'id'        => $customerId,
            'name'      => $customerName,
            'email'     => $customerEmail,
            'user_type' => $userType,
            'sess_id'   => session_id() ?: null,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Endpoint Assíncrono de Rastreamento de Demanda: POST /api/drop/track-demand
     */
    public function trackDemand(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        if (empty($payload) || !is_array($payload)) {
            $payload = $request->all();
        }

        if ($this->demandTracker !== null && !empty($payload)) {
            $identity = $this->resolveSessionIdentity();
            // Remove campos de identidade/conversão forjáveis do payload público
            unset($payload['customer_id'], $payload['customer_name'], $payload['customer_email'], $payload['ip_address']);
            $rawAct = strtolower(trim((string)($payload['action'] ?? ($payload['event_type'] ?? 'view_details'))));
            if (in_array($rawAct, ['conversion', 'purchase'], true)) {
                $payload['action'] = 'view_details';
                $payload['event_type'] = 'view_details';
            }

            $event = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent::fromArray(
                payload: $payload,
                sessionId: $identity['sess_id'],
                customerId: $identity['id'],
                customerName: $identity['name'],
                customerEmail: $identity['email'],
                ipAddress: \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent::resolveClientIp()
            );
            $tracked = $this->demandTracker->recordInteraction($event);
            return Response::json([
                'success'   => true,
                'tracked'   => $tracked,
                'user_type' => $event->userType,
                'identity'  => [
                    'id'    => $event->customerId,
                    'name'  => $event->customerName,
                    'email' => $event->customerEmail,
                ],
            ]);
        }

        return Response::json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Rastreador de demanda indisponível'], 400);
    }

    /**
     * Endpoint de Verificação ao Vivo no Clique de Compra: POST /api/drop/check-availability
     */
    public function checkAvailability(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        if (empty($payload) || !is_array($payload)) {
            $payload = $request->all();
        }

        $productId = (int)($payload['product_id'] ?? 0);
        $slug = trim((string)($payload['slug'] ?? ''));
        $skuId = trim((string)($payload['sku'] ?? ''));

        $product = null;
        if ($productId > 0) {
            $product = $this->catalogRepo->findById($productId);
        } elseif ($slug !== '') {
            $product = $this->catalogRepo->findBySlug($slug);
        }

        if ($product === null || $product->status !== 'published') {
            return Response::json([
                'success'      => true,
                'available'    => false,
                'reason'       => 'not_found',
                'message'      => 'O estoque deste produto já acabou e ele não está mais disponível.',
                'stock'        => 0,
                'stock_source' => 'catalog',
            ]);
        }

        if ($this->miningService !== null && method_exists($this->miningService, 'checkLiveProductAvailability')) {
            $check = $this->miningService->checkLiveProductAvailability($product, $skuId);
            return Response::json(array_merge(['success' => true], $check));
        }

        return Response::json([
            'success'      => true,
            'available'    => true,
            'reason'       => 'available',
            'message'      => 'Produto disponível para compra.',
            'stock'        => null,
            'stock_source' => 'catalog',
        ]);
    }
