        // 4. Integração com DomainCommerce (Resolução de Itens Vendáveis no Checkout)
        $runtime->onHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers', function ($resolver) use ($runtime) {
            if ($resolver instanceof PurchasableItemResolverInterface) {
                $resolveDropshipItem = function (int $id, array $context = []) use ($runtime) {
                    try {
                        /** @var DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $repo */
                        $repo = $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $product = $repo->findById($id);
                        if ($product !== null) {
                            // Resolve SKU a partir do contexto explicitamente fornecido (sem superglobais)
                            $requestedSku = trim((string)($context['sku'] ?? ''));
                            if ($requestedSku === '') {
                                // Fallback retrocompatível caso não injetado no contexto
                                $requestedSku = trim((string)($_GET['sku'] ?? ($_POST['sku'] ?? '')));
                            }
                            return new DropshipProductPurchasableAdapter($product, $requestedSku !== '' ? $requestedSku : null);
                        }
                        return null;
                    } catch (Throwable $e) {
                        return null;
                    }
                };

                $resolver->registerResolver('dropship_product', $resolveDropshipItem);
            }
        });

        // 5. Integração com Pagamentos Aprovados (Criação de Pedido de Dropshipping)
        $runtime->onHook('payment.approved', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $itemType = (string)($payload['item_type'] ?? '');
            $itemId = (int)($payload['item_id'] ?? ($payload['course_id'] ?? 0));
            $orderRef = (string)($payload['order_ref'] ?? '');

            if (in_array($itemType, ['dropship_product', 'dropship', 'product'], true) && $orderRef !== '') {
                try {
                    /** @var DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo */
                    $orderRepo = $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class);
                    $existing = $orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
                    if ($existing === null) {
                        $sellerOrigin = 'CN';
                        $expectedDays = 25;
                        $sellerName = null;
                        $productSlug = null;
                        $productTitle = null;
                        $aeProductId = null;

                        if ($itemId > 0) {
                            try {
                                /** @var DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $catRepo */
                                $catRepo = $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class);
                                $productDto = $catRepo->findById($itemId);
                                if ($productDto !== null) {
                                    $sellerInfo = $productDto->getSellerInfo();
                                    $isBr = !empty($sellerInfo['is_brazil']);
                                    $sellerOrigin = $isBr ? 'BR' : 'CN';
                                    $expectedDays = $isBr ? 7 : 25;
                                    $sellerName = (string)($sellerInfo['store_name'] ?? '');
                                    $productSlug = $productDto->slug;
                                    $productTitle = $productDto->title;
                                    $aeProductId = $productDto->aliexpressId;
                                }
                            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                            }
                        }

                        $newDropOrder = [
                            'order_ref'              => $orderRef,
                            'customer_name'          => (string)($payload['customer_name'] ?? 'Cliente'),
                            'customer_email'         => (string)($payload['customer_email'] ?? ''),
                            'customer_document'      => isset($payload['customer_document']) ? (string)$payload['customer_document'] : null,
                            'shipping_address'       => isset($payload['shipping_address']) ? $payload['shipping_address'] : null,
                            'status'                 => 'paid',
                            'total_paid_brl'         => (float)($payload['total'] ?? 0.0),
                            'seller_origin'          => $sellerOrigin,
                            'seller_name'            => $sellerName,
                            'expected_delivery_days' => $expectedDays,
                            'product_slug'           => $productSlug,
                            'product_title'          => $productTitle,
                            'aliexpress_product_id'  => $aeProductId,
                        ];
                        $orderRepo->create($newDropOrder);

                        // Se houver endereço e cliente cadastrado, atualiza endereço no cliente caso ainda não tenha
                        try {
                            /** @var DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface $customerRepo */
                            $customerRepo = $runtime->make(DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface::class);
                            $shipAddr = $payload['shipping_address'] ?? null;
                            $cEmail = (string)($payload['customer_email'] ?? '');
                            if (is_array($shipAddr) && !empty($shipAddr['zip']) && $cEmail !== '') {
                                $existingCustomer = $customerRepo->findByEmail($cEmail);
                                if ($existingCustomer !== null && (empty($existingCustomer['shipping_zip']) || empty($existingCustomer['shipping_address']))) {
                                    $customerRepo->updateAddress((int)$existingCustomer['id'], $shipAddr);
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (Throwable $e) {
                            // Isolamento gracioso
                        }

                        // Dispara e-mail de confirmação de pagamento para o cliente
                        try {
                            /** @var \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\DropshipCustomerNotificationService $notifService */
                            $notifService = $runtime->make(\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\DropshipCustomerNotificationService::class);
                            $notifService->notifyOrderPaid($newDropOrder);
                        } catch (Throwable $e) {
                            // Isolamento gracioso
                        }
                    } else {
                        $orderRepo->updateFulfillment($orderRef, 'paid');
                    }

                    // Registra conversão de venda no Livro de Demanda com identidade completa do comprador
                    try {
                        /** @var \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandTrackerInterface $demandTracker */
                        $demandTracker = $runtime->make(\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandTrackerInterface::class);
                        $cId = (int)($payload['user_id'] ?? 0);
                        $cName = trim((string)($payload['customer_name'] ?? ''));
                        $cEmail = strtolower(trim((string)($payload['customer_email'] ?? '')));
                        $sessionId = session_id() ?: null;

                        $demandTracker->recordInteraction(new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent(
                            productId: $aeProductId ?: (string)$itemId,
                            productTitle: $productTitle,
                            categorySlug: 'geral',
                            actionType: 'conversion',
                            sessionId: $sessionId,
                            customerId: $cId ?: null,
                            customerName: $cName ?: null,
                            customerEmail: $cEmail ?: null,
                            userType: ($cId > 0 || $cEmail !== '') ? 'cliente_logado' : 'externo'
                        ));
                    } catch (Throwable $e) {}
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    error_log('[DomainDrop] Falha ao registrar pedido em payment.approved: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }
            }
        });

        // 5.0.1 Sincronização de Reembolso do Commerce -> DomainDrop
        $runtime->onHook('payment.refunded', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $itemType = (string)($payload['item_type'] ?? '');
            $orderRef = (string)($payload['order_ref'] ?? '');
            if ($orderRef !== '' && ($itemType === '' || in_array($itemType, ['dropship_product', 'dropship', 'product'], true))) {
                try {
                    /** @var DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo */
                    $orderRepo = $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class);
                    $existing = $orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
                    if ($existing !== null) {
                        $orderRepo->updateFulfillment($orderRef, 'refunded');
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    error_log('[DomainDrop] Falha ao atualizar reembolso em payment.refunded: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }
            }
        });

        // 5.1 Registro de Intenção e Atribuição de Demanda ao Gerar Pedido no Checkout
        $runtime->onHook('dropship.order_created', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $itemType = (string)($payload['item_type'] ?? '');
            if (!in_array($itemType, ['dropship_product', 'dropship', 'product'], true)) {
                return;
            }

            try {
                /** @var \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandTrackerInterface $demandTracker */
                $demandTracker = $runtime->make(\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandTrackerInterface::class);
                $sessionId = session_id() ?: '';
                $cId = (int)($payload['user_id'] ?? 0);
                $cName = trim((string)($payload['customer_name'] ?? ''));
                $cEmail = strtolower(trim((string)($payload['customer_email'] ?? '')));

                $clientIp = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent::resolveClientIp();
                if ($cId > 0) {
                    $demandTracker->promoteSession($sessionId, $cId, $cName, $cEmail, $clientIp);
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Isolamento gracioso
            }
        });

        // 6. Registro de Blocos Semânticos no Flex Builder via Contrato (SOLID - OCP / DIP)
        $registerDropshipBlocks = function ($registry) use ($runtime) {
            if (is_object($registry) && method_exists($registry, 'has') && !$registry->has('dropship_showcase')) {
                try {
                    $provider = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks\DropshipBlockProvider(
                        $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class)
                    );
                    $provider->registerBlocks($registry);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Isolamento gracioso
                }
            }
        };

        $runtime->onHook('theme.blocks.register', $registerDropshipBlocks);
        $runtime->onHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks', $registerDropshipBlocks);

        // 7. Shortcode para Vitrine de Dropshipping: [dropship_vitrine limit="8" cols="4" category=""]
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function (\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $manager) use ($runtime) {
            $manager->add('dropship_vitrine', function ($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    $block = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks\DropshipShowcaseBlock(
                        $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class)
                    );
                    $attributes = [
                        'limit'    => isset($attrs['limit']) ? (int)$attrs['limit'] : 8,
                        'columns'  => isset($attrs['cols']) ? (int)$attrs['cols'] : (isset($attrs['columns']) ? (int)$attrs['columns'] : 4),
                        'category' => isset($attrs['category']) ? (string)$attrs['category'] : '',
                        'title'    => isset($attrs['title']) ? (string)$attrs['title'] : 'Tendências em Alta & Mais Vendidos',
                    ];
                    return $block->render($attributes);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    return "<div style='text-align:center; padding:30px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:8px; color:#8c8f94;'>Vitrine Dropshipping em configuração.</div>";
                }
            });
        });
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain_drop/Repositories/DomainDropSchemaEnsurer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Garante de forma idempotente e segura que as tabelas do DomainDrop
 * (incluindo clientes, endereços, reclamações e colunas de SLA) existam mesmo antes
 * de uma execução manual do CLI bin/migrate.php.
 */
final class DomainDropSchemaEnsurer
{
    /** @var \WeakMap<PDO, bool>|null */
    private static ?\WeakMap $ensuredConnections = null;

    public static function ensure(PDO $pdo): void
    {
        if (self::$ensuredConnections === null) {
            self::$ensuredConnections = new \WeakMap();
        }
        if (isset(self::$ensuredConnections[$pdo])) {
            return;
        }

        if (self::schemaAlreadyPresent($pdo)) {
            self::$ensuredConnections[$pdo] = true;
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Garante coluna period_year_month na tabela de demanda se a tabela já existir previamente
            $driver = (string)$pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
            if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
                $checkDemand = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='domain_drop_product_demand'");
                if ($checkDemand && $checkDemand->fetchColumn() !== false) {
                    $dCols = $pdo->query("PRAGMA table_info(domain_drop_product_demand)");
                    $dColNames = $dCols ? array_column($dCols->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'name') : [];
                    if (!in_array('period_year_month', $dColNames, true)) {
                        $pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE domain_drop_product_demand ADD COLUMN period_year_month TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''");
                    }
                    if (!in_array('demand_score', $dColNames, true)) {
                        $pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE domain_drop_product_demand ADD COLUMN demand_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0");
                    }
                    if (!in_array('category_slug', $dColNames, true)) {
                        $pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE domain_drop_product_demand ADD COLUMN category_slug TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'geral'");
                    }
                }
            } elseif ($driver === 'mysql') {
                $checkDemand = $pdo->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'domain_drop_product_demand'");
                if ($checkDemand && $checkDemand->fetchColumn() !== false) {
                    $dCols = $pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM domain_drop_product_demand LIKE 'period_year_month'");
                    if ($dCols && $dCols->fetchColumn() === false) {
                        $pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE domain_drop_product_demand ADD COLUMN `period_year_month` VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''");
                    }
                }
            }

            $migrationsDir = dirname(__DIR__) . '/migrations';
            foreach ([
                '2026_11_10_000001_create_domain_drop_tables.php',
                '2026_11_12_000001_create_customer_disputes_and_mediation.php',
                '2026_11_16_000001_create_domain_drop_demand_table.php',
                '2026_11_16_000002_create_domain_drop_demand_activity_logs_table.php',
                '2026_11_18_000001_add_shipping_address_to_customers.php',
            ] as $file) {
                $path = $migrationsDir . '/' . $file;
                if (is_file($path)) {
                    $migration = require $path;
                    if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up']) && is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                        ($migration['up'])($pdo);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (self::schemaAlreadyPresent($pdo)) {
                self::$ensuredConnections[$pdo] = true;
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            error_log('[DomainDropSchemaEnsurer] Falha ao garantir schema: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public static function resetCache(): void
    {
        self::$ensuredConnections = null;
    }

    private static function schemaAlreadyPresent(PDO $pdo): bool
    {
        try {
            $driver = (string)$pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
            if ($driver === 'mysql') {
                $c0 = $pdo->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'domain_drop_catalog'");
                $c1 = $pdo->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'domain_drop_customers'");
                $c2 = $pdo->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'domain_drop_disputes'");
                $c3 = $pdo->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'domain_drop_product_demand'");
                $c4 = $pdo->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'domain_drop_demand_activity_logs'");
                $cols = $pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM domain_drop_orders LIKE 'seller_origin'");
                $cAddr = $pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM domain_drop_customers LIKE 'shipping_zip'");
                return $c0 !== false && $c0->fetchColumn() !== false
                    && $c1 !== false && $c1->fetchColumn() !== false
                    && $c2 !== false && $c2->fetchColumn() !== false
                    && $c3 !== false && $c3->fetchColumn() !== false
                    && $c4 !== false && $c4->fetchColumn() !== false
                    && $cols !== false && $cols->fetchColumn() !== false
                    && $cAddr !== false && $cAddr->fetchColumn() !== false;
            }

            $c0 = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='domain_drop_catalog'");
            $c1 = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='domain_drop_customers'");
            $c2 = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='domain_drop_disputes'");
            $c3 = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='domain_drop_product_demand'");
            $c4 = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='domain_drop_demand_activity_logs'");
            $cols = $pdo->query("PRAGMA table_info(domain_drop_orders)");
            $colNames = $cols ? array_column($cols->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'name') : [];

            $custCols = $pdo->query("PRAGMA table_info(domain_drop_customers)");
            $custColNames = $custCols ? array_column($custCols->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'name') : [];

            return $c0 !== false && $c0->fetchColumn() !== false
                && $c1 !== false && $c1->fetchColumn() !== false
                && $c2 !== false && $c2->fetchColumn() !== false
                && $c3 !== false && $c3->fetchColumn() !== false
                && $c4 !== false && $c4->fetchColumn() !== false
                && in_array('seller_origin', $colNames, true)
                && in_array('shipping_zip', $custColNames, true);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Repositories/PdoDemandMetricsRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandMetricsRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

final class PdoDemandMetricsRepository implements DemandMetricsRepositoryInterface
{
    private readonly PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        DomainDropSchemaEnsurer::ensure($this->pdo);
    }

    public function incrementMetric(
        string $productId,
        string $productTitle,
        string $categorySlug,
        string $actionType,
        ?\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent $event = null
    ): void {
        $cleanId = trim($productId);
        if ($cleanId === '') {
            return;
        }

        $title = trim(mb_substr($productTitle, 0, 255));
        $category = trim(mb_substr($categorySlug, 0, 64)) ?: 'geral';
        $period = date('Y-m');
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');

        $driver = (string)$this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);

        // Pontuação ponderada: conversions=10, buy_clicks=4, detail_clicks=1
        $detailInc = ($actionType === 'view_details' || $actionType === 'detail_click') ? 1 : 0;
        $buyInc = ($actionType === 'buy_click') ? 1 : 0;
        $convInc = ($actionType === 'conversion') ? 1 : 0;
        $scoreInc = ($convInc * 10) + ($buyInc * 4) + ($detailInc * 1);

        $startedTx = false;
        try {
            if (!$this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $startedTx = $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
            }
            if ($driver === 'mysql') {
                $sql = "
                    INSERT INTO domain_drop_product_demand 
                        (product_id, product_title, category_slug, period_year_month, detail_clicks, buy_clicks, conversions, demand_score, last_searched_at)
                    VALUES 
                        (:pid, :title, :cat, :period, :d_inc, :b_inc, :c_inc, :score, :searched_at)
                    ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                        product_title = VALUES(product_title),
                        category_slug = VALUES(category_slug),
                        detail_clicks = detail_clicks + VALUES(detail_clicks),
                        buy_clicks = buy_clicks + VALUES(buy_clicks),
                        conversions = conversions + VALUES(conversions),
                        demand_score = demand_score + VALUES(demand_score),
                        last_searched_at = VALUES(last_searched_at)
                ";
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
                $stmt->execute([
                    ':pid'         => $cleanId,
                    ':title'       => $title,
                    ':cat'         => $category,
                    ':period'      => $period,
                    ':d_inc'       => $detailInc,
                    ':b_inc'       => $buyInc,
                    ':c_inc'       => $convInc,
                    ':score'       => $scoreInc,
                    ':searched_at' => $now,
                ]);
            } else {
                // SQLite moderno (ON CONFLICT)
                $sql = "
                    INSERT INTO domain_drop_product_demand 
                        (product_id, product_title, category_slug, period_year_month, detail_clicks, buy_clicks, conversions, demand_score, last_searched_at)
                    VALUES 
                        (:pid, :title, :cat, :period, :d_inc, :b_inc, :c_inc, :score, :searched_at)
                    ON CONFLICT(product_id, period_year_month) DO UPDATE SET
                        product_title = excluded.product_title,
                        category_slug = excluded.category_slug,
                        detail_clicks = detail_clicks + excluded.detail_clicks,
                        buy_clicks = buy_clicks + excluded.buy_clicks,
                        conversions = conversions + excluded.conversions,
                        demand_score = demand_score + excluded.demand_score,
                        last_searched_at = excluded.last_searched_at
                ";
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
                $stmt->execute([
                    ':pid'         => $cleanId,
                    ':title'       => $title,
                    ':cat'         => $category,
                    ':period'      => $period,
                    ':d_inc'       => $detailInc,
                    ':b_inc'       => $buyInc,
                    ':c_inc'       => $convInc,
                    ':score'       => $scoreInc,
                    ':searched_at' => $now,
                ]);
            }

            // Grava a trilha de auditoria individual com identificação de usuário (logado vs externo)
            $userType = $event ? $event->userType : 'externo';
            $cId = $event?->customerId;
            $cName = $event?->customerName;
            $cEmail = $event?->customerEmail;
            $sessId = $event?->sessionId;
            $ip = $event?->ipAddress ?: (\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent::resolveClientIp());

            $logStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                INSERT INTO domain_drop_demand_activity_logs
                    (product_id, product_title, category_slug, action_type, user_type, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, session_id, ip_address, created_at)
                VALUES
                    (:pid, :title, :cat, :action, :utype, :cid, :cname, :cemail, :sess, :ip, :created)
            ");
            $logStmt->execute([
                ':pid'     => $cleanId,
                ':title'   => $title,
                ':cat'     => $category,
                ':action'  => $actionType,
                ':utype'   => $userType,
                ':cid'     => $cId,
                ':cname'   => $cName,
                ':cemail'  => $cEmail,
                ':sess'    => $sessId,
                ':ip'      => $ip,
                ':created' => $now,
            ]);
            if ($startedTx && $this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->commit();
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($startedTx && $this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            error_log('[PdoDemandMetricsRepository] Falha ao incrementar métrica: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function getRecentActivityLogs(int $limit = 25): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT id, product_id, product_title, category_slug, action_type, user_type, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, session_id, ip_address, created_at
            FROM domain_drop_demand_activity_logs
            ORDER BY id DESC
            LIMIT :lim
        ");
        $stmt->bindValue(':lim', max(1, min(100, $limit)), PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getLivePulseMetrics(): array
    {
        $currentPeriod = date('Y-m');
        $todayStart = date('Y-m-d 00:00:00');

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT 
                COUNT(*) AS active_products_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(detail_clicks), 0) AS total_detail_clicks,
                COALESCE(SUM(buy_clicks), 0) AS total_buy_clicks,
                COALESCE(SUM(conversions), 0) AS total_conversions,
                COALESCE(SUM(demand_score), 0) AS total_demand_score
            FROM domain_drop_product_demand
            WHERE period_year_month = :period
        ");
        $stmt->execute([':period' => $currentPeriod]);
        $summary = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        // Top 8 produtos mais quentes do mês em tempo real
        $topStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT product_id, product_title, category_slug, detail_clicks, buy_clicks, conversions, demand_score, last_searched_at
            FROM domain_drop_product_demand
            WHERE period_year_month = :period
            ORDER BY demand_score DESC, buy_clicks DESC
            LIMIT 8
        ");
        $topStmt->execute([':period' => $currentPeriod]);
        $topProducts = $topStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return [
            'period'                => $currentPeriod,
            'active_products_count' => (int)($summary['active_products_count'] ?? 0),
            'total_detail_clicks'   => (int)($summary['total_detail_clicks'] ?? 0),
            'total_buy_clicks'      => (int)($summary['total_buy_clicks'] ?? 0),
            'total_conversions'     => (int)($summary['total_conversions'] ?? 0),
            'total_demand_score'    => (int)($summary['total_demand_score'] ?? 0),
            'top_products'          => $topProducts,
        ];
    }

    public function getMonthlyRankings(string $yearMonth, int $limit = 20): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT 
                product_id,
                product_title,
                category_slug,
                period_year_month,
                detail_clicks,
                buy_clicks,
                conversions,
                demand_score,
                ROUND((buy_clicks * 100.0 / NULLIF(detail_clicks + buy_clicks, 0)), 1) AS buy_intent_ratio,
                last_searched_at
            FROM domain_drop_product_demand
            WHERE period_year_month = :period
            ORDER BY demand_score DESC, buy_clicks DESC, conversions DESC
            LIMIT :lim
        ");
        $stmt->bindValue(':period', $yearMonth);
        $stmt->bindValue(':lim', max(1, min(100, $limit)), PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getAudienceCategoryProfile(string $yearMonth): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT 
                category_slug,
                SUM(detail_clicks) AS category_details,
                SUM(buy_clicks) AS category_buys,
                SUM(demand_score) AS category_score
            FROM domain_drop_product_demand
            WHERE period_year_month = :period
            GROUP BY category_slug
            ORDER BY category_score DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([':period' => $yearMonth]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $profile = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $cat = (string)($row['category_slug'] ?? 'geral');
            $profile[$cat] = [
                'score'         => (int)($row['category_score'] ?? 0),
                'detail_clicks' => (int)($row['category_details'] ?? 0),
                'buy_clicks'    => (int)($row['category_buys'] ?? 0),
            ];
        }

        return $profile;
    }

    public function promoteInteractions(
        string $sessionId,
        int $customerId,
        string $customerName,
        string $customerEmail,
        ?string $ipAddress = null
    ): int {
        $cleanSession = trim($sessionId);
        $cleanIp = trim($ipAddress ?? '');
        if ($customerId <= 0 || ($cleanSession === '' && $cleanIp === '')) {
            return 0;
        }

        try {
            // Janela temporal recente para correlação por IP (últimas 4 horas)
            $recentThreshold = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - 14400);

            if ($cleanSession !== '' && $cleanIp !== '') {
                $sql = "
                    UPDATE domain_drop_demand_activity_logs
                    SET 
                        customer_id = :cid,
                        customer_name = :cname,
                        customer_email = :cemail,
                        user_type = 'cliente_logado'
                    WHERE (
                        session_id = :sess 
                        OR (ip_address = :ip AND created_at >= :recent)
                    )
                    AND (customer_id IS NULL OR customer_id = 0 OR user_type = 'externo')
                ";
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
                $stmt->execute([
                    ':cid'    => $customerId,
                    ':cname'  => $customerName,
                    ':cemail' => $customerEmail,
                    ':sess'   => $cleanSession,
                    ':ip'     => $cleanIp,
                    ':recent' => $recentThreshold,
                ]);
            } elseif ($cleanSession !== '') {
                $sql = "
                    UPDATE domain_drop_demand_activity_logs
                    SET 
                        customer_id = :cid,
                        customer_name = :cname,
                        customer_email = :cemail,
                        user_type = 'cliente_logado'
                    WHERE session_id = :sess
                      AND (customer_id IS NULL OR customer_id = 0 OR user_type = 'externo')
                ";
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
                $stmt->execute([
                    ':cid'    => $customerId,
                    ':cname'  => $customerName,
                    ':cemail' => $customerEmail,
                    ':sess'   => $cleanSession,
                ]);
            } else {
                $sql = "
                    UPDATE domain_drop_demand_activity_logs
                    SET 
                        customer_id = :cid,
                        customer_name = :cname,
                        customer_email = :cemail,
                        user_type = 'cliente_logado'
                    WHERE ip_address = :ip
                      AND created_at >= :recent
                      AND (customer_id IS NULL OR customer_id = 0 OR user_type = 'externo')
                ";
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
                $stmt->execute([
                    ':cid'    => $customerId,
                    ':cname'  => $customerName,
                    ':cemail' => $customerEmail,
                    ':ip'     => $cleanIp,
                    ':recent' => $recentThreshold,
                ]);
            }

            return $stmt->rowCount();
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            error_log('[PdoDemandMetricsRepository] Falha ao promover interações de sessão/IP: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public function promoteSessionInteractions(
        string $sessionId,
        int $customerId,
        string $customerName,
        string $customerEmail
    ): int {
        return $this->promoteInteractions($sessionId, $customerId, $customerName, $customerEmail);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Repositories/PdoDropshipCatalogRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\CategoryTaxonomyInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\CategoryTaxonomyService;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para o Catálogo de Produtos Minerados do DomainDrop (DIP / SRP).
 */
class PdoDropshipCatalogRepository implements DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private CategoryTaxonomyInterface $taxonomy;

    public function __construct(
        DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection,
        ?CategoryTaxonomyInterface $taxonomy = null
    ) {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
        $this->taxonomy = $taxonomy ?? new CategoryTaxonomyService();
        DomainDropSchemaEnsurer::ensure($this->pdo);
    }

    public function save(DropshipProductDto $product): int
    {
        $existing = $this->findByAliExpressId($product->aliexpressId);
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $imagesJson = json_encode($product->images, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        $attrJson = json_encode($product->attributes, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

        if ($existing !== null && $existing->id !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
                SET title = ?, slug = ?, cost_price_usd = ?, sale_price_brl = ?,
                    main_image_url = ?, images = ?, category = ?, description = ?,
                    rating = ?, orders_count = ?, attributes = ?, status = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");

            $stmt->execute([
                $product->title,
                $product->slug,
                $product->costPriceUsd,
                $product->salePriceBrl,
                $product->mainImageUrl,
                $imagesJson,
                $product->category,
                $product->description,
                $product->rating,
                $product->ordersCount,
                $attrJson,
                $product->status,
                $now,
                $existing->id,
            ]);

            return $existing->id;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO domain_drop_catalog
                (aliexpress_id, title, slug, cost_price_usd, sale_price_brl, main_image_url, images, category, description, rating, orders_count, attributes, status, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            $product->aliexpressId,
            $product->title,
            $product->slug,
            $product->costPriceUsd,
            $product->salePriceBrl,
            $product->mainImageUrl,
            $imagesJson,
            $product->category,
            $product->description,
            $product->rating,
            $product->ordersCount,
            $attrJson,
            $product->status,
            $now,
            $now,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?DropshipProductDto
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrate($row) : null;
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?DropshipProductDto

        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrate($row) : null;
    }

    public function list(array $criteria = [], int $limit = 20, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($criteria['category'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildCategoryListClause($criteria['category'], $params);
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['slug'])) {
            $where[] = "slug = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['slug'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['search'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildSearchClause((string)$criteria['search'], $params);
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $where);
        }

        $orderBy = "id DESC";
        if (!empty($criteria['sort'])) {
            $sortVal = (string)$criteria['sort'];
            if ($sortVal === 'sales' || $sortVal === 'best_sellers' || $sortVal === 'volume_desc') {
                $orderBy = "orders_count DESC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'updated_desc' || $sortVal === 'recent' || $sortVal === 'cycle') {
                $orderBy = "updated_at DESC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'price_asc') {
                $orderBy = "sale_price_brl ASC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'price_desc') {
                $orderBy = "sale_price_brl DESC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'rating') {
                $orderBy = "rating DESC, id DESC";
            }
        }

        $limit = max(1, $limit);
        $offset = max(0, $offset);
        $sql .= " ORDER BY {$orderBy} LIMIT {$limit} OFFSET {$offset}";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return array_map([$this, 'hydrate'], $rows);
    }

    public function count(array $criteria = []): int
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($criteria['category'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildCategoryListClause($criteria['category'], $params);
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['slug'])) {
            $where[] = "slug = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['slug'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['search'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildSearchClause((string)$criteria['search'], $params);
        }

        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_catalog";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $where);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
    }

    /**
     * Constrói cláusula SQL inteligente para busca textual tolerante a tokens, plural/singular,
     * remoção de preposições (stop words) e sinônimos frequentes de mercado.
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $params
     */
    private function buildSearchClause(string $search, array &$params): string
    {
        $search = trim($search);
        if ($search === '') {
            return '1=1';
        }

        $stopWords = ['de', 'da', 'do', 'das', 'dos', 'em', 'na', 'no', 'nas', 'nos', 'com', 'por', 'para', 'pra', 'um', 'uma', 'uns', 'umas', 'e', 'ou', 'a', 'o', 'as', 'os', 'ao', 'aos', 'que', 'se'];

        // Separa em palavras/tokens limpos
        $rawTokens = preg_split('/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u', mb_strtolower($search, 'UTF-8'), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY) ?: [];

        // Filtra stop words se sobrarem outros termos significativos
        $filtered = array_values(array_filter($rawTokens, fn($t) => !in_array($t, $stopWords, true)));
        $tokens = !empty($filtered) ? $filtered : $rawTokens;

        if (empty($tokens)) {
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            return "(title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?)";
        }

        $tokenClauses = [];
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            $variants = [$token];

            // 1. Versão sem acentos
            $unaccented = preg_replace(
                ['/[áàãâä]/u', '/[éèêë]/u', '/[íìîï]/u', '/[óòõôö]/u', '/[úùûü]/u', '/[ç]/u'],
                ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', 'c'],
                $token
            );
            if ($unaccented !== $token) {
                $variants[] = $unaccented;
            }

            // 2. Singular / Plural inteligente em português
            if (mb_strlen($token, 'UTF-8') > 3 && str_ends_with($token, 's')) {
                $variants[] = mb_substr($token, 0, -1, 'UTF-8');
                if (str_ends_with($token, 'es')) {
                    $variants[] = mb_substr($token, 0, -2, 'UTF-8');
                }
            } elseif (mb_strlen($token, 'UTF-8') >= 3) {
                $variants[] = $token . 's';
            }

            // 3. Normalização das variantes geradas
            foreach ($variants as $v) {
                $unacc = preg_replace(
                    ['/[áàãâä]/u', '/[éèêë]/u', '/[íìîï]/u', '/[óòõôö]/u', '/[úùûü]/u', '/[ç]/u'],
                    ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', 'c'],
                    $v
                );
                if ($unacc !== $v) {
                    $variants[] = $unacc;
                }
            }

            // 4. Sinônimos de mercado comuns
            if (in_array($unaccented, ['relogio', 'relogios', 'smartwatch', 'smartwatches', 'watch'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'relogio';
                $variants[] = 'relógio';
                $variants[] = 'smartwatch';
                $variants[] = 'watch';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['fone', 'fones', 'ouvido', 'tws', 'headset'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'fone';
                $variants[] = 'tws';
                $variants[] = 'ouvido';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['lampada', 'lampadas', 'luminaria', 'luminarias'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'lampada';
                $variants[] = 'lâmpada';
                $variants[] = 'luminaria';
                $variants[] = 'luminária';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['secador', 'secadora', 'secadores', 'escova', 'escovas'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'secador';
                $variants[] = 'secadora';
                $variants[] = 'escova';
            }

            $variants = array_unique(array_filter($variants, fn($v) => mb_strlen($v, 'UTF-8') >= 2));

            $subClauses = [];
            foreach ($variants as $v) {
                $subClauses[] = "(title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?)";
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
            }

            $tokenClauses[] = '(' . implode(' OR ', $subClauses) . ')';
        }

        return '(' . implode(' AND ', $tokenClauses) . ')';
    }

    /**
     * Suporta uma única categoria ou lista de categorias oficiais combinadas com OR.
     *
     * @param string|array<int, string> $category
     * @param array<int, mixed> $params
     */
    private function buildCategoryListClause(string|array $category, array &$params): string
    {
        if (is_array($category)) {
            $parts = [];
            foreach ($category as $catItem) {
                $catStr = trim((string)$catItem);
                if ($catStr !== '') {
                    $parts[] = $this->buildCategoryClause($catStr, $params);
                }
            }
            if (!empty($parts)) {
                return '(' . implode(' OR ', $parts) . ')';
            }
            return '1=1';
        }

        return $this->buildCategoryClause($category, $params);
    }

    /**
     * Constrói cláusula SQL inteligente para categoria delegando para a Taxonomia Desacoplada (SOLID / DIP).
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $params
     */
    private function buildCategoryClause(string $category, array &$params): string
    {
        return $this->taxonomy->buildSqlFilter($category, $params);
    }

    public function delete(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function updatePrice(int $id, float $salePriceBrl, ?float $costPriceUsd = null): bool
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        if ($costPriceUsd !== null && $costPriceUsd >= 0) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
                SET sale_price_brl = ?, cost_price_usd = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            return $stmt->execute([$salePriceBrl, $costPriceUsd, $now, $id]);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
            SET sale_price_brl = ?, updated_at = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$salePriceBrl, $now, $id]);
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $id, string $status): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE domain_drop_catalog 
            SET status = ?, updated_at = ? 
            WHERE id = ?
        ");

        return $stmt->execute([$status, date('Y-m-d H:i:s'), $id]);
    }

    public function getCategories(): array
    {
        $canonicals = $this->taxonomy->getCanonicalCategories();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT DISTINCT category FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE category != '' ORDER BY category ASC");
        $dbCats = $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN) : [];
        return array_values(array_unique(array_merge($canonicals, $dbCats)));
    }

    public function clearAll(bool $preserveOrdered = true): int
    {
        if ($preserveOrdered) {
            try {
                // Preserva produtos vinculados a pedidos de clientes
                $sql = "
                    DELETE FROM domain_drop_catalog
                    WHERE aliexpress_id NOT IN (
                        SELECT aliexpress_product_id 
                        FROM domain_drop_orders 
                        WHERE aliexpress_product_id IS NOT NULL AND aliexpress_product_id != ''
                    )
                ";
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
                $stmt->execute();
                return $stmt->rowCount();
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Fallback se a tabela de pedidos ainda não tiver sido criada
            }
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM domain_drop_catalog");
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->rowCount();
    }

    public function purgeDrafts(): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE status != 'published'");
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->rowCount();
    }

    public function publishAll(): int
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE domain_drop_catalog SET status = 'published', updated_at = ? WHERE status != 'published'");
        $stmt->execute([$now]);
        return $stmt->rowCount();
    }

    public function findSimilarOffers(int $excludeId, string $category, string $title = '', int $limit = 4): array
    {
        $limit = max(1, min(20, $limit));
        $params = [$excludeId];

        $where = ["status = 'published'", "id != ?"];

        // 1. Prioriza filtro por categoria oficial
        if ($category !== '') {
            $catClause = $this->buildCategoryListClause($category, $params);
            $where[] = $catClause;
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE " . implode(' AND ', $where) . " ORDER BY sale_price_brl ASC, orders_count DESC LIMIT {$limit}";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        // 2. Se a categoria tiver poucos itens, busca ofertas de produtos com alta reputação geral
        if (count($rows) < $limit) {
            $needed = $limit - count($rows);
            $existingIds = array_merge([$excludeId], array_column($rows, 'id'));
            $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($existingIds), '?'));
            $fallbackSql = "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE status = 'published' AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders}) ORDER BY sale_price_brl ASC, rating DESC LIMIT {$needed}";
            $fbStmt = $this->pdo->prepare($fallbackSql);
            $fbStmt->execute($existingIds);
            $fbRows = $fbStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
            $rows = array_merge($rows, $fbRows);
        }

        return array_map([$this, 'hydrate'], $rows);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $row
     */
    private function hydrate(array $row): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $images = [];
        if (!empty($row['images'])) {
            $decoded = json_decode((string)$row['images'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $images = $decoded;
            }
        }

        $attributes = [];
        if (!empty($row['attributes'])) {
            $decoded = json_decode((string)$row['attributes'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $attributes = $decoded;
            }
        }

        return new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: (string)$row['aliexpress_id'],
            title: (string)$row['title'],
            slug: (string)$row['slug'],
            costPriceUsd: (float)($row['cost_price_usd'] ?? 0.0),
            salePriceBrl: (float)($row['sale_price_brl'] ?? 0.0),
            mainImageUrl: (string)$row['main_image_url'],
            images: $images,
            category: (string)($row['category'] ?? 'Geral'),
            description: (string)($row['description'] ?? ''),
            rating: (float)($row['rating'] ?? 4.8),
            ordersCount: (int)($row['orders_count'] ?? 0),
            attributes: $attributes,
            status: (string)($row['status'] ?? 'published'),
            id: (int)$row['id']
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para clientes cadastrados na vitrine RachidD.com / DomainDrop.
 */
class PdoDropshipCustomerRepository implements DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(PDO|DatabaseConnectionInterface $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
        DomainDropSchemaEnsurer::ensure($this->pdo);
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $email = strtolower(trim((string)($data['email'] ?? '')));

        $shippingZip = isset($data['shipping_zip']) && trim((string)$data['shipping_zip']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_zip']) : null;
        $shippingAddress = isset($data['shipping_address']) && trim((string)$data['shipping_address']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_address']) : null;
        $shippingNumber = isset($data['shipping_number']) && trim((string)$data['shipping_number']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_number']) : null;
        $shippingComplement = isset($data['shipping_complement']) && trim((string)$data['shipping_complement']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_complement']) : null;
        $shippingNeighborhood = isset($data['shipping_neighborhood']) && trim((string)$data['shipping_neighborhood']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_neighborhood']) : null;
        $shippingCity = isset($data['shipping_city']) && trim((string)$data['shipping_city']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_city']) : null;
        $shippingState = isset($data['shipping_state']) && trim((string)$data['shipping_state']) !== '' ? strtoupper(trim((string)$data['shipping_state'])) : null;

        $defaultShippingAddress = null;
        if (isset($data['default_shipping_address']) && is_array($data['default_shipping_address'])) {
            $defaultShippingAddress = json_encode($data['default_shipping_address'], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        } elseif (isset($data['default_shipping_address']) && is_string($data['default_shipping_address']) && trim($data['default_shipping_address']) !== '') {
            $defaultShippingAddress = trim($data['default_shipping_address']);
        } elseif ($shippingZip !== null || $shippingAddress !== null) {
            $defaultShippingAddress = json_encode([
                'zip'          => $shippingZip,
                'street'       => $shippingAddress,
                'number'       => $shippingNumber,
                'complement'   => $shippingComplement,
                'neighborhood' => $shippingNeighborhood,
                'city'         => $shippingCity,
                'state'        => $shippingState,
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO domain_drop_customers (
                name, email, cpf, phone, password_hash, status,
                shipping_zip, shipping_address, shipping_number, shipping_complement,
                shipping_neighborhood, shipping_city, shipping_state, default_shipping_address,
                created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :name, :email, :cpf, :phone, :password_hash, :status,
                :shipping_zip, :shipping_address, :shipping_number, :shipping_complement,
                :shipping_neighborhood, :shipping_city, :shipping_state, :default_shipping_address,
                :created_at, :updated_at
            )
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            ':name'                     => trim((string)($data['name'] ?? '')),
            ':email'                    => $email,
            ':cpf'                      => isset($data['cpf']) && trim((string)$data['cpf']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['cpf']) : null,
            ':phone'                    => isset($data['phone']) && trim((string)$data['phone']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['phone']) : null,
            ':password_hash'            => (string)($data['password_hash'] ?? ''),
            ':status'                   => (string)($data['status'] ?? 'active'),
            ':shipping_zip'             => $shippingZip,
            ':shipping_address'         => $shippingAddress,
            ':shipping_number'          => $shippingNumber,
            ':shipping_complement'      => $shippingComplement,
            ':shipping_neighborhood'    => $shippingNeighborhood,
            ':shipping_city'            => $shippingCity,
            ':shipping_state'           => $shippingState,
            ':default_shipping_address' => $defaultShippingAddress,
            ':created_at'               => (string)($data['created_at'] ?? $now),
            ':updated_at'               => (string)($data['updated_at'] ?? $now),
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_customers WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrateCustomer($row) : null;
    }

    public function findByEmail(string $email): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_customers WHERE LOWER(email) = :email LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':email' => strtolower(trim($email))]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrateCustomer($row) : null;
    }

    public function updateAddress(int $id, array $addressData): bool
    {
        $zip = isset($addressData['shipping_zip']) && trim((string)$addressData['shipping_zip']) !== ''
            ? trim((string)$addressData['shipping_zip'])
            : (isset($addressData['zip']) && trim((string)$addressData['zip']) !== '' ? trim((string)$addressData['zip']) : null);

        $address = isset($addressData['shipping_address']) && trim((string)$addressData['shipping_address']) !== ''
            ? trim((string)$addressData['shipping_address'])
            : (isset($addressData['street']) && trim((string)$addressData['street']) !== '' ? trim((string)$addressData['street']) : null);

        $number = isset($addressData['shipping_number']) && trim((string)$addressData['shipping_number']) !== ''
            ? trim((string)$addressData['shipping_number'])
            : (isset($addressData['number']) && trim((string)$addressData['number']) !== '' ? trim((string)$addressData['number']) : null);

        $complement = isset($addressData['shipping_complement'])
            ? trim((string)$addressData['shipping_complement'])
            : (isset($addressData['complement']) ? trim((string)$addressData['complement']) : null);

        $neighborhood = isset($addressData['shipping_neighborhood']) && trim((string)$addressData['shipping_neighborhood']) !== ''
            ? trim((string)$addressData['shipping_neighborhood'])
            : (isset($addressData['neighborhood']) && trim((string)$addressData['neighborhood']) !== '' ? trim((string)$addressData['neighborhood']) : null);

        $city = isset($addressData['shipping_city']) && trim((string)$addressData['shipping_city']) !== ''
            ? trim((string)$addressData['shipping_city'])
            : (isset($addressData['city']) && trim((string)$addressData['city']) !== '' ? trim((string)$addressData['city']) : null);

        $state = isset($addressData['shipping_state']) && trim((string)$addressData['shipping_state']) !== ''
            ? strtoupper(trim((string)$addressData['shipping_state']))
            : (isset($addressData['state']) && trim((string)$addressData['state']) !== '' ? strtoupper(trim((string)$addressData['state'])) : null);

        $phone = isset($addressData['phone']) && trim((string)$addressData['phone']) !== ''
            ? trim((string)$addressData['phone'])
            : (isset($addressData['payer_phone']) && trim((string)$addressData['payer_phone']) !== '' ? trim((string)$addressData['payer_phone']) : null);

        $cpf = isset($addressData['cpf']) && trim((string)$addressData['cpf']) !== ''
            ? trim((string)$addressData['cpf'])
            : (isset($addressData['payer_cpf']) && trim((string)$addressData['payer_cpf']) !== '' ? trim((string)$addressData['payer_cpf']) : null);

        $payloadJson = json_encode([
            'zip'          => $zip,
            'street'       => $address,
            'number'       => $number,
            'complement'   => $complement,
            'neighborhood' => $neighborhood,
            'city'         => $city,
            'state'        => $state,
            'phone'        => $phone,
            'cpf'          => $cpf,
        ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

        $sql = "
            UPDATE domain_drop_customers
            SET shipping_zip = :shipping_zip,
                shipping_address = :shipping_address,
                shipping_number = :shipping_number,
                shipping_complement = :shipping_complement,
                shipping_neighborhood = :shipping_neighborhood,
                shipping_city = :shipping_city,
                shipping_state = :shipping_state,
                default_shipping_address = :default_shipping_address,
                updated_at = :updated_at
        ";

        $params = [
            ':shipping_zip'             => $zip,
            ':shipping_address'         => $address,
            ':shipping_number'          => $number,
            ':shipping_complement'      => $complement,
            ':shipping_neighborhood'    => $neighborhood,
            ':shipping_city'            => $city,
            ':shipping_state'           => $state,
            ':default_shipping_address' => $payloadJson,
            ':updated_at'               => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            ':id'                       => $id,
        ];

        if ($phone !== null) {
            $sql .= ", phone = :phone";
            $params[':phone'] = $phone;
        }
        if ($cpf !== null) {
            $sql .= ", cpf = :cpf";
            $params[':cpf'] = $cpf;
        }

        $sql .= " WHERE id = :id";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function updateProfile(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        $fields = [];
        $params = [':id' => $id, ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')];

        if (isset($data['name']) && trim((string)$data['name']) !== '') {
            $fields[] = 'name = :name';
            $params[':name'] = trim((string)$data['name']);
        }
        if (isset($data['phone'])) {
            $fields[] = 'phone = :phone';
            $params[':phone'] = trim((string)$data['phone']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['phone']) : null;
        }
        if (isset($data['cpf'])) {
            $fields[] = 'cpf = :cpf';
            $params[':cpf'] = trim((string)$data['cpf']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['cpf']) : null;
        }
        if (isset($data['shipping_zip'])) {
            $fields[] = 'shipping_zip = :shipping_zip';
            $params[':shipping_zip'] = trim((string)$data['shipping_zip']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_zip']) : null;
        }
        if (isset($data['shipping_address'])) {
            $fields[] = 'shipping_address = :shipping_address';
            $params[':shipping_address'] = trim((string)$data['shipping_address']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_address']) : null;
        }
        if (isset($data['shipping_number'])) {
            $fields[] = 'shipping_number = :shipping_number';
            $params[':shipping_number'] = trim((string)$data['shipping_number']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_number']) : null;
        }
        if (isset($data['shipping_complement'])) {
            $fields[] = 'shipping_complement = :shipping_complement';
            $params[':shipping_complement'] = trim((string)$data['shipping_complement']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_complement']) : null;
        }
        if (isset($data['shipping_neighborhood'])) {
            $fields[] = 'shipping_neighborhood = :shipping_neighborhood';
            $params[':shipping_neighborhood'] = trim((string)$data['shipping_neighborhood']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_neighborhood']) : null;
        }
        if (isset($data['shipping_city'])) {
            $fields[] = 'shipping_city = :shipping_city';
            $params[':shipping_city'] = trim((string)$data['shipping_city']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['shipping_city']) : null;
        }
        if (isset($data['shipping_state'])) {
            $fields[] = 'shipping_state = :shipping_state';
            $params[':shipping_state'] = trim((string)$data['shipping_state']) !== '' ? strtoupper(trim((string)$data['shipping_state'])) : null;
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $fields[] = 'updated_at = :updated_at';
        $sql = "UPDATE domain_drop_customers SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = :id";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function saveAddressByEmail(string $email, array $addressData): bool
    {
        $customer = $this->findByEmail($email);
        if ($customer === null || empty($customer['id'])) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->updateAddress((int)$customer['id'], $addressData);
    }

    public function listAll(int $limit = 100, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_customers ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT " . max(1, (int)$limit) . " OFFSET " . max(0, (int)$offset)
        );
        $stmt->execute();
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return array_map([$this, 'hydrateCustomer'], $rows);
    }

    public function listCustomers(int $page = 1, int $perPage = 15, ?string $search = null, ?string $status = null): array
    {
        $page = max(1, $page);
        $perPage = max(1, min(100, $perPage));
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;

        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if ($status !== null && $status !== '' && $status !== 'all') {
            $where[] = 'c.status = :status';
            $params[':status'] = $status;
        }

        if ($search !== null && trim($search) !== '') {
            $q = '%' . strtolower(trim($search)) . '%';
            $where[] = '(LOWER(c.name) LIKE :q1 OR LOWER(c.email) LIKE :q2 OR LOWER(COALESCE(c.cpf, \'\')) LIKE :q3 OR LOWER(COALESCE(c.phone, \'\')) LIKE :q4)';
            $params[':q1'] = $q;
            $params[':q2'] = $q;
            $params[':q3'] = $q;
            $params[':q4'] = $q;
        }

        $whereSql = !empty($where) ? ('WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where)) : '';

        $countStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_customers c {$whereSql}");
        $countStmt->execute($params);
        $total = (int)$countStmt->fetchColumn();

        $sql = "
            SELECT
                c.*,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_orders o WHERE LOWER(o.customer_email) = LOWER(c.email)) AS orders_count,
                (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_paid_brl), 0) FROM domain_drop_orders o WHERE LOWER(o.customer_email) = LOWER(c.email)) AS total_spent_brl,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_disputes d WHERE LOWER(d.customer_email) = LOWER(c.email)) AS disputes_count
            FROM domain_drop_customers c
            {$whereSql}
            ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT {$perPage} OFFSET {$offset}
        ";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $items = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return [
            'items' => array_map([$this, 'hydrateCustomer'], $items),
            'total' => $total,
        ];
    }

    public function getCustomerMetrics(): array
    {
        $total = (int)$this->pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_customers")->fetchColumn();
        $active = (int)$this->pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_customers WHERE status = 'active'")->fetchColumn();
        $suspended = max(0, $total - $active);
        $linkedOrders = (int)$this->pdo->query("
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_orders o
            WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM domain_drop_customers c WHERE LOWER(c.email) = LOWER(o.customer_email))
        ")->fetchColumn();

        return [
            'total_customers'     => $total,
            'active_customers'    => $active,
            'suspended_customers' => $suspended,
            'linked_orders'       => $linkedOrders,
        ];
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $id, string $status): bool
    {
        $allowed = ['active', 'suspended', 'blocked'];
        $normalized = in_array($status, $allowed, true) ? $status : 'active';

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE domain_drop_customers
            SET status = :status, updated_at = :updated_at
            WHERE id = :id
        ");

        return $stmt->execute([
            ':status'     => $normalized,
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            ':id'         => $id,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Normaliza e decodifica campos estruturados do cliente.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $row
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function hydrateCustomer(array $row): array
    {
        $parsedAddress = null;
        if (!empty($row['default_shipping_address']) && is_string($row['default_shipping_address'])) {
            $decoded = @json_decode($row['default_shipping_address'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $parsedAddress = $decoded;
            }
        }

        if ($parsedAddress === null && (!empty($row['shipping_zip']) || !empty($row['shipping_address']))) {
            $parsedAddress = [
                'zip'          => $row['shipping_zip'] ?? null,
                'street'       => $row['shipping_address'] ?? null,
                'number'       => $row['shipping_number'] ?? null,
                'complement'   => $row['shipping_complement'] ?? null,
                'neighborhood' => $row['shipping_neighborhood'] ?? null,
                'city'         => $row['shipping_city'] ?? null,
                'state'        => $row['shipping_state'] ?? null,
                'phone'        => $row['phone'] ?? null,
                'cpf'          => $row['cpf'] ?? null,
            ];
        }

        $row['parsed_shipping_address'] = $parsedAddress;
        return $row;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Repositories/PdoDropshipDisputeRepository.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para reclamações e intermediações com fornecedores.
 */
class PdoDropshipDisputeRepository implements DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(PDO|DatabaseConnectionInterface $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
        DomainDropSchemaEnsurer::ensure($this->pdo);
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $attachments = $data['attachments_json'] ?? [];
        if (is_array($attachments)) {
            $attachmentsJson = json_encode(array_values($attachments), JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?: '[]';
        } else {
            $attachmentsJson = (string)$attachments;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO domain_drop_disputes (
                order_ref, customer_id, customer_email, reason, description,
                attachments_json, seller_origin, seller_name, seller_email,
                seller_language, translated_message, mediation_status,
                mediation_channel, mediation_sent_at, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :order_ref, :customer_id, :customer_email, :reason, :description,
                :attachments_json, :seller_origin, :seller_name, :seller_email,
                :seller_language, :translated_message, :mediation_status,
                :mediation_channel, :mediation_sent_at, :created_at, :updated_at
            )
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            ':order_ref'          => (string)($data['order_ref'] ?? ''),
            ':customer_id'        => isset($data['customer_id']) ? (int)$data['customer_id'] : null,
            ':customer_email'     => strtolower(trim((string)($data['customer_email'] ?? ''))),
            ':reason'             => (string)($data['reason'] ?? 'produto_danificado'),
            ':description'        => trim((string)($data['description'] ?? '')),
            ':attachments_json'   => $attachmentsJson,
            ':seller_origin'      => strtoupper((string)($data['seller_origin'] ?? 'CN')),
            ':seller_name'        => isset($data['seller_name']) ? (string)$data['seller_name'] : null,
            ':seller_email'       => isset($data['seller_email']) ? (string)$data['seller_email'] : null,
            ':seller_language'    => isset($data['seller_language']) ? (string)$data['seller_language'] : null,
            ':translated_message' => isset($data['translated_message']) ? (string)$data['translated_message'] : null,
            ':mediation_status'   => (string)($data['mediation_status'] ?? 'open'),
            ':mediation_channel'  => isset($data['mediation_channel']) ? (string)$data['mediation_channel'] : null,
            ':mediation_sent_at'  => isset($data['mediation_sent_at']) ? (string)$data['mediation_sent_at'] : null,
            ':created_at'         => (string)($data['created_at'] ?? $now),
            ':updated_at'         => (string)($data['updated_at'] ?? $now),
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->decodeRow($row) : null;
    }

    public function findByOrderRef(string $orderRef): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes WHERE order_ref = :ref ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC");
        $stmt->execute([':ref' => $orderRef]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return array_map([$this, 'decodeRow'], $rows);
    }

    public function findByCustomerEmail(string $email): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes WHERE LOWER(customer_email) = :email ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC");
        $stmt->execute([':email' => strtolower(trim($email))]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return array_map([$this, 'decodeRow'], $rows);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function listRecent(int $limit = 30): array
    {
        $lim = max(1, min(100, $limit));
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT {$lim}");
        $rows = $stmt !== false ? ($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: []) : [];

        return array_map([$this, 'decodeRow'], $rows);
    }

    public function mapByOrderRefs(array $orderRefs): array
    {
        $refs = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('strval', $orderRefs))));
        if ($refs === []) {
            return [];
        }

        $placeholders = implode(', ', array_fill(0, count($refs), '?'));
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes WHERE order_ref IN ($placeholders) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC");
        $stmt->execute($refs);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        $grouped = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $decoded = $this->decodeRow($row);
            $ref = (string)($decoded['order_ref'] ?? '');
            if ($ref !== '') {
                $grouped[$ref][] = $decoded;
            }
        }

        return $grouped;
    }

    public function markMediationSent(
        int $disputeId,
        string $sellerLanguage,
        string $translatedMessage,
        string $channel = 'email'
    ): bool {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE domain_drop_disputes
            SET seller_language = :lang,
                translated_message = :msg,
                mediation_status = 'sent',
                mediation_channel = :channel,
                mediation_sent_at = :sent_at,
                updated_at = :updated_at
            WHERE id = :id
        ");

        return $stmt->execute([
            ':lang'       => $sellerLanguage,
            ':msg'        => $translatedMessage,
            ':channel'    => $channel,
            ':sent_at'    => $now,
            ':updated_at' => $now,
            ':id'         => $disputeId,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $row
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function decodeRow(array $row): array
    {
        $raw = (string)($row['attachments_json'] ?? '[]');
        $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
        $row['attachments'] = is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];

        return $row;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Repositories/PdoDropshipOrderRepository.php
