<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para Ordens de Dropshipping (SRP / DIP).
 */
class PdoDropshipOrderRepository implements DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    /** @var array<int, string>|null */
    private ?array $tableColumns = null;

    public function __construct(PDO|DatabaseConnectionInterface $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
        DomainDropSchemaEnsurer::ensure($this->pdo);
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $createdAt = (string)($data['created_at'] ?? $now);
        $updatedAt = (string)($data['updated_at'] ?? $createdAt);

        $columns = [
            'order_ref',
            'customer_name',
            'customer_email',
            'customer_document',
            'shipping_address',
            'aliexpress_order_id',
            'tracking_code',
            'status',
            'total_paid_brl',
            'created_at',
            'updated_at',
        ];

        $params = [
            ':order_ref'           => (string)($data['order_ref'] ?? uniqid('ORD_DROP_')),
            ':customer_name'       => (string)($data['customer_name'] ?? 'Cliente'),
            ':customer_email'      => strtolower(trim((string)($data['customer_email'] ?? ''))),
            ':customer_document'   => isset($data['customer_document']) ? (string)$data['customer_document'] : null,
            ':shipping_address'    => isset($data['shipping_address'])
                ? (is_array($data['shipping_address']) ? json_encode($data['shipping_address'], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) : (string)$data['shipping_address'])
                : null,
            ':aliexpress_order_id' => isset($data['aliexpress_order_id']) ? (string)$data['aliexpress_order_id'] : null,
            ':tracking_code'       => isset($data['tracking_code']) ? (string)$data['tracking_code'] : null,
            ':status'              => (string)($data['status'] ?? 'pending'),
            ':total_paid_brl'      => (float)($data['total_paid_brl'] ?? 0.0),
            ':created_at'          => $createdAt,
            ':updated_at'          => $updatedAt,
        ];

        $optionalMap = [
            'seller_origin'          => strtoupper((string)($data['seller_origin'] ?? 'BR')),
            'seller_name'            => isset($data['seller_name']) ? (string)$data['seller_name'] : null,
            'seller_email'           => isset($data['seller_email']) ? (string)$data['seller_email'] : null,
            'expected_delivery_days' => isset($data['expected_delivery_days']) ? max(1, (int)$data['expected_delivery_days']) : 7,
            'sdk_delivered_at'       => isset($data['sdk_delivered_at']) ? (string)$data['sdk_delivered_at'] : null,
            'sdk_tracking_summary'   => isset($data['sdk_tracking_summary']) ? (string)$data['sdk_tracking_summary'] : null,
            'product_slug'           => isset($data['product_slug']) ? (string)$data['product_slug'] : null,
            'product_title'          => isset($data['product_title']) ? (string)$data['product_title'] : null,
            'aliexpress_product_id'  => isset($data['aliexpress_product_id']) ? (string)$data['aliexpress_product_id'] : null,
        ];

        $existingCols = $this->getTableColumns();
        foreach ($optionalMap as $col => $val) {
            if (in_array($col, $existingCols, true)) {
                $columns[] = $col;
                $params[':' . $col] = $val;
            }
        }

        $placeholders = array_map(static fn (string $c): string => ':' . $c, $columns);
        $sql = 'INSERT INTO domain_drop_orders (' . implode(', ', $columns) . ') VALUES (' . implode(', ', $placeholders) . ')';

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findByOrderRef(string $orderRef): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_orders WHERE order_ref = :ref LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':ref' => $orderRef]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function findByCustomerEmail(string $email, int $limit = 50): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_orders WHERE LOWER(customer_email) = :email ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT " . max(1, (int)$limit)
        );
        $stmt->execute([':email' => strtolower(trim($email))]);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function updateFulfillment(string $orderRef, string $status, ?string $aliExpressOrderId = null, ?string $trackingCode = null): bool
    {
        $fields = ['status = :status', 'updated_at = :updated_at'];
        $params = [
            ':ref'        => $orderRef,
            ':status'     => $status,
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ];

        if ($aliExpressOrderId !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'aliexpress_order_id = :ae_id';
            $params[':ae_id'] = $aliExpressOrderId;
        }

        if ($trackingCode !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'tracking_code = :track';
            $params[':track'] = $trackingCode;
        }

        if ($status === 'delivered' && in_array('sdk_delivered_at', $this->getTableColumns(), true)) {
            $fields[] = 'sdk_delivered_at = COALESCE(sdk_delivered_at, :delivered_at)';
            $params[':delivered_at'] = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE domain_drop_orders SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE order_ref = :ref";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function updateSellerAndSla(
        string $orderRef,
        string $sellerOrigin,
        int $expectedDays,
        ?string $sellerName = null,
        ?string $sellerEmail = null
    ): bool {
        $existingCols = $this->getTableColumns();
        if (!in_array('seller_origin', $existingCols, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        $fields = [
            'seller_origin = :origin',
            'expected_delivery_days = :days',
            'updated_at = :updated_at',
        ];
        $params = [
            ':ref'        => $orderRef,
            ':origin'     => strtoupper($sellerOrigin) === 'CN' ? 'CN' : 'BR',
            ':days'       => max(1, min(90, $expectedDays)),
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ];

        if ($sellerName !== null && in_array('seller_name', $existingCols, true)) {
            $fields[] = 'seller_name = :sname';
            $params[':sname'] = $sellerName;
        }
        if ($sellerEmail !== null && in_array('seller_email', $existingCols, true)) {
            $fields[] = 'seller_email = :semail';
            $params[':semail'] = $sellerEmail;
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE domain_drop_orders SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE order_ref = :ref";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function updateSdkTracking(
        string $orderRef,
        ?string $sdkDeliveredAt,
        ?string $summaryJson,
        ?string $newStatus = null
    ): bool {
        $existingCols = $this->getTableColumns();
        $fields = ['updated_at = :updated_at'];
        $params = [
            ':ref'        => $orderRef,
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ];

        if (in_array('sdk_delivered_at', $existingCols, true) && $sdkDeliveredAt !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'sdk_delivered_at = :delivered_at';
            $params[':delivered_at'] = $sdkDeliveredAt;
        }
        if (in_array('sdk_tracking_summary', $existingCols, true) && $summaryJson !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'sdk_tracking_summary = :summary';
            $params[':summary'] = $summaryJson;
        }
        if ($newStatus !== null && $newStatus !== '') {
            $fields[] = 'status = :status';
            $params[':status'] = $newStatus;
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE domain_drop_orders SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE order_ref = :ref";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function list(array $filters = [], int $limit = 50, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($filters['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = :st";
            $params[':st'] = (string)$filters['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($filters['search'])) {
            $term = '%' . (string)$filters['search'] . '%';
            $where[] = "(order_ref LIKE :q1 OR customer_name LIKE :q2 OR customer_email LIKE :q3 OR tracking_code LIKE :q4)";
            $params[':q1'] = $term;
            $params[':q2'] = $term;
            $params[':q3'] = $term;
            $params[':q4'] = $term;
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_orders";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(' AND ', $where);
        }
        $limit = max(1, (int)$limit);
        $offset = max(0, (int)$offset);
        $sql .= " ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT {$limit} OFFSET {$offset}";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function getTableColumns(): array
    {
        if ($this->tableColumns !== null) {
            return $this->tableColumns;
        }

        try {
            $driver = (string)$this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
            if ($driver === 'mysql') {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM domain_drop_orders");
                $this->tableColumns = $stmt ? array_column($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'Field') : [];
            } else {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->query("PRAGMA table_info(domain_drop_orders)");
                $this->tableColumns = $stmt ? array_column($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'name') : [];
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->tableColumns = [];
        }

        return $this->tableColumns;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/AiProductEnricherService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AiProductEnricherInterface;

/**
 * Motor de Higienização de Títulos e Copywriting de Produtos (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Transforma os textos poluídos e genéricos do AliExpress em páginas de produtos
 * profissionais, com títulos concisos e descrições orientadas à conversão (AIDA).
 */
class AiProductEnricherService implements AiProductEnricherInterface
{
    /**
     * Palavras e termos de spam frequentemente encontrados em anúncios brutos da China.
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    private array $spamKeywords = [
        '2024', '2025', '2026', 'novo', 'nova', 'novos', 'novas',
        'quente', 'venda', 'promoção', 'barato', 'frete grátis',
        'alta qualidade', 'top', 'luxo', 'moda', 'marca', 'original',
        'atacado', 'china', 'direto da fábrica', 'melhor preço', 'aliexpress',
        'hot sale', 'new', 'luxury', 'free shipping', 'drop shipping', 'dropshipping', 'dropship',
    ];

    public function polishTitle(string $rawTitle, ?string $category = null): string
    {
        $clean = trim($rawTitle);

        // 1. Remove termos de spam comuns
        foreach ($this->spamKeywords as $spam) {
            $pattern = '/\b' . preg_quote($spam, '/') . '\b/iu';
            $clean = (string)preg_replace($pattern, '', $clean);
        }

        // 2. Remove caracteres estranhos repetidos (ex: |||, ***, ---, [ ])
        $clean = (string)preg_replace('/[\[\]\|\*\#\_]+/', ' ', $clean);
        $clean = (string)preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $clean);
        $clean = trim($clean, " -.,:;\t\n\r\0\x0B");

        // 3. Limita o tamanho do título para 65-80 caracteres (ideal para SEO e e-commerce)
        $words = explode(' ', $clean);
        if (count($words) > 10) {
            $words = array_slice($words, 0, 10);
            $clean = implode(' ', $words);
        }

        // 4. Formata com inicial maiúscula elegante
        $clean = mb_convert_case($clean, MB_CASE_TITLE, 'UTF-8');

        if ($clean === '' && $category !== null) {
            return "Produto Premium - {$category}";
        }

        return $clean !== '' ? $clean : 'Produto Importado Exclusivo';
    }

    public function generateSalesCopy(string $rawDescription, array $attributes = []): string
    {
        $cleanText = strip_tags($rawDescription);
        $cleanText = (string)preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $cleanText);
        $summary = mb_substr(trim($cleanText), 0, 320);

        $specsHtml = '';
        if (!empty($attributes)) {
            $ignoredKeys = [
                'curadoria_nota', 'termometro_demanda', 'ship_from', 'origem_brasil',
                'vendas_informadas', 'variants', 'variation_axes', 'properties', 'seller_id',
                'shop_id', 'seller_name', 'store_name'
            ];

            $lis = [];
            $hasWeight = false;

            foreach ($attributes as $k => $v) {
                $kStr = trim((string)$k);
                $kLower = strtolower($kStr);
                if (in_array($kLower, $ignoredKeys, true)) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (is_scalar($v) && trim((string)$v) !== '') {
                    if (preg_match('/(?:peso|weight)/i', $kStr)) {
                        $hasWeight = true;
                    }
                    $lis[] = '<li><strong>' . htmlspecialchars($kStr) . ':</strong> ' . htmlspecialchars((string)$v) . '</li>';
                }
            }

            if (!$hasWeight) {
                $rawWeight = (string)($attributes['weight'] ?? ($attributes['peso'] ?? ''));
                if ($rawWeight === '') {
                    $rawWeight = '200g (Envio Leve até 300g)';
                }
                $lis[] = '<li><strong>Peso Estimado:</strong> ' . htmlspecialchars($rawWeight) . '</li>';
            }

            $isNational = !empty($attributes['origem_brasil']) || (($attributes['ship_from'] ?? '') === 'BR');
            $lis[] = $isNational
                ? '<li><strong>Origem do Envio:</strong> Estoque Nacional (Brasil) 🇧🇷</li>'
                : '<li><strong>Origem do Envio:</strong> Importação Oficial com Rastreio 🌐</li>';

            if (!empty($lis)) {
                $specsHtml .= '<div style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">';
                $specsHtml .= '<h4 style="margin-top:0; color:#45f3ff; font-size:14px; text-transform:uppercase;">📐 Especificações Técnicas</h4>';
                $specsHtml .= '<ul style="margin:0; padding-left:20px; font-size:13px; color:#cbd5e1; line-height:1.7;">';
                $specsHtml .= implode("\n", $lis);
                $specsHtml .= '</ul></div>';
            }
        }

        return <<<HTML
<div class="domain-drop-product-description" style="font-size:14px; line-height:1.7; color:var(--text-main, #cbd5e1);">
    <p style="font-size:15px; font-weight:500; color:#fff; margin-bottom:16px;">
        {$summary}...
    </p>

    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap:12px; margin:20px 0;">
        <div style="background:rgba(0,210,132,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(0,210,132,0.3); border-radius:6px; padding:12px;">
            <strong style="color:#00d284; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">✨ Qualidade Comprovada</strong>
            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Item selecionado entre os mais bem avaliados do catálogo internacional.</span>
        </div>
        <div style="background:rgba(69,243,255,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); border-radius:6px; padding:12px;">
            <strong style="color:#45f3ff; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">🚚 Envio com Rastreio</strong>
            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Código de rastreamento enviado automaticamente no seu WhatsApp e E-mail.</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    {$specsHtml}
</div>
HTML;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/AliExpressApiClient.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressApiClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Exceptions\AliExpressApiException;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Cliente Oficial de Comunicação com a AliExpress Open Platform API (DIP / SOLID).
 * 
 * Implementa o protocolo de assinatura criptográfica oficial HMAC-SHA256 (IOP Protocol),
 * compatível com o gateway internacional: https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync.
 */
class AliExpressApiClient implements AliExpressApiClientInterface
{
    private string $appKey;
    private string $appSecret;
    private string $gatewayUrl;
    private int $timeout;
    private string $sdkVersion = 'iop-sdk-php-20220608';
    private ?string $lastError = null;

    public function __construct(
        string $appKey,
        string $appSecret,
        string $gatewayUrl = 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync',
        int $timeout = 15,
        private ?string $accessToken = null
    ) {
        $this->appKey = trim($appKey);
        $this->appSecret = trim($appSecret);
        $this->gatewayUrl = rtrim($gatewayUrl, '/');
        $this->timeout = $timeout;
    }

    public function getLastError(): ?string
    {
        return $this->lastError;
    }

    public function execute(string $apiMethod, array $params = [], ?string $accessToken = null): array
    {
        if ($this->appKey === '' || $this->appSecret === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('[AliExpressApiClient] AppKey ou AppSecret não configurados no DomainDrop.');
        }

        $token = $accessToken ?? $this->accessToken;

        $sysParams = [
            'app_key'     => $this->appKey,
            'sign_method' => 'sha256',
            'timestamp'   => $this->getMillisecondTimestamp(),
            'method'      => $apiMethod,
            'partner_id'  => $this->sdkVersion,
            'format'      => 'json',
            'simplify'    => 'true',
            'v'           => '2.0',
        ];

        if ($token !== null && $token !== '') {
            $sysParams['session'] = $token;
        }

        // Filtra parâmetros nulos ou de string vazia para manter paridade exata com o cálculo de assinatura IOP
        $cleanParams = [];
        foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
            if ($v !== null && $v !== '') {
                $cleanParams[$k] = (string)$v;
            }
        }

        // Combina parâmetros de sistema e de API para cálculo da assinatura
        $allParams = array_merge($cleanParams, $sysParams);
        $sysParams['sign'] = $this->generateSignature($apiMethod, $allParams);

        // Monta a Query String dos parâmetros de sistema
        $requestUrl = $this->gatewayUrl . '?' . http_build_query($sysParams);

        return $this->sendHttpRequest($requestUrl, $cleanParams);
    }

    public function getOAuthAuthorizeUrl(string $redirectUri, string $state = ''): string
    {
        $query = [
            'response_type' => 'code',
            'force_auth'    => 'true',
            'redirect_uri'  => $redirectUri,
            'client_id'     => $this->appKey,
        ];
        if ($state !== '') {
            $query['state'] = $state;
        }
        return 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/oauth/authorize?' . http_build_query($query);
    }

    /**
     * Troca o código OAuth (`code`) pelo `access_token` e `refresh_token` via `/rest/auth/token/create`.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function createAccessToken(string $code): array
    {
        $raw = $this->executeRest('/auth/token/create', ['code' => trim($code)]);
        $unwrapped = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($raw);
        return array_merge($raw, $unwrapped);
    }

    /**
     * Renova o `access_token` usando o `refresh_token` via `/rest/auth/token/refresh`.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function refreshAccessToken(string $refreshToken): array
    {
        $raw = $this->executeRest('/auth/token/refresh', ['refresh_token' => trim($refreshToken)]);
        $unwrapped = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($raw);
        return array_merge($raw, $unwrapped);
    }

    /**
     * Executa chamada IOP System/Auth (`/rest/...`), onde o caminho da API é incluído no cálculo HMAC-SHA256.
     * Segue estritamente a especificação oficial do AliExpress IOP SDK (IopClient).
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $params
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function executeRest(string $apiPath, array $params = []): array
    {
        if ($this->appKey === '' || $this->appSecret === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('[AliExpressApiClient] AppKey ou AppSecret não configurados no DomainDrop.');
        }

        $cleanPath = '/' . ltrim($apiPath, '/');
        $cleanParams = [];
        foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
            if ($v !== null && $v !== '') {
                $cleanParams[$k] = (string)$v;
            }
        }

        $sysParams = [
            'app_key'     => $this->appKey,
            'sign_method' => 'sha256',
            'timestamp'   => $this->getMillisecondTimestamp(),
            'method'      => $cleanPath,
            'partner_id'  => $this->sdkVersion,
            'format'      => 'json',
            'simplify'    => 'false',
        ];

        $allParams = array_merge($cleanParams, $sysParams);
        $sysParams['sign'] = $this->generateSignature($cleanPath, $allParams);

        $restBase = str_ends_with($this->gatewayUrl, '/sync')
            ? substr($this->gatewayUrl, 0, -5) . '/rest'
            : (str_ends_with($this->gatewayUrl, '/rest') ? $this->gatewayUrl : 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/rest');

        $requestUrl = rtrim($restBase, '/') . '?' . http_build_query($sysParams);
        return $this->sendHttpRequest($requestUrl, $cleanParams);
    }

    public function getProductDetails(string|int $productId, string $targetLanguage = 'pt', string $targetCurrency = 'USD'): array
    {
        $numericId = (string)$productId;
        // Se for URL completa do AliExpress, extrai o ID numérico
        if (preg_match('/\/item\/(\d+)\.html/', $numericId, $matches)) {
            $numericId = $matches[1];
        }

        $params = [
            'product_id'      => $numericId,
            'target_language' => $targetLanguage,
            'target_currency' => $targetCurrency,
            'ship_to_country' => 'BR',
        ];

        return $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.product.get', $params, $this->accessToken);
    }

    /**
     * Realiza busca textual dropshipping oficial via aliexpress.ds.text.search (dropshiper.pdf páginas 39-41).
     * Não exige session token obrigatório.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $filters
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function textSearch(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $sort = (string)($filters['sort_by'] ?? ($filters['sort'] ?? 'orders,desc'));
        $mappedSort = match ($sort) {
            'min_price,asc', 'price_asc'   => 'min_price,asc',
            'min_price,desc', 'price_desc' => 'min_price,desc',
            'comments,desc', 'rating'      => 'comments,desc',
            default                        => 'orders,desc',
        };

        $params = [
            'local'       => (string)($filters['local'] ?? 'pt_BR'),
            'countryCode' => (string)($filters['country_code'] ?? ($filters['countryCode'] ?? ($filters['country'] ?? 'BR'))),
            'sortBy'      => $mappedSort,
            'pageSize'    => (string)($filters['page_size'] ?? ($filters['pageSize'] ?? '20')),
            'pageIndex'   => (string)($filters['page_index'] ?? ($filters['pageIndex'] ?? ($filters['page_no'] ?? '1'))),
            'currency'    => (string)($filters['currency'] ?? 'USD'),
        ];

        $keyword = trim((string)($filters['keyWord'] ?? ($filters['keyword'] ?? ($filters['query'] ?? ($filters['key_word'] ?? '')))));
        if ($keyword !== '') {
            $params['keyWord'] = $keyword;
        }

        $categoryId = $filters['categoryId'] ?? ($filters['category_id'] ?? ($filters['cate_id'] ?? null));
        if (!empty($categoryId)) {
            $params['categoryId'] = (string)$categoryId;
        }

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.text.search', $params, $this->accessToken);
            $this->lastError = null;
            return $response;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lastError = $e->getMessage();
            error_log("[AliExpressApiClient] textSearch falhou: " . $e->getMessage());
            return [];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Consulta lista de IDs de produtos mais vendidos no feed oficial de Dropshipping.
     * Endpoint oficial: aliexpress.ds.feed.itemids.get (dropshiper.pdf páginas 950-1010).
     *
     * @param string $feedName Nome do feed (padrão 'DS bestseller')
     * @param string|null $categoryId ID da categoria de primeiro nível no AliExpress
     * @param int $pageSize Quantidade de itens por página (máx. 200)
     * @param string|null $searchId Cursor de paginação retornado na busca anterior
     * @return array<string, mixed> Estrutura com 'products' (array de IDs), 'total' e 'search_id'
     */
    public function getFeedItemIds(string $feedName = 'DS bestseller', ?string $categoryId = null, int $pageSize = 50, ?string $searchId = null): array
    {
        $params = [
            'feed_name' => $feedName !== '' ? $feedName : 'DS bestseller',
            'page_size' => (string)min(max($pageSize, 1), 200),
        ];

        if ($categoryId !== null && trim((string)$categoryId) !== '') {
            $params['category_id'] = trim((string)$categoryId);
        }

        if ($searchId !== null && trim($searchId) !== '') {
            $params['search_id'] = trim($searchId);
        }

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.feed.itemids.get', $params, $this->accessToken);
            $this->lastError = null;

            $unwrapped = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($response);
            $result = $unwrapped['result'] ?? ($response['result'] ?? $unwrapped);

            $rawProducts = $result['products'] ?? [];
            if (is_string($rawProducts)) {
                $decoded = json_decode($rawProducts, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    $rawProducts = $decoded;
                }
            }

            return [
                'total'     => (int)($result['total'] ?? (is_array($rawProducts) ? count($rawProducts) : 0)),
                'products'  => is_array($rawProducts) ? $rawProducts : [],
                'search_id' => (string)($result['search_id'] ?? ''),
                'raw'       => $response,
            ];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lastError = $e->getMessage();
            error_log("[AliExpressApiClient] getFeedItemIds falhou: " . $e->getMessage());
            return [
                'total'     => 0,
                'products'  => [],
                'search_id' => '',
                'raw'       => [],
            ];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Consulta os nomes de feeds de recomendação e bestsellers disponíveis no AliExpress.
     * Endpoint oficial: aliexpress.ds.feedname.get (dropshiper.pdf).
     *
     * @return array<int, string> Lista de nomes de feeds oficiais disponíveis
     */
    public function getFeedNames(): array
    {
        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.feedname.get', [], $this->accessToken);
            $this->lastError = null;
            $unwrapped = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($response);
            $result = $unwrapped['result'] ?? ($response['result'] ?? $unwrapped);
            $feeds = $result['prompts'] ?? ($result['feed_names'] ?? ($result['feeds'] ?? []));
            if (is_array($feeds) && !empty($feeds)) {
                return array_values(array_filter(array_map('strval', $feeds)));
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lastError = $e->getMessage();
        }

        return ['DS bestseller', 'Top Ranking', 'Hot Products'];
    }

    public function searchProducts(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $hasTextQuery = !empty($filters['query']) || !empty($filters['keyword']) || !empty($filters['keyWord']) || !empty($filters['keywords']) || !empty($filters['search']);
        $hasCategoryId = !empty($filters['category_id']) || !empty($filters['categoryId']) || !empty($filters['cate_id']);

        if ($hasTextQuery || $hasCategoryId) {
            $textRes = $this->textSearch($filters);
            $unwrapped = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($textRes);
            $data = $unwrapped['data'] ?? ($textRes['data'] ?? ($unwrapped['result'] ?? ($textRes['result'] ?? [])));
            $rawProducts = $data['products'] ?? ($unwrapped['products'] ?? []);
            if (isset($rawProducts['traffic_product_d_t_o'])) {
                $products = $rawProducts['traffic_product_d_t_o'];
            } elseif (isset($rawProducts['product'])) {
                $products = $rawProducts['product'];
            } else {
                $products = $rawProducts;
            }

            if (is_array($products) && !empty($products)) {
                return $products;
            }
        }

        // Bestseller feed query oficial aliexpress.ds.feed.itemids.get (dropshiper.pdf)
        $catId = $filters['category_id'] ?? ($filters['categoryId'] ?? ($filters['cate_id'] ?? null));
        $feedName = (string)($filters['feed_name'] ?? 'DS bestseller');
        $pageSize = (int)($filters['page_size'] ?? ($filters['pageSize'] ?? 20));

        $feedRes = $this->getFeedItemIds($feedName, $catId ? (string)$catId : null, $pageSize);
        if (!empty($feedRes['products']) && is_array($feedRes['products'])) {
            $feedProducts = [];
            foreach (array_slice($feedRes['products'], 0, $pageSize) as $pId) {
                try {
                    $details = $this->getProductDetails((string)$pId, 'pt', 'USD');
                    $unwrappedDetails = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($details);
                    $productData = $unwrappedDetails['result'] ?? ($details['result'] ?? $unwrappedDetails);
                    if (!empty($productData) && is_array($productData)) {
                        $feedProducts[] = $productData;
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Isolamento gracioso
                }
            }
            if (!empty($feedProducts)) {
                return $feedProducts;
            }
        }

        $sort = (string)($filters['sort'] ?? 'volume_desc');
        $mappedSort = match ($sort) {
            'evaluate_rate_desc', 'rating' => 'DSRratingDesc',
            'price_asc'                    => 'priceAsc',
            'price_desc'                   => 'priceDesc',
            default                        => 'volumeDesc',
        };

        $params = [
            'feed_name'       => (string)($filters['feed_name'] ?? 'DS bestseller'),
            'target_language' => 'pt',
            'target_currency' => 'USD',
            'country'         => (string)($filters['country'] ?? ($filters['ship_to_country'] ?? 'BR')),
            'page_size'       => (string)($filters['page_size'] ?? '20'),
            'page_no'         => (string)($filters['page_no'] ?? '1'),
            'sort'            => $mappedSort,
        ];

        if (!empty($filters['category_id'])) {
            $params['category_id'] = (string)$filters['category_id'];
        }

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.recommend.feed.get', $params, $this->accessToken);
            $this->lastError = null;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lastError = $e->getMessage();
            error_log("[AliExpressApiClient] searchProducts falhou: " . $e->getMessage());
            return [];
        }

        // Normaliza diferentes formatos de payload do IOP SDK (feed ou busca de produtos)
        $products = $response['result']['products']['traffic_product_d_t_o']
            ?? ($response['result']['products']['product'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_ds_recommend_feed_get_response']['result']['products']['traffic_product_d_t_o'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_ds_recommend_feed_get_response']['result']['products'] ?? []);

        return is_array($products) ? $products : [];
    }

    public function queryTrackingInfo(
        string $logisticsNo,
        string $origin = 'ESCROW',
        string $outRef = '',
        string $serviceName = 'CAINIAO',
        string $toArea = 'BR'
    ): array {
        $logisticsNo = trim($logisticsNo);
        if ($logisticsNo === '' && trim($outRef) === '') {
            return [];
        }

        $params = [
            'logistics_no' => $logisticsNo,
            'origin'       => $origin !== '' ? $origin : 'ESCROW',
            'out_ref'      => trim($outRef),
            'service_name' => $serviceName !== '' ? $serviceName : 'CAINIAO',
            'to_area'      => $toArea !== '' ? strtoupper($toArea) : 'BR',
        ];

        $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.logistics.ds.trackinginfo.query', $params, $this->accessToken);

        $details = $response['result']['details']['details']
            ?? ($response['result']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['details']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['result']['details']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['result']['details'] ?? []);

        return [
            'official_website' => (string)($response['result']['official_website'] ?? $response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['official_website'] ?? ''),
            'details'          => is_array($details) ? $details : [],
            'raw'              => $response,
        ];
    }

    public function getOfficialCategories(int|string $categoryId = 0, string $language = 'pt', bool $forceRefresh = false): array
    {
        $langKey = strtolower(trim($language)) ?: 'pt';
        $cacheFile = dirname(__DIR__, 4) . '/storage/cache/aliexpress_categories_' . $langKey . '.json';

        if (!$forceRefresh && file_exists($cacheFile)) {
            $mtime = filemtime($cacheFile);
            // Cache oficial de 7 dias (categorias de e-commerce global são altamente estáveis)
            if ((time() - $mtime) < 604800) {
                $cached = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($cacheFile), true);
                if (is_array($cached) && !empty($cached)) {
                    return $cached;
                }
            }
        }

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.category.get', [
                'category_id' => (string)$categoryId,
                'language'    => $langKey,
            ]);

            $categories = $response['resp_result']['result']['categories']
                ?? ($response['result']['categories']
                ?? ($response['aliexpress_ds_category_get_response']['resp_result']['result']['categories'] ?? []));

            if (is_array($categories) && !empty($categories)) {
                $dir = dirname($cacheFile);
                if (!is_dir($dir)) {
                    mkdir($dir, 0777, true);
                }
                file_put_contents($cacheFile, json_encode($categories, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
                return $categories;
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Em caso de instabilidade na conexão, utiliza cache em disco se existir
            if (file_exists($cacheFile)) {
                $cached = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($cacheFile), true);
                if (is_array($cached) && !empty($cached)) {
                    return $cached;
                }
            }
        }

        return [];
    }

    public function getSkuAttributes(int|string $categoryId): array
    {
        $params = [
            'query_sku_attribute_info_request' => json_encode([
                'aliexpress_category_id' => (string)$categoryId,
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
        ];

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.solution.sku.attribute.query', $params, $this->accessToken);
            $this->lastError = null;
            $unwrapped = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($response);
            $res = $unwrapped['result'] ?? ($unwrapped['data'] ?? $unwrapped);
            return is_array($res) ? $res : [];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lastError = $e->getMessage();
            error_log("[AliExpressApiClient] getSkuAttributes falhou: " . $e->getMessage());
            return [];
        }
    }

    public function getProductEanCode(string $eanCode): array
    {
        $code = trim($eanCode);
        if ($code === '') {
            return [];
        }

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.product.eancode.info.query', ['ean_code' => $code], $this->accessToken);
            $this->lastError = null;
            $unwrapped = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($response);
            $res = $unwrapped['result'] ?? ($unwrapped['data'] ?? $unwrapped);
            return is_array($res) ? $res : [];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lastError = $e->getMessage();
            error_log("[AliExpressApiClient] getProductEanCode falhou: " . $e->getMessage());
            return [];
        }
    }

    public function queryProductInventory(int|string $productId): array
    {
        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.solution.product.inventory.query', ['product_id' => (string)$productId], $this->accessToken);
            $this->lastError = null;
            $unwrapped = \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($response);
            $res = $unwrapped['result'] ?? ($unwrapped['data'] ?? $unwrapped);
            return is_array($res) ? $res : [];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lastError = $e->getMessage();
            error_log("[AliExpressApiClient] queryProductInventory falhou: " . $e->getMessage());
            return [];
        }
    }

    public function updateBatchProductPrices(array $priceUpdates): array
    {
        if (empty($priceUpdates)) {
            return [];
        }

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.solution.batch.product.price.update', [
                'mutiple_product_update_list' => json_encode($priceUpdates, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            ], $this->accessToken);
            $this->lastError = null;
            return \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken::unwrapPayload($response);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lastError = $e->getMessage();
            error_log("[AliExpressApiClient] updateBatchProductPrices falhou: " . $e->getMessage());
            return [];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Algoritmo Oficial de Assinatura IOP da AliExpress Open Platform.
     * 1. Ordena parâmetros alfabeticamente por chave (ksort).
     * 2. Concatena chave e valor em string corrida.
     * 3. Calcula HMAC-SHA256 em maiúsculas usando o AppSecret.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $params
     */
    public function generateSignature(string $apiMethod, array $params): string
    {
        ksort($params);

        $stringToBeSigned = '';
        if (str_contains($apiMethod, '/')) {
            $stringToBeSigned .= $apiMethod;
        }

        foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
            if ($v !== null && $v !== '') {
                $stringToBeSigned .= "$k$v";
            }
        }

        return strtoupper(hash_hmac('sha256', $stringToBeSigned, $this->appSecret));
    }

    /**
     * Retorna o timestamp em milissegundos exigido pela AliExpress API.
     */
    private function getMillisecondTimestamp(): string
    {
        return (string)(int)(microtime(true) * 1000);
    }

    /**
     * Executa requisição HTTP segura via cURL com POST.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $postData
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function sendHttpRequest(string $url, array $postData = []): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($postData));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $this->timeout);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 5);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, $this->sdkVersion);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);

        $rawResponse = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $error = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        (new ApiUsageTracker())->recordRequest();

        if ($rawResponse === false) {
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[AliExpressApiClient] Falha na conexão com o gateway do AliExpress: {$error}", 0, 'CONNECTION_ERROR');
        }

        // 1. Validar Status HTTP primeiro (HTTP 2xx é sucesso HTTP)
        if ($httpCode < 200 || $httpCode >= 300) {
            $decodedErr = json_decode((string)$rawResponse, true);
            if (is_array($decodedErr)) {
                $errCode = (string)($decodedErr['code'] ?? ($decodedErr['error_response']['code'] ?? "HTTP_{$httpCode}"));
                $errMsg = (string)($decodedErr['message'] ?? ($decodedErr['error_response']['msg'] ?? 'Falha de resposta HTTP do gateway AliExpress.'));
                throw new AliExpressApiException("[AliExpress Gateway HTTP {$httpCode} - {$errCode}] {$errMsg}", $httpCode, $errCode);
            }
            throw new AliExpressApiException(
                "[AliExpress Gateway HTTP {$httpCode}] Falha de resposta HTTP do gateway AliExpress.",
                $httpCode,
                'HTTP_ERROR'
            );
        }

        // 2. Decodificar resposta JSON
        $decoded = json_decode((string)$rawResponse, true);

        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            // Se vier XML ou formato inesperado
            return [
                'raw_response' => (string)$rawResponse,
                'http_code'    => $httpCode,
            ];
        }

        // 3. Se o AliExpress retornar erro formal na resposta (formato TOP error_response ou IOP code)
        if (isset($decoded['error_response']) && is_array($decoded['error_response'])) {
            $err = $decoded['error_response'];
            $errCode = (string)($err['sub_code'] ?? ($err['code'] ?? 'API_ERROR'));
            $msg = (string)($err['sub_msg'] ?? ($err['msg'] ?? 'Erro desconhecido da AliExpress API'));
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[AliExpress Gateway Error: {$errCode}] {$msg}", 0, $errCode);
        }

        if (isset($decoded['code']) && (string)$decoded['code'] !== '0' && (string)$decoded['code'] !== '200') {
            $codeStr = (string)$decoded['code'];
            $msg = (string)($decoded['message'] ?? ($decoded['msg'] ?? ($decoded['sub_msg'] ?? 'Erro retornado pela AliExpress API')));
            $subCode = (string)($decoded['sub_code'] ?? $codeStr);
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[AliExpress Gateway Error: {$codeStr}] {$msg}", 0, $subCode);
        }

        return $decoded;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/AliExpressLinkScraperService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\CategoryTaxonomyInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductLinkScraperInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\ScrapedProductDto;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\CategoryTaxonomyService;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Motor de Scraping em Tempo Real para Links Oficiais do AliExpress (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Extrai diretamente do HTML da página pública:
 * - Imagem de capa oficial (og:image) em alta resolução
 * - Galeria completa de imagens Full HD (imagePathList)
 * - Título original do fornecedor
 * - Preço promocional em vigor (pdp_npi)
 */
class AliExpressLinkScraperService implements ProductLinkScraperInterface
{
    private CategoryTaxonomyInterface $taxonomy;

    public function __construct(?CategoryTaxonomyInterface $taxonomy = null)
    {
        $this->taxonomy = $taxonomy ?? new CategoryTaxonomyService();
    }
    public function canHandle(string $urlOrId): bool
    {
        $trim = trim($urlOrId);
        if (str_contains($trim, 'aliexpress.com') || str_contains($trim, 'aliexpress-media.com')) {
            return true;
        }

        // Verifica se é um ID numérico típico do AliExpress (10 a 20 dígitos)
        return (bool)preg_match('/^\d{10,20}$/', $trim);
    }

    public function scrape(string $urlOrId): ?ScrapedProductDto
    {
        $productId = $this->extractProductId($urlOrId);
        if ($productId === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $canonicalUrl = "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html?country=BR&locale=pt_BR&currency=BRL";
        $targetUrl = str_starts_with($urlOrId, 'http') ? $urlOrId : $canonicalUrl;

        try {
            $html = $this->fetchHtml($targetUrl);
            if ($html === null || strlen($html) < 200) {
                return null;
            }

            return $this->parseRawHtml($html, $targetUrl);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public function parseRawHtml(string $rawSource, string $sourceUrl = ''): ?ScrapedProductDto
    {
        if (trim($rawSource) === '') {
            return null;
        }

        // 1. Filtro de Link Morto / 404 / Página Desativada / Desafio Anti-Robô (Slider Captcha)
        if (stripos($rawSource, 'Página não encontrada') !== false 
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Page Not Found') !== false 
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Item no longer available') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Não conseguimos encontrar esta página') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Arraste o controle deslizante') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'controle deslizante para verificar') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'verificação garante acesso normal') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'sec.aliexpress.com') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'slide to verify') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'rgv587_flag') !== false
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        // 2. Extração do Product ID
        $productId = $this->extractProductId($sourceUrl);
        if ($productId === '') {
            if (preg_match('/(?:productId|itemId)["\']?\s*:\s*["\']?(\d{10,20})["\']?/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            } elseif (preg_match('/item\/(\d{10,20})\.html/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            } elseif (preg_match('/(\d{10,20})/', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            }
        }

        if ($productId === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $canonicalUrl = "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html";

        // 3. Extração do Título
        $title = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:title" content="([^"]+)"/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode(preg_replace('/\s*-\s*AliExpress.*$/i', '', $m[1]));
        } elseif (preg_match('/<title>([^<]+)<\/title>/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode(preg_replace('/\s*-\s*AliExpress.*$/i', '', $m[1]));
        } elseif (preg_match('/["\'](?:subject|title|productTitle)["\']\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode($m[1]);
        }

        if (empty($title) 
            || stripos($title, 'Página não encontrada') !== false 
            || stripos($title, 'Page Not Found') !== false
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        // 4. Extração da Imagem Principal
        $mainImage = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:image" content="([^"]+)"/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $mainImage = $this->cleanImageUrl($m[1]);
        }

        // 5. Extração da Galeria Completa (imagePathList ou regex de CDN)
        $gallery = [];
        if (preg_match('/"imagePathList":(\[[^\]]+\])/', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($m[1], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                foreach ($decoded as $img) {
                    $clean = $this->cleanImageUrl((string)$img);
                    if ($clean !== '' && !in_array($clean, $gallery, true)) {
                        $gallery[] = $clean;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Se imagePathList não veio ou veio vazio, busca todas as imagens do CDN no código
        if (empty($gallery)) {
            preg_match_all('/https?:\/\/(?:ae-pic-[a-z0-9\-]+\.aliexpress-media\.com|[a-z0-9\-]+\.alicdn\.com)\/kf\/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.(?:jpg|png|webp)/i', $rawSource, $allCdnImgs);
            if (!empty($allCdnImgs[0])) {
                foreach ($allCdnImgs[0] as $cdnImg) {
                    $clean = $this->cleanImageUrl($cdnImg);
                    if ($clean !== '' && !in_array($clean, $gallery, true)) {
                        $gallery[] = $clean;
                    }
                    if (count($gallery) >= 8) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($gallery) && !empty($mainImage)) {
            $gallery[] = $mainImage;
        }

        if (empty($mainImage) && !empty($gallery)) {
            $mainImage = $gallery[0];
        }

        if (empty($mainImage)) {
            return null;
        }

        // 6. Preço Real da Oferta / Promoção do Vendedor (BRL e USD)
        $costPriceBrl = 0.0;
        $costPriceUsd = 0.0;
        $decodedFull = urldecode($sourceUrl . ' ' . $rawSource);

        // Regex 1: Parâmetro oficial do AliExpress dis!MOEDA!original!promo (ex: dis!BRL!68.88!29.09)
        if (preg_match('/dis!([A-Z]{3})![0-9.]+!([0-9.]+)/i', $decodedFull, $pm)) {
            $currency = strtoupper($pm[1]);
            $promoVal = (float)$pm[2];
            if ($currency === 'BRL') {
                $costPriceBrl = $promoVal;
                $costPriceUsd = round($promoVal / 5.75, 2);
            } elseif ($currency === 'USD') {
                $costPriceUsd = $promoVal;
                $costPriceBrl = round($promoVal * 5.75, 2);
            }
        }

        // Regex 2: Formato de moeda explícita R$ (ex: "formatedAmount":"R$ 29,09" ou "R$ 44,77")
        if ($costPriceBrl <= 0.0 && preg_match('/["\'](?:formatedAmount|formattedPrice|formattedActivityPrice)["\']\s*:\s*["\'](?:R\$\s*)?([0-9.,]+)["\']/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
            $parsedNum = (float)str_replace(['.', ','], ['', '.'], $pm[1]);
            if ($parsedNum > 0.0) {
                $costPriceBrl = $parsedNum;
                $costPriceUsd = round($parsedNum / 5.75, 2);
            }
        }

        // Regex 3: Campos de preço do player de checkout do AliExpress Brasil
        if ($costPriceBrl <= 0.0 && preg_match('/["\'](?:actSkuCalPrice|minActivityAmount|actSkuMultiCurrencyCalPrice|app_sale_price)["\']\s*:\s*["\']?([0-9.]+)/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
            $val = (float)$pm[1];
            if ($val > 0.0) {
                $costPriceBrl = $val;
                $costPriceUsd = round($val / 5.75, 2);
            }
        }

        // Fallback defensivo caso o HTML não exponha valor explícito
        if ($costPriceBrl <= 0.0 && $costPriceUsd <= 0.0) {
            $costPriceBrl = 29.09;
            $costPriceUsd = 5.06;
        } elseif ($costPriceUsd <= 0.0 && $costPriceBrl > 0.0) {
            $costPriceUsd = round($costPriceBrl / 5.75, 2);
        }

        // 7. Métricas reais do anúncio (jamais inventar vendas ou notas fixas quando ausentes)
        $ordersCount = 0;
        $ordersCountKnown = false;
        if (preg_match('/"(?:tradeCount|orders_count)"\s*:\s*(\d+)/i', $rawSource, $om)) {
            $ordersCount = max(0, (int)$om[1]);
            $ordersCountKnown = true;
        } elseif (preg_match('/"formatTradeCount"\s*:\s*"([\d.,]+)"/i', $rawSource, $om)) {
            $ordersCount = max(0, (int)str_replace(['.', ','], '', $om[1]));
            $ordersCountKnown = true;
        } elseif (preg_match('/(\d[\d.]*)\s*\+?\s*(?:vendidos|orders|sold)\b/i', $rawSource, $om)) {
            $ordersCount = max(0, (int)str_replace(['.', ','], '', $om[1]));
            $ordersCountKnown = true;
        }

        $rating = 0.0;
        if (preg_match('/"(?:evarageStar|averageStar|ratingValue)"\s*:\s*"?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)"?/i', $rawSource, $rm)) {
            $parsedRating = (float)$rm[1];
            if ($parsedRating > 0.0 && $parsedRating <= 5.0) {
                $rating = round($parsedRating, 1);
            }
        }

        // 8. Categoria inferida
        $category = $this->inferCategory($title);

        $attributes = [
            'Origem'            => 'Importação Oficial AliExpress',
            'Envio'             => 'Rastreamento Internacional Expresso',
            'Vendas_Informadas' => $ordersCountKnown ? 'sim' : 'nao',
        ];

        // 8.1 Extrai matriz real de variações (skuPropertyList) do HTML/JSON do AliExpress
        $extractedSkuData = $this->extractSkuVariantsFromSource($rawSource, $productId, $costPriceUsd, $mainImage);
        if (!empty($extractedSkuData['variants'])) {
            $attributes['variation_axes'] = $extractedSkuData['variation_axes'];
            $attributes['variants'] = $extractedSkuData['variants'];
            if (!empty($extractedSkuData['variation_axes']['Tamanho'])) {
                $attributes['Tamanhos'] = implode(', ', $extractedSkuData['variation_axes']['Tamanho']);
            }
            if (!empty($extractedSkuData['variation_axes']['Cor'])) {
                $attributes['Cores'] = implode(', ', $extractedSkuData['variation_axes']['Cor']);
            }
        } else {
            // Se for vestuário / lingerie / moda íntima sem skuPropertyList no HTML, garante matriz padrão de Cor e Tamanho
            $isApparel = in_array($category, ['Moda Íntima, Lingeries & Pijamas', 'Roupa Íntima & Pijamas', 'Roupas, Bolsas & Calçados'], true)
                || preg_match('/\b(lingerie|sutiã|sutia|calcinha|vestido|biquini|body|camisola|pijama|robe|meia|cueca|espartilho)\b/iu', $title);
            if ($isApparel) {
                $colors = ['Preto', 'Vermelho', 'Branco'];
                $sizes = ['S (BR P)', 'M (BR M)', 'L (BR G)', 'XL (BR GG)'];
                $attributes['variation_axes'] = [
                    'Cor'     => $colors,
                    'Tamanho' => $sizes,
                ];
                $attributes['Cores'] = implode(', ', $colors);
                $attributes['Tamanhos'] = implode(', ', $sizes);

                $scrapedVariants = [];
                foreach ($colors as $cIdx => $color) {
                    $colorSlug = strtoupper($color);
                    foreach ($sizes as $sIdx => $size) {
                        $scrapedVariants[] = [
                            'sku_id'         => "{$productId}-{$colorSlug}-SIZE-{$sIdx}",
                            'sku_attr'       => '14:' . (200000180 + $cIdx) . ';5:10001406' . (4 + $sIdx),
                            'options'        => ['Cor' => $color, 'Tamanho' => $size],
                            'price_brl'      => round($costPriceUsd * 5.25 * 1.5, 2),
                            'cost_price_usd' => $costPriceUsd,
                            'image_url'      => $mainImage,
                            'stock'          => 50,
                        ];
                    }
                }
                $attributes['variants'] = $scrapedVariants;
            }
        }

        return new ScrapedProductDto(
            sourceId: $productId,
            sourceUrl: $canonicalUrl,
            rawTitle: $title !== '' ? $title : "Produto AliExpress {$productId}",
            mainImageUrl: $mainImage,
            galleryImages: $gallery,
            costPriceUsd: $costPriceUsd,
            category: $category,
            rating: $rating,
            ordersCount: $ordersCount,
            attributes: $attributes
        );
    }

    private function extractProductId(string $urlOrId): string
    {
        $str = trim($urlOrId);
        if (preg_match('/\/item\/(\d+)\.html/i', $str, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }
        if (preg_match('/(\d{10,20})/', $str, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }

        return '';
    }

    public function isProductAlive(string $urlOrId): bool
    {
        return $this->checkAvailability($urlOrId) === 'alive';
    }

    /**
     * Verifica a disponibilidade real do anúncio no AliExpress.
     * Retorna:
     * - 'not_found': HTTP 404/410, redirecionamento para página de erro ou HTML explícito de "Página não encontrada" / oferta encerrada.
     * - 'alive': Página respondeu 200 com conteúdo válido do produto.
     * - 'unknown': Erro de rede/timeout ou desafio anti-robô (captcha) — não permite confirmar que o anúncio morreu.
     */
    public function checkAvailability(string $urlOrId): string
    {
        $productId = $this->extractProductId($urlOrId);
        if ($productId === '') {
            return 'unknown';
        }

        $canonicalUrl = "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html?country=BR&locale=pt_BR&currency=BRL";
        $targetUrl = str_starts_with($urlOrId, 'http') ? $urlOrId : $canonicalUrl;

        $resp = $this->fetchResponseDetails($targetUrl);
        return $this->classifyHtmlAvailability(
            (string)($resp['body'] ?? ''),
            (int)($resp['http_code'] ?? 0),
            (string)($resp['effective_url'] ?? '')
        );
    }

    public function classifyHtmlAvailability(string $rawSource, int $httpCode = 200, string $effectiveUrl = ''): string
    {
        if (in_array($httpCode, [404, 410], true)) {
            return 'not_found';
        }

        $lowerUrl = strtolower($effectiveUrl);
        if ($lowerUrl !== '' && (
            str_contains($lowerUrl, 'notfound')
            || str_contains($lowerUrl, 'page-not-found')
            || str_contains($lowerUrl, 'item-not-found')
            || str_contains($lowerUrl, 'error/404')
        )) {
            return 'not_found';
        }

        if ($httpCode !== 200 || trim($rawSource) === '') {
            return 'unknown';
        }

        // Desafio anti-robô (Slider Captcha) -> não confirmar exclusão por falso positivo
        if (stripos($rawSource, 'Arraste o controle deslizante') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'controle deslizante para verificar') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'verificação garante acesso normal') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'sec.aliexpress.com') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'slide to verify') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'rgv587_flag') !== false
        ) {
            return 'unknown';
        }

        // Marcadores explícitos de página inexistente / promoção relâmpago encerrada / item removido
        $notFoundMarkers = [
            'Página não encontrada',
            'Page Not Found',
            'Não conseguimos encontrar esta página',
            'Item no longer available',
            'Sorry, this item is no longer available',
            'Desculpe, este item não está mais disponível',
            'Este produto não está mais disponível',
            'This item is no longer available',
        ];
        foreach ($notFoundMarkers as $marker) {
            if (stripos($rawSource, $marker) !== false) {
                return 'not_found';
            }
        }

        return 'alive';
    }

    private function isAllowedAliExpressUrl(string $url): bool
    {
        $parts = parse_url($url);
        if (!is_array($parts)) {
            return false;
        }
        $scheme = strtolower((string)($parts['scheme'] ?? ''));
        $host = strtolower((string)($parts['host'] ?? ''));
        if (!in_array($scheme, ['http', 'https'], true) || $host === '') {
            return false;
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)*aliexpress\.(?:com|us|ru)$/i', $host)) {
            return false;
        }
        // Bloqueia SSRF para IPs privados, loopback ou link-local/metadata
        $ips = @gethostbynamel($host);
        if (!is_array($ips) || empty($ips)) {
            return false;
        }
        foreach ($ips as $ip) {
            if (!filter_var($ip, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP, FILTER_FLAG_NO_PRIV_RANGE | FILTER_FLAG_NO_RES_RANGE)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function fetchHtml(string $url): ?string
    {
        $resp = $this->fetchResponseDetails($url);
        if (($resp['http_code'] ?? 0) !== 200) {
            return null;
        }
        $effectiveUrl = strtolower((string)($resp['effective_url'] ?? ''));
        if (str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'notfound') || str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'page-not-found') || str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'item-not-found')) {
            return null;
        }
        $body = $resp['body'] ?? null;
        return is_string($body) ? $body : null;
    }

    /**
     * @return array{http_code: int, effective_url: string, body: ?string}
     */
    private function fetchResponseDetails(string $url, int $redirectsLeft = 2): array
    {
        if (!$this->isAllowedAliExpressUrl($url)) {
            return ['http_code' => 0, 'effective_url' => $url, 'body' => null];
        }
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36');
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, false);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS, CURLPROTO_HTTP | CURLPROTO_HTTPS);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 4);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 3);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
            'Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
            'Accept-Language: pt-BR,pt;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
            'Cookie: aep_usuc_f=region=BR&site=bra&b_locale=pt_BR&c_tp=BRL; xman_us_f=x_locale=pt_BR; intl_locale=pt_BR;',
            'Cache-Control: no-cache',
            'Pragma: no-cache',
        ]);
        $html = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $effectiveUrl = (string)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL);
        $redirectUrl = (string)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_REDIRECT_URL);
        curl_close($ch);

        if (in_array($httpCode, [301, 302, 303, 307, 308], true) && $redirectUrl !== '') {
            $lowerRedirect = strtolower($redirectUrl);
            if (str_contains($lowerRedirect, 'notfound') || str_contains($lowerRedirect, 'page-not-found') || str_contains($lowerRedirect, 'item-not-found') || str_contains($lowerRedirect, 'error/404')) {
                return ['http_code' => 404, 'effective_url' => $redirectUrl, 'body' => null];
            }
            if ($redirectsLeft > 0 && $this->isAllowedAliExpressUrl($redirectUrl)) {
                return $this->fetchResponseDetails($redirectUrl, $redirectsLeft - 1);
            }
        }

        return [
            'http_code'     => $httpCode,
            'effective_url' => $effectiveUrl !== '' ? $effectiveUrl : $url,
            'body'          => is_string($html) ? $html : null,
        ];
    }

    private function cleanImageUrl(string $url): string
    {
        $url = trim($url);
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }
        if (str_starts_with($url, '//')) {
            $url = 'https:' . $url;
        }
        // Remove sufixos de thumbnails e redimensionamento como _80x80.jpg, _50x50.jpg, _.webp
        $url = (string)preg_replace('/_[0-9]+x[0-9]+\.(?:jpg|png|webp|jpeg)$/i', '', $url);
        $url = (string)preg_replace('/_\.(?:jpg|png|webp|jpeg)$/i', '', $url);

        return $url;
    }

    private function inferCategory(string $title): string
    {
        return $this->taxonomy->classifyFromText($title);
    }

    /**
     * Extrai eixos de variação e SKUs a partir do bloco JSON `skuPropertyList` embutido na página do AliExpress.
     *
     * @return array{variation_axes: array<string, array<int, string>>, variants: array<int, array<string, mixed>>}
     */
    private function extractSkuVariantsFromSource(
        string $rawSource,
        string $productId,
        float $costPriceUsd,
        string $mainImage
    ): array {
        $pos = strpos($rawSource, '"skuPropertyList"');
        if ($pos === false) {
            return ['variation_axes' => [], 'variants' => []];
        }

        $bracketStart = strpos($rawSource, '[', $pos);
        if ($bracketStart === false) {
            return ['variation_axes' => [], 'variants' => []];
        }

        // Extrai o array JSON balanceado de skuPropertyList
        $depth = 0;
        $inString = false;
        $escape = false;
        $len = strlen($rawSource);
        $endPos = null;
        $limit = min($len, $bracketStart + 250000);
        for ($i = $bracketStart; $i < $limit; $i++) {
            $ch = $rawSource[$i];
            if ($escape) {
                $escape = false;
                continue;
            }
            if ($ch === '\\' && $inString) {
                $escape = true;
                continue;
            }
            if ($ch === '"') {
                $inString = !$inString;
                continue;
            }
            if ($inString) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($ch === '[') {
                $depth++;
            } elseif ($ch === ']') {
                $depth--;
                if ($depth === 0) {
                    $endPos = $i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if ($endPos === null) {
            return ['variation_axes' => [], 'variants' => []];
        }

        $jsonSlice = substr($rawSource, $bracketStart, $endPos - $bracketStart + 1);
        $decoded = json_decode($jsonSlice, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded) || empty($decoded)) {
            return ['variation_axes' => [], 'variants' => []];
        }

        $axes = [];
        $axisEntries = [];
        foreach ($decoded as $prop) {
            if (!is_array($prop)) {
                continue;
            }
            $rawName = trim((string)($prop['skuPropertyName'] ?? ''));
            if ($rawName === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $lower = mb_strtolower($rawName, 'UTF-8');
            if ($lower === 'color' || $lower === 'colour') {
                $axisName = 'Cor';
            } elseif ($lower === 'size') {
                $axisName = 'Tamanho';
            } else {
                $axisName = $rawName;
            }

            // Ignora eixo puramente logístico "Ships From" / "Enviar de"
            if (in_array($lower, ['ships from', 'ship from', 'enviar de'], true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $propId = (string)($prop['skuPropertyId'] ?? '');
            $valuesList = is_array($prop['skuPropertyValues'] ?? null) ? $prop['skuPropertyValues'] : [];
            $entries = [];
            foreach ($valuesList as $val) {
                if (!is_array($val)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $label = trim((string)($val['propertyValueDisplayName'] ?? ($val['propertyValueName'] ?? '')));
                if ($label === '') {
                    continue;
                }
                $valId = (string)($val['propertyValueId'] ?? ($val['propertyValueIdLong'] ?? ''));
                $img = !empty($val['skuPropertyImagePath']) ? $this->cleanImageUrl((string)$val['skuPropertyImagePath']) : '';
                if (!isset($axes[$axisName])) {
                    $axes[$axisName] = [];
                }
                if (!in_array($label, $axes[$axisName], true)) {
                    $axes[$axisName][] = $label;
                }
                $entries[] = [
                    'axis'  => $axisName,
                    'label' => $label,
                    'attr'  => ($propId !== '' && $valId !== '') ? "{$propId}:{$valId}" : '',
                    'image' => $img,
                ];
            }

            if (!empty($entries)) {
                $axisEntries[] = $entries;
            }
        }

        if (empty($axisEntries)) {
            return ['variation_axes' => [], 'variants' => []];
        }

        // Produto cartesiano dos eixos (limitado a 64 SKUs)
        $combos = [[]];
        foreach ($axisEntries as $entries) {
            $next = [];
            foreach ($combos as $combo) {
                foreach ($entries as $entry) {
                    $next[] = array_merge($combo, [$entry]);
                    if (count($next) >= 64) {
                        break 2;
                    }
                }
            }
            $combos = $next;
        }

        $variants = [];
        $priceBrl = round($costPriceUsd * 5.25 * 1.5, 2);
        foreach ($combos as $idx => $combo) {
            $options = [];
            $attrParts = [];
            $variantImg = $mainImage;
            foreach ($combo as $item) {
                $options[$item['axis']] = $item['label'];
                if ($item['attr'] !== '') {
                    $attrParts[] = $item['attr'];
                }
                if ($item['image'] !== '') {
                    $variantImg = $item['image'];
                }
            }
            $variants[] = [
                'sku_id'         => "{$productId}-VAR-" . ($idx + 1),
                'sku_attr'       => implode(';', $attrParts),
                'options'        => $options,
                'price_brl'      => $priceBrl,
                'cost_price_usd' => $costPriceUsd,
                'image_url'      => $variantImg,
                'stock'          => 50,
            ];
        }

        return [
            'variation_axes' => $axes,
            'variants'       => $variants,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/ApiUsageTracker.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

/**
 * Rastreador de telemetria e consumo de cota mensal da AliExpress Open Platform (SRP).
 */
final class ApiUsageTracker
{
    private string $storageFile;
    private int $defaultMonthlyLimit;

    public function __construct(?string $basePath = null, int $defaultMonthlyLimit = 1000000)
    {
        $root = $basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4));
        $this->storageFile = $root . '/storage/cache/aliexpress_api_usage.json';
        $this->defaultMonthlyLimit = $defaultMonthlyLimit;
    }

    /**
     * Registra uma requisição disparada ao gateway do AliExpress.
     */
    public function recordRequest(): void
    {
        $stats = $this->loadStats();
        $currentMonth = date('Y-m');

        if (($stats['current_month'] ?? '') !== $currentMonth) {
            $stats['current_month'] = $currentMonth;
            $stats['requests_this_month'] = 0;
        }

        $stats['requests_this_month'] = (int)($stats['requests_this_month'] ?? 0) + 1;
        $stats['requests_total'] = (int)($stats['requests_total'] ?? 0) + 1;
        $stats['last_request_at'] = time();

        $this->saveStats($stats);
    }

    /**
     * Retorna os dados analíticos de consumo da cota e saúde de requisições.
     *
     * @return array{
     *     current_month: string,
     *     requests_this_month: int,
     *     monthly_quota_limit: int,
     *     percentage_used: float,
     *     percentage_available: float,
     *     requests_total: int,
     *     last_request_at: int|null
     * }
     */
    public function getUsageStats(): array
    {
        $stats = $this->loadStats();
        $currentMonth = date('Y-m');

        if (($stats['current_month'] ?? '') !== $currentMonth) {
            $stats['current_month'] = $currentMonth;
            $stats['requests_this_month'] = 0;
        }

        $used = (int)($stats['requests_this_month'] ?? 0);
        $limit = max(1, (int)($stats['monthly_quota_limit'] ?? $this->defaultMonthlyLimit));
        $percentageUsed = round(($used / $limit) * 100, 3);
        $percentageAvailable = max(0.0, round(100.0 - $percentageUsed, 3));

        return [
            'current_month'        => (string)$stats['current_month'],
            'requests_this_month'  => $used,
            'monthly_quota_limit'  => $limit,
            'percentage_used'      => $percentageUsed,
            'percentage_available' => $percentageAvailable,
            'requests_total'       => (int)($stats['requests_total'] ?? $used),
            'last_request_at'      => isset($stats['last_request_at']) ? (int)$stats['last_request_at'] : null,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function loadStats(): array
    {
        if (file_exists($this->storageFile)) {
            $raw = @file_get_contents($this->storageFile);
            if (is_string($raw) && $raw !== '') {
                $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    return $decoded;
                }
            }
        }

        return [
            'current_month'       => date('Y-m'),
            'requests_this_month' => 0,
            'monthly_quota_limit' => $this->defaultMonthlyLimit,
            'requests_total'      => 0,
            'last_request_at'     => null,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $stats
     */
    private function saveStats(array $stats): void
    {
        $dir = dirname($this->storageFile);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }
        @file_put_contents(
            $this->storageFile,
            json_encode($stats, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/AtomicConfigStorage.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

/**
 * Utilitário seguro para leitura e gravação atômica de configurações JSON com flock.
 * Previne corrupção de arquivos e race conditions em requisições paralelas.
 */
final class AtomicConfigStorage
{
    /**
     * Lê um arquivo JSON de forma segura com bloqueio compartilhado (LOCK_SH).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function read(string $filePath): array
    {
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            return [];
        }

        $fp = @fopen($filePath, 'rb');
        if (!$fp) {
            return [];
        }

        @flock($fp, LOCK_SH);
        $content = stream_get_contents($fp);
        @flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
        @fclose($fp);

        if (!is_string($content) || trim($content) === '') {
            return [];
        }

        $decoded = json_decode($content, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
    }

    /**
     * Grava um arquivo JSON de forma atômica através de arquivo temporário e rename com LOCK_EX.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public static function write(string $filePath, array $data): bool
    {
        $dir = dirname($filePath);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }

        $json = json_encode($data, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if ($json === false) {
            return false;
        }

        $tempFile = $filePath . '.' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.tmp';
        $fp = @fopen($tempFile, 'wb');
        if (!$fp) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!@flock($fp, LOCK_EX)) {
            @fclose($fp);
            @unlink($tempFile);
            return false;
        }

        $written = @fwrite($fp, $json);
        @fflush($fp);
        @flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
        @fclose($fp);

        if ($written === false || $written < strlen($json)) {
            @unlink($tempFile);
            return false;
        }

        if (!@rename($tempFile, $filePath)) {
            if (@copy($tempFile, $filePath)) {
                @unlink($tempFile);
                return true;
            }
            @unlink($tempFile);
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Executa uma transação de leitura, modificação e escrita atômica garantida por lock exclusivo.
     *
     * @param callable(array<string, mixed>): array<string, mixed> $modifier
     * @return array<string, mixed> O novo array resultante gravado.
     */
    public static function update(string $filePath, callable $modifier): array
    {
        $dir = dirname($filePath);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }

        $lockFile = $filePath . '.lock';
        $lockFp = @fopen($lockFile, 'c+');
        if ($lockFp) {
            @flock($lockFp, LOCK_EX);
        }

        try {
            $current = self::read($filePath);
            $updated = (array)$modifier($current);
            self::write($filePath, $updated);
            return $updated;
        } finally {
            if ($lockFp) {
                @flock($lockFp, LOCK_UN);
                @fclose($lockFp);
            }
        }
    }
}
