<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\CategoryTaxonomyInterface;

/**
 * Serviço de Taxonomia Canônica Oficial, Classificação Semântica e Filtros SQL (SOLID / SRP).
 * 
 * Totalmente alinhado às 548 categorias oficiais da AliExpress Open Platform (IOP SDK)
 * para produtos em território nacional brasileiro, sem invenção de termos.
 */
class CategoryTaxonomyService implements CategoryTaxonomyInterface
{
    // Categorias Oficiais alinhadas 1:1 com a AliExpress Open Platform
    public const CAT_TECH         = 'Eletrônicos & Telefonia';          // IDs 44, 509, 7
    public const CAT_SMARTWATCH   = 'Relógios & Smartwatches';          // ID 1511
    public const CAT_HOME         = 'Casa, Iluminação & Eletro';        // IDs 15, 39, 6, 13
    public const CAT_TOOLS        = 'Ferramentas & Utilidades';         // IDs 1420, 30
    public const CAT_BEAUTY       = 'Beleza, Saúde & Maquiagem';        // IDs 66, 660103
    public const CAT_PETS         = 'Pet Shop';                         // ID 100006664 (Casa e jardim)
    public const CAT_AUTO         = 'Peças & Acessórios Automotivos';   // IDs 34, 201355758
    public const CAT_FASHION      = 'Roupas, Bolsas & Calçados';        // IDs 200000345, 200000343, 1524, 322
    public const CAT_LINGERIE     = 'Roupa Íntima & Pijamas';           // ID 200574005 (feminina, masculina, pijamas)
    public const CAT_ADULT        = 'Novidades & Uso Especial';         // ID 200000532

    public function getCanonicalCategories(): array
    {
        return [
            self::CAT_TECH,
            self::CAT_SMARTWATCH,
            self::CAT_HOME,
            self::CAT_TOOLS,
            self::CAT_BEAUTY,
            self::CAT_PETS,
            self::CAT_AUTO,
            self::CAT_FASHION,
            self::CAT_LINGERIE,
            self::CAT_ADULT,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Retorna os IDs numéricos oficiais correspondentes na árvore de categorias da AliExpress Open Platform.
     * Alinhado a categoria-e-atributos.pdf e dropshiper.pdf.
     *
     * @param string $category

     */
    public function getAliExpressCategoryIds(string $category): array
    {
        $canonical = $this->normalizeCategory($category);
        return match ($canonical) {
            self::CAT_TECH       => [44, 509, 7],
            self::CAT_SMARTWATCH => [1511],
            self::CAT_HOME       => [15, 39, 6],
            self::CAT_TOOLS      => [1420, 30],
            self::CAT_BEAUTY     => [66],
            self::CAT_PETS       => [100006664, 15],
            self::CAT_AUTO       => [34],
            self::CAT_FASHION    => [200000345, 200000343, 1524, 322],
            self::CAT_LINGERIE   => [200574005],
            self::CAT_ADULT      => [200000532],
            default              => [44],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Retorna termos de busca otimizados em português para consulta no AliExpress.
     *
     * @param string $category
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function getAliExpressSearchKeywords(string $category): array
    {
        $canonical = $this->normalizeCategory($category);
        return match ($canonical) {
            self::CAT_TECH       => ['fone bluetooth tws', 'carregador turbo usb c', 'fone sem fio', 'power bank'],
            self::CAT_SMARTWATCH => ['smartwatch', 'relogio inteligente', 'pulseira smartwatch'],
            self::CAT_HOME       => ['fita led rgb', 'luminaria tuya inteligente', 'lampada inteligente wifi', 'aspirador portatil'],
            self::CAT_TOOLS      => ['alicate crimpador decapador', 'jogo chave precisao catraca', 'ferramentas reparo manual'],
            self::CAT_BEAUTY     => ['escova secadora modeladora', 'maquiagem paleta', 'barbeador eletrico recarregavel'],
            self::CAT_PETS       => ['coleira led cachorro', 'escova pelos pet gato cão', 'brinquedo interativo pet'],
            self::CAT_AUTO       => ['suporte celular veicular', 'acessorios carro suporte', 'led veicular automotivo'],
            self::CAT_FASHION    => ['mochila executiva impermeavel', 'tenis casual confortavel', 'bolsa transversal feminina'],
            self::CAT_LINGERIE   => ['lingerie renda sexy', 'sutia sem costura push up', 'pijama cetim seda'],
            self::CAT_ADULT      => ['massageador muscular eletrico', 'rolo massagem relaxamento'],
            default              => ['eletronicos'],
        };
    }

    public function normalizeCategory(string $category): string
    {
        $raw = trim($category);
        if ($raw === '') {
            return self::CAT_TECH;
        }

        $lower = mb_strtolower($raw, 'UTF-8');
        $clean = preg_replace('/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s&]/u', ' ', $lower) ?? $lower;

        if (str_contains($clean, 'geral')) {
            return self::CAT_TOOLS;
        }

        // 1. Roupa Íntima & Pijamas (ID 200574005)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'lingerie') || str_contains($clean, 'sutia') || str_contains($clean, 'sutiã') || str_contains($clean, 'calcinha') || str_contains($clean, 'intima') || str_contains($clean, 'íntima') || str_contains($clean, 'pijama') || str_contains($clean, 'cueca') || str_contains($clean, 'boxer') || str_contains($clean, 'espartilho') || str_contains($clean, 'corset')) {
            return self::CAT_LINGERIE;
        }

        // 2. Novidades & Uso Especial / Adulto (ID 200000532)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'sex shop') || str_contains($clean, 'sexshop') || str_contains($clean, 'adulto') || str_contains($clean, '18') || str_contains($clean, 'vibrat') || str_contains($clean, 'massageador') || str_contains($clean, 'novidade') || str_contains($clean, 'especial')) {
            return self::CAT_ADULT;
        }

        // 3. Roupas, Bolsas & Calçados (IDs 200000345, 200000343, 1524, 322)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'roupa') || str_contains($clean, 'vestuario') || str_contains($clean, 'vestuário') || str_contains($clean, 'casaco') || str_contains($clean, 'jaqueta') || str_contains($clean, 'mochila') || str_contains($clean, 'bolsa') || str_contains($clean, 'carteira') || str_contains($clean, 'sapato') || str_contains($clean, 'tenis') || str_contains($clean, 'tênis') || str_contains($clean, 'calcado') || str_contains($clean, 'calçado') || (str_contains($clean, 'moda') && !str_contains($clean, 'intima') && !str_contains($clean, 'íntima'))) {
            return self::CAT_FASHION;
        }

        // 4. Pet Shop (ID 100006664)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'pet') || str_contains($clean, 'cachorro') || str_contains($clean, 'gato') || str_contains($clean, 'cao') || str_contains($clean, 'cão')) {
            return self::CAT_PETS;
        }

        // 5. Peças & Acessórios Automotivos (ID 34)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'veiculo') || str_contains($clean, 'veículo') || str_contains($clean, 'carro') || str_contains($clean, 'automotivo') || str_contains($clean, 'auto') || str_contains($clean, 'moto')) {
            return self::CAT_AUTO;
        }

        // 6. Ferramentas & Utilidades (ID 1420, 30)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'alicate') || str_contains($clean, 'ferramenta') || str_contains($clean, 'crimpador') || str_contains($clean, 'decapador') || str_contains($clean, 'chave de fenda') || str_contains($clean, 'utilidade') || str_contains($clean, 'segurança')) {
            return self::CAT_TOOLS;
        }

        // 7. Relógios & Smartwatches (ID 1511)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'smartwatch') || str_contains($clean, 'relogio') || str_contains($clean, 'relógio') || str_contains($clean, 'pulseira inteligente') || str_contains($clean, 'apple watch')) {
            return self::CAT_SMARTWATCH;
        }

        // 8. Beleza, Saúde & Maquiagem (ID 66, 660103)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'beleza') || str_contains($clean, 'cabelo') || str_contains($clean, 'pele') || str_contains($clean, 'secador') || str_contains($clean, 'escova') || str_contains($clean, 'saude') || str_contains($clean, 'saúde') || str_contains($clean, 'maquiagem') || str_contains($clean, 'batom')) {
            return self::CAT_BEAUTY;
        }

        // 9. Casa, Iluminação & Eletro (ID 15, 39, 6)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'casa') || str_contains($clean, 'led') || str_contains($clean, 'luminaria') || str_contains($clean, 'luminária') || str_contains($clean, 'lampada') || str_contains($clean, 'lâmpada') || str_contains($clean, 'iluminação') || str_contains($clean, 'eletro') || str_contains($clean, 'tuya')) {
            return self::CAT_HOME;
        }

        // 10. Eletrônicos & Telefonia (ID 44, 509, 7)
        return self::CAT_TECH;
    }

    public function classifyFromText(string $title, ?string $rawCategory = null): string
    {
        $t = mb_strtolower(trim($title), 'UTF-8');

        // 1. Roupa Íntima & Pijamas (Precedência alta sobre Moda geral para evitar falso-positivo)
        if (preg_match('/\b(lingerie|sutiã|sutia|calcinha|calcinhas|bojo|push up|push-up|guipir|bralette|camisola|baby doll|pijama|pijamas|renda sexy|natalina sexy|meia-calça|meias-calça|meia calça|meias calça|meia calca|meia-calca|meia arrastão|meia arrastao|cueca|cuecas|boxer|slip|corpete|espartilho|espartilhos|corset|cinta modeladora|peças íntimas|pecas intimas|roupa íntima)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_LINGERIE;
        }

        // 2. Novidades & Uso Especial / Adulto (+18)
        if (preg_match('/\b(sex shop|sexshop|adulto|\+18|vibratório|vibratorio|vibratória|vibratoria|vibração|vibracao|massageador|amendoim|estimulador|plug|lubrificante|uso especial)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_ADULT;
        }

        // 3. Roupas, Bolsas & Calçados
        if (preg_match('/\b(casaco|casacos|jaqueta|jaquetas|corta-vento|corta vento|ciclismo|corrida secagem|impermeável masculino|capuz capa|moletom|calça|calca|camisa|camiseta|vestido|saia|bermuda|roupa|roupas|vestuário|vestuario|mochila|mochilas|bolsa|bolsas|carteira|carteiras|pochete|tênis|tenis|sapato|sapatos|sandália|sandalia|chinelo|chinelos|bota|botas|mocassim|calçado|calçados|calcado|calcados|meia|meias|invisível|invisivel|chaveiro|chaveiros|cinto|cintos|boné|bone|óculos|oculos)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_FASHION;
        }

        // 4. Pet Shop
        if (preg_match('/\b(pet|pets|cachorro|cachorros|cão|cães|gato|gatos|coleira|trela|fita led noite segurança|fibra ótica recarregável cães)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_PETS;
        }

        // 5. Peças & Acessórios Automotivos
        if (preg_match('/\b(veicular|veículo|veiculo|carro|automotivo|ventilação de ar|suporte celular carro|suporte automotivo|telemóvel com ventosa|suporte magnético 360|peças automotivas)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_AUTO;
        }

        // 6. Ferramentas & Utilidades
        if (preg_match('/\b(alicate|alicates|crimpador|decapador|desencapar fios|chaves de fenda|chave de fenda|catraca|ferramentas|ferramenta|chaves de precisão|bits)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_TOOLS;
        }

        // 7. Relógios & Smartwatches
        if (preg_match('/\b(smartwatch|smartwatches|relógio inteligente|relogio inteligente|relógio|relogio|apple watch|amazfit|aurafit|pulseira homem de ferro)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_SMARTWATCH;
        }

        // 8. Beleza, Saúde & Maquiagem
        if (preg_match('/\b(secador|escova secadora|escova alisadora|alisador|modelador de cabelo|cabelo|curling|barbeador|barba|depilador|maquiagem|facial|pele|batom|batons|gloss|rímel|rimel|delineador|base líquida|base liquida|corretivo|pó compacto|po compacto|paleta de sombras|paleta sombras|blush|pincel|pincéis|pinceis|esponja maquiagem|lip tint)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_BEAUTY;
        }

        // 9. Casa, Iluminação & Eletro
        if (preg_match('/\b(fita de led|fita led|rgbic|tuya|luminária|luminaria|lâmpada|lampada|barra de luz|monitor luzes|iluminação|teto|armário|quarto|cozinha|aspirador|eletrodoméstico|eletrodomestico|liquidificador portátil)\b/iu', $t)) {
            return self::CAT_HOME;
        }

        // 10. Se houver categoria bruta informada da API oficial, normaliza diretamente
        if ($rawCategory !== null && trim($rawCategory) !== '' && trim($rawCategory) !== 'Geral') {
            return $this->normalizeCategory($rawCategory);
        }

        return self::CAT_TECH;
    }

    public function buildSqlFilter(string $requestedCategory, array &$params): string
    {
        $raw = trim($requestedCategory);
        $lower = mb_strtolower($raw, 'UTF-8');
        $clean = preg_replace('/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s&]/u', ' ', $lower) ?? $lower;

        // 0. Filtro específico de Áudio & Fones (Prioridade alta antes de eletrônicos gerais)
        if ($clean === 'audio' || $clean === 'áudio' || str_starts_with($clean, 'fone') || str_contains($clean, 'ouvido') || str_contains($clean, 'headphone')) {
            return "(
                (
                    category IN ('Áudio', 'Audio', 'Fones Bluetooth TWS')
                    OR title LIKE '%Fone%'
                    OR title LIKE '%Tws%'
                    OR title LIKE '%Headphone%'
                    OR title LIKE '%Earphone%'
                    OR title LIKE '%Microfone%'
                )
                AND title NOT LIKE '%Smartwatch%'
                AND title NOT LIKE '%Relógio%'
                AND title NOT LIKE '%Pulseira%'
                AND title NOT LIKE '%Chave%'
                AND title NOT LIKE '%Reparo%'
            )";
        }

        // 0.1 Filtro específico de Celular / Smartphone
        if ($clean === 'celular' || $clean === 'smartphone' || $clean === 'celulares') {
            return "(
                category IN ('Telefones e telecomunicações', 'Celulares', 'Smartphones')

        // 1. Roupa Íntima & Pijamas (ID 200574005)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'lingerie') || str_contains($clean, 'intima') || str_contains($clean, 'íntima') || str_contains($clean, 'pijama') || str_contains($clean, 'sutia') || str_contains($clean, 'sutiã') || str_contains($clean, 'meia calca') || str_contains($clean, 'meia calça') || str_contains($clean, 'cueca')) {

                OR category LIKE '%Íntima%'
                OR category LIKE '%Intima%'
                OR category LIKE '%Lingerie%'
                OR title LIKE '%Lingerie%'
                OR title LIKE '%Sutiã%'
                OR title LIKE '%Sutia%'
                OR title LIKE '%Calcinha%'
                OR title LIKE '%Push Up%'
                OR title LIKE '%Push-Up%'
                OR title LIKE '%Pijama%'
                OR title LIKE '%Baby Doll%'

                OR title LIKE '%Massageador%'
                OR title LIKE '%Amendoim%'

        if (str_contains($clean, 'roupa') || str_contains($clean, 'vestuario') || str_contains($clean, 'vestuário') || str_contains($clean, 'moda') || str_contains($clean, 'casaco') || str_contains($clean, 'jaqueta') || str_contains($clean, 'mochila') || str_contains($clean, 'bolsa') || str_contains($clean, 'carteira') || str_contains($clean, 'tenis') || str_contains($clean, 'tênis') || str_contains($clean, 'sapato') || str_contains($clean, 'calcado') || str_contains($clean, 'calçado')) {

                    OR (category LIKE '%Moda%' AND category NOT LIKE '%Íntima%' AND category NOT LIKE '%Intima%')
                    OR (category LIKE '%Roupa%' AND category NOT LIKE '%Íntima%' AND category NOT LIKE '%Intima%')

        // 7. Relógios & Smartwatches (ID 1511)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'smartwatch') || str_contains($clean, 'relogio') || str_contains($clean, 'relógio') || str_contains($clean, 'pulseira') || str_contains($clean, 'watch')) {

                category IN ('Relógios & Smartwatches', 'Relógios', 'Smartwatches & Áudio', 'Smartwatches')

        // 8. Beleza, Saúde & Maquiagem (ID 66, 660103)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'beleza') || str_contains($clean, 'cabelo') || str_contains($clean, 'secador') || str_contains($clean, 'escova') || str_contains($clean, 'saude') || str_contains($clean, 'saúde') || str_contains($clean, 'cuidado') || str_contains($clean, 'maquiagem') || str_contains($clean, 'batom')) {

                category IN ('Beleza, Saúde & Maquiagem', 'Beleza e saúde', 'Maquiagem', 'Beleza, Cuidados & Estilo', 'Saúde & Cuidados')

        if (str_contains($clean, 'casa') || str_contains($clean, 'led') || str_contains($clean, 'luminaria') || str_contains($clean, 'luminária') || str_contains($clean, 'lampada') || str_contains($clean, 'lâmpada') || str_contains($clean, 'iluminação') || str_contains($clean, 'eletro')) {

        }

        // 10. Eletrônicos & Telefonia (ID 44, 509, 7)
        if (str_contains($clean, 'eletronico') || str_contains($clean, 'eletrônico') || str_contains($clean, 'telefone') || str_contains($clean, 'telefonia') || str_contains($clean, 'computador') || str_contains($clean, 'tecnologia') || str_contains($clean, 'gadget') || str_contains($clean, 'audio') || str_contains($clean, 'áudio') || str_contains($clean, 'fone')) {
            return "(
                category IN ('Eletrônicos & Telefonia', 'Eletrônicos', 'Telefones e telecomunicações', 'Computador e escritório', 'Tecnologia & Gadgets', 'Eletrônicos & Gadget', 'Áudio', 'Audio', 'Fones Bluetooth TWS')
                OR category LIKE '%Eletrônic%'
                OR category LIKE '%Eletronic%'
                OR category LIKE '%Telefone%'
                OR category LIKE '%Computador%'
                OR category LIKE '%Tecnologia%'
                OR category LIKE '%Áudio%'
                OR category LIKE '%Audio%'
                OR title LIKE '%Projetor%'
                OR title LIKE '%Console%'
                OR title LIKE '%Power Bank%'
                OR title LIKE '%Carregador%'
                OR title LIKE '%Fone%'
                OR title LIKE '%Tws%'
                OR title LIKE '%Headphone%'
                OR title LIKE '%Earphone%'
                OR title LIKE '%Microfone%'
            )";
        }

        // Fallback genérico seguro
        $params[] = $raw;
        $params[] = '%' . $raw . '%';
        return "(category = ? OR category LIKE ?)";
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/CurrencyConverterService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\CurrencyConverterInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Serviço de Conversão Cambial Dinâmica e Precificação (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Obtém cotação USD/BRL em tempo real com cache inteligente de 12 horas
 * e aplica regras de margem de lucro (markup percentual e lucro mínimo garantido).
 */
class CurrencyConverterService implements CurrencyConverterInterface
{
    private string $cacheFile;
    private float $defaultMarkupPercent;
    private float $minProfitBrl;
    private float $fallbackUsdRate = 5.80;
    private float $defaultVolatilityPercent;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $cacheDirOrFile = null,
        float $defaultMarkupPercent = 100.0,
        float $minProfitBrl = 30.0,
        float $fallbackUsdRate = 5.80,
        float $defaultVolatilityPercent = 12.0
    ) {
        if ($cacheDirOrFile !== null && str_ends_with(strtolower($cacheDirOrFile), '.json')) {
            $this->cacheFile = $cacheDirOrFile;
            $dir = dirname($cacheDirOrFile);
            if (!is_dir($dir)) {
                @mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
            }
        } else {
            $baseDir = $cacheDirOrFile ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/storage/cache' : dirname(__DIR__, 4) . '/storage/cache');
            if (!is_dir($baseDir)) {
                @mkdir($baseDir, 0775, true);
            }
            $this->cacheFile = $baseDir . '/exchange_rates.json';
        }
        $this->defaultMarkupPercent = $defaultMarkupPercent;
        $this->minProfitBrl = $minProfitBrl;
        $this->fallbackUsdRate = $fallbackUsdRate;
        $this->defaultVolatilityPercent = $defaultVolatilityPercent;
    }

    public function getDefaultVolatilityPercent(): float
    {
        return $this->defaultVolatilityPercent;
    }

    public function setDefaultVolatilityPercent(float $percent): void
    {
        $this->defaultVolatilityPercent = max(0.0, min(50.0, $percent));
    }

    /**
     * Aplica o amortecedor do Índice de Volatilidade (ex: 12% sobre o custo base).
     */
    public function applyVolatilityBuffer(float $baseCost, float $volatilityPercent = 12.0): float
    {
        if ($baseCost <= 0.0) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        return round($baseCost * (1 + ($volatilityPercent / 100.0)), 2);
    }

    public function getExchangeRate(string $from = 'USD', string $to = 'BRL'): float
    {
        if (strtoupper($from) === strtoupper($to)) {
            return 1.0;
        }

        // 1. Tenta carregar do cache local (válido por 12 horas)
        $cached = $this->loadCachedRate($from, $to);
        if ($cached !== null) {
            return $cached;
        }

        // 2. Consulta API pública de cotação (AwesomeAPI - Banco Central)
        try {
            $url = "https://economia.awesomeapi.com.br/last/{$from}-{$to}";
            $ctx = stream_context_create([
                'http' => [
                    'timeout'    => 3,
                    'user_agent' => 'DomainDrop-CurrencyConverter/1.0',
                ],
            ]);

            $json = @file_get_contents($url, false, $ctx);
            if ($json !== false) {
                $data = json_decode($json, true);
                $key = "{$from}{$to}";
                if (isset($data[$key]['bid'])) {
                    $rate = (float)$data[$key]['bid'];
                    if ($rate > 0) {
                        $this->saveCachedRate($from, $to, $rate);
                        return $rate;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Silencia para fallback defensivo
        }

        // 3. Fallback defensivo para não travar a loja offline
        return $this->fallbackUsdRate;
    }

    public function calculateSalePrice(float $costUsd, ?float $customMarkupPercent = null, ?float $minProfitBrl = null, float $volatilityPercent = 0.0): float
    {
        if ($costUsd <= 0.0) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $rate = $this->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
        $rawCostBrl = $costUsd * $rate;
        $effectiveCostBrl = $volatilityPercent > 0.0 ? $this->applyVolatilityBuffer($rawCostBrl, $volatilityPercent) : $rawCostBrl;

        $markup = $customMarkupPercent ?? $this->defaultMarkupPercent;
        $minProfit = $minProfitBrl ?? $this->minProfitBrl;

        // Calcula com o markup sobre o custo corrigido pela volatilidade
        $calculatedSalePrice = $effectiveCostBrl * (1 + ($markup / 100.0));

        // Assegura que o lucro líquido em Reais seja no mínimo o configurado
        $profit = $calculatedSalePrice - $rawCostBrl;
        if ($profit < $minProfit) {
            $calculatedSalePrice = $rawCostBrl + $minProfit;
        }

        // Arredondamento comercial atraente
        return round($calculatedSalePrice, 2);
    }

    /**
     * Calcula o preço final de venda em BRL aplicando margem de lucro (markup)
     * diretamente sobre o preço líquido de oferta do produto em Reais (BRL),
     * com suporte a índice de correção de volatilidade cambial/fornecedor.
     */
    public function calculateSalePriceFromBrl(float $costBrl, ?float $customMarkupPercent = 100.0, float $volatilityPercent = 0.0): float
    {
        if ($costBrl <= 0.0) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $markup = $customMarkupPercent ?? $this->defaultMarkupPercent;
        $effectiveCostBrl = $volatilityPercent > 0.0 ? $this->applyVolatilityBuffer($costBrl, $volatilityPercent) : $costBrl;
        $calculatedSalePrice = $effectiveCostBrl * (1 + ($markup / 100.0));

        // Assegura piso mínimo
        $profit = $calculatedSalePrice - $costBrl;
        if ($profit < $this->minProfitBrl) {
            $calculatedSalePrice = $costBrl + $this->minProfitBrl;
        }

        return round($calculatedSalePrice, 2);
    }

    private function loadCachedRate(string $from, string $to): ?float
    {
        if (!file_exists($this->cacheFile)) {
            return null;
        }

        $raw = @file_get_contents($this->cacheFile);
        if ($raw === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $cache = json_decode($raw, true);
        $key = "{$from}_{$to}";

        if (isset($cache[$key]['rate'], $cache[$key]['time'])) {
            // Expira em 12 horas (43.200 segundos)
            if ((time() - (int)$cache[$key]['time']) < 43200) {
                return (float)$cache[$key]['rate'];
            }
        } elseif (isset($cache[$from]) && is_numeric($cache[$from])) {
            return (float)$cache[$from];
        } elseif (isset($cache[$key]) && is_numeric($cache[$key])) {
            return (float)$cache[$key];
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function saveCachedRate(string $from, string $to, float $rate): void
    {
        $cache = [];
        if (file_exists($this->cacheFile)) {
            $raw = @file_get_contents($this->cacheFile);
            if ($raw !== false) {
                $cache = json_decode($raw, true) ?: [];
            }
        }

        $key = "{$from}_{$to}";
        $cache[$key] = [
            'rate' => $rate,
            'time' => time(),
        ];

        @file_put_contents($this->cacheFile, json_encode($cache, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/DisputeAttachmentService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

/**
 * Valida e persiste anexos (PDF e imagens) de reclamações de clientes fora da pasta pública.
 */
class DisputeAttachmentService
{
    public const MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 5242880; // 5 MB
    public const MAX_FILES_PER_DISPUTE = 4;

    private const ALLOWED_MIME_MAP = [
        'pdf'  => ['application/pdf'],
        'jpg'  => ['image/jpeg', 'image/pjpeg'],
        'jpeg' => ['image/jpeg', 'image/pjpeg'],
        'png'  => ['image/png'],
        'webp' => ['image/webp'],
    ];

    private string $storageDir;

    public function __construct(?string $basePath = null, private readonly bool $requireUploadedFile = true)
    {
        $root = $basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4));
        $this->storageDir = rtrim($root, '/\\') . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'storage' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'domain_drop' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'disputes';
    }

    public function getStorageDir(): string
    {
        return $this->storageDir;
    }

    /**
     * Valida e armazena arquivos enviados via $request->files['evidences'].
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $fileInput
     * @return array{attachments: array<int, array<string, mixed>>, errors: array<int, string>}
     */
    public function storeUploadedFiles(?array $fileInput): array
    {
        if (empty($fileInput) || empty($fileInput['name'])) {
            return ['attachments' => [], 'errors' => []];
        }

        $normalized = $this->normalizeFiles($fileInput);
        if (count($normalized) > self::MAX_FILES_PER_DISPUTE) {
            return [
                'attachments' => [],
                'errors'      => ['Envie no máximo ' . self::MAX_FILES_PER_DISPUTE . ' arquivos (PDF ou imagem).'],
            ];
        }

        $attachments = [];
        $errors = [];

        foreach ($normalized as $file) {
            $err = (int)($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE);
            if ($err === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($err !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $errors[] = 'Falha no upload do arquivo "' . (string)($file['name'] ?? 'anexo') . '".';
                continue;
            }

            $originalName = basename((string)($file['name'] ?? ''));
            $tmpPath = (string)($file['tmp_name'] ?? '');
            $size = (int)($file['size'] ?? 0);

            if ($tmpPath === '' || !is_file($tmpPath)) {
                $errors[] = 'Arquivo temporário inválido.';
                continue;
            }
            if ($this->requireUploadedFile && !is_uploaded_file($tmpPath)) {
                $errors[] = 'Origem de arquivo não permitida.';
                continue;
            }
            if ($size <= 0 || $size > self::MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
                $errors[] = "O arquivo '{$originalName}' excede o limite de 5 MB.";
                continue;
            }

            $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($originalName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
            if (!isset(self::ALLOWED_MIME_MAP[$ext])) {
                $errors[] = "Formato não permitido para '{$originalName}'. Envie apenas PDF, JPG, PNG ou WEBP.";
                continue;
            }

            $detectedMime = $this->detectMime($tmpPath);
            if (!in_array($detectedMime, self::ALLOWED_MIME_MAP[$ext], true)) {
                $errors[] = "Conteúdo incompatível para '{$originalName}' (MIME detectado: {$detectedMime}).";
                continue;
            }

            if (!is_dir($this->storageDir)) {
                @mkdir($this->storageDir, 0775, true);
            }

            $storedFilename = bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) . '.' . $ext;
            $targetPath = $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $storedFilename;

            $moved = $this->requireUploadedFile
                ? @move_uploaded_file($tmpPath, $targetPath)
                : @copy($tmpPath, $targetPath);

            if (!$moved) {
                $errors[] = "Não foi possível salvar '{$originalName}'.";
                continue;
            }

            $attachments[] = [
                'filename'      => $storedFilename,
                'original_name' => $originalName,
                'mime'          => $detectedMime,
                'size'          => $size,
            ];
        }

        return [
            'attachments' => $attachments,
            'errors'      => $errors,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Resolve caminho absoluto seguro de um anexo já armazenado.
     */
    public function resolveSafePath(string $filename): ?string
    {
        $clean = basename($filename);
        if ($clean === '' || !preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}\.(pdf|jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i', $clean)) {
            return null;
        }

        $candidate = $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $clean;
        if (!is_file($candidate)) {
            return null;
        }

        $realBase = realpath($this->storageDir);
        $realFile = realpath($candidate);
        if ($realBase === false || $realFile === false || !str_starts_with($realFile, $realBase)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $realFile;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $fileInput
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function normalizeFiles(array $fileInput): array
    {
        if (!is_array($fileInput['name'])) {
            return [$fileInput];
        }

        $items = [];
        $count = count($fileInput['name']);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
            $items[] = [
                'name'     => $fileInput['name'][$i] ?? '',
                'type'     => $fileInput['type'][$i] ?? '',
                'tmp_name' => $fileInput['tmp_name'][$i] ?? '',
                'error'    => $fileInput['error'][$i] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE,
                'size'     => $fileInput['size'][$i] ?? 0,
            ];
        }

        return $items;
    }

    private function detectMime(string $path): string
    {
        if (function_exists('finfo_open')) {
            $finfo = @finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
            if ($finfo !== false) {
                $mime = (string)@finfo_file($finfo, $path);
                @finfo_close($finfo);
                if ($mime !== '') {
                    return strtolower(trim($mime));
                }
            }
        }

        return 'application/octet-stream';
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/FileDemandLogStorage.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandLogStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Armazenamento de logs de demanda em arquivos JSON particionados por mês e ano (SRP).
 *
 * Estrutura de diretórios criada:
 *   storage/demand_logs/{ano}/json_{nome_do_mes}_{ano}/interactions.json
 *
 * Garante concorrência segura com trava de arquivo (LOCK_EX) e
 * expurgo automático de dados com mais de 2 anos.
 */
class FileDemandLogStorage implements DemandLogStorageInterface
{
    private const MONTH_NAMES = [
        1  => 'janeiro',
        2  => 'fevereiro',
        3  => 'marco',
        4  => 'abril',
        5  => 'maio',
        6  => 'junho',
        7  => 'julho',
        8  => 'agosto',
        9  => 'setembro',
        10 => 'outubro',
        11 => 'novembro',
        12 => 'dezembro',
    ];

    private string $baseDir;

    public function __construct(?string $baseDir = null)
    {
        if ($baseDir !== null && $baseDir !== '') {
            $this->baseDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $baseDir), '/');
        } else {
            $root = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4);
            $this->baseDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $root), '/') . '/storage/demand_logs';
        }
    }

    public function appendInteraction(DemandEvent $event): void
    {
        try {
            $filePath = $this->getFilePathForPeriod();
            $dir = dirname($filePath);

            if (!is_dir($dir)) {
                @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
            }

            $record = [
                'id'             => bin2hex(random_bytes(8)),
                'product_id'     => $event->productId,
                'product_title'  => $event->productTitle,
                'category_slug'  => $event->categorySlug,
                'action_type'    => $event->actionType,
                'user_type'      => $event->userType,
                'customer_id'    => $event->customerId,
                'customer_name'  => $event->customerName,
                'customer_email' => $event->customerEmail,
                'session_id'     => $event->sessionId,
                'ip_address'     => $event->ipAddress ?: (\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent::resolveClientIp()),
                'created_at'     => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            ];

            $line = json_encode($record, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n";
            @file_put_contents($filePath, $line, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            error_log('[FileDemandLogStorage] Falha ao registrar log de demanda JSON: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function getRecentInteractions(?string $yearMonth = null, int $limit = 50): array
    {
        $filePath = $this->getFilePathForPeriod($yearMonth);
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            return [];
        }

        $lines = @file($filePath, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES);
        if ($lines === false || empty($lines)) {
            return [];
        }

        $records = [];
        // Itera de trás para frente para pegar os mais recentes primeiro
        for ($i = count($lines) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $line = trim($lines[$i]);
            if ($line === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $decoded = json_decode($line, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $records[] = $decoded;
                if (count($records) >= $limit) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        return $records;
    }

    public function getLeadEmails(?string $yearMonth = null): array
    {
        $filePath = $this->getFilePathForPeriod($yearMonth);
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            return [];
        }

        $lines = @file($filePath, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES);
        if ($lines === false || empty($lines)) {
            return [];
        }

        $emails = [];
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            $line = trim($line);
            if ($line === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $item = json_decode($line, true);
            if (is_array($item)) {
                $email = strtolower(trim((string)($item['customer_email'] ?? '')));
                if ($email !== '' && ($item['user_type'] ?? '') === 'cliente_logado') {
                    $emails[] = $email;
                }
            }
        }

        return array_values(array_unique($emails));
    }

    public function purgeExpiredLogs(int $retentionYears = 2): int
    {
        if (!is_dir($this->baseDir)) {
            return 0;
        }

        $currentYear = (int)date('Y');
        $cutoffYear = $currentYear - max(1, $retentionYears);
        $purgedCount = 0;

        $entries = @scandir($this->baseDir);
        if ($entries === false) {
            return 0;
        }

        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
            if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                continue;
            }

            $yearDirPath = $this->baseDir . '/' . $entry;
            if (is_dir($yearDirPath) && preg_match('/^\d{4}$/', $entry)) {
                $dirYear = (int)$entry;
                // Expurga anos anteriores à janela de 2 anos
                if ($dirYear < $cutoffYear) {
                    $this->deleteDirectoryRecursive($yearDirPath);
                    $purgedCount++;
                }
            }
        }

        return $purgedCount;
    }

    public function getFilePathForPeriod(?string $yearMonth = null): string
    {
        $period = $yearMonth ?: date('Y-m');
        if (!preg_match('/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})$/', $period, $matches)) {
            $year = date('Y');
            $monthNum = (int)date('n');
        } else {
            $year = $matches[1];
            $monthNum = (int)$matches[2];
        }

        $monthName = self::MONTH_NAMES[$monthNum] ?? 'geral';
        $folderName = "json_{$monthName}_{$year}";

        return "{$this->baseDir}/{$year}/{$folderName}/interactions.json";
    }

    public function promoteInteractions(
        string $sessionId,
        int $customerId,
        string $customerName,
        string $customerEmail,
        ?string $ipAddress = null,
        ?string $yearMonth = null
    ): int {
        $cleanSession = trim($sessionId);
        $cleanIp = trim($ipAddress ?? '');
        if ($customerId <= 0 || ($cleanSession === '' && $cleanIp === '')) {
            return 0;
        }

        $filePath = $this->getFilePathForPeriod($yearMonth);
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            return 0;
        }

        $fp = @fopen($filePath, 'c+');
        if (!$fp) {
            return 0;
        }

        $updatedCount = 0;
        try {
            if (!flock($fp, LOCK_EX)) {
                fclose($fp);
                return 0;
            }

            $lines = [];
            while (($line = fgets($fp)) !== false) {
                $trimmed = trim($line);
                if ($trimmed === '') {
                    continue;
                }
                $record = json_decode($trimmed, true);
                if (is_array($record)) {
                    $recSession = (string)($record['session_id'] ?? '');
                    $recIp = (string)($record['ip_address'] ?? '');
                    $recCustId = (int)($record['customer_id'] ?? 0);
                    $recUserType = (string)($record['user_type'] ?? 'externo');

                    $matchesSession = ($cleanSession !== '' && $recSession === $cleanSession);
                    $matchesIp = ($cleanIp !== '' && $recIp === $cleanIp);

                    if (($matchesSession || $matchesIp) && ($recCustId <= 0 || $recUserType === 'externo')) {
                        $record['customer_id'] = $customerId;
                        $record['customer_name'] = $customerName;
                        $record['customer_email'] = $customerEmail;
                        $record['user_type'] = 'cliente_logado';
                        if (empty($record['ip_address']) && $cleanIp !== '') {
                            $record['ip_address'] = $cleanIp;
                        }
                        $updatedCount++;
                    }
                    $lines[] = json_encode($record, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n";
                }
            }

            if ($updatedCount > 0) {
                ftruncate($fp, 0);
                rewind($fp);
                foreach ($lines as $lineStr) {
                    fwrite($fp, $lineStr);
                }
                fflush($fp);
            }

            flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($fp);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            @fclose($fp);
            error_log('[FileDemandLogStorage] Falha ao promover interações de sessão/IP: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return $updatedCount;
    }

    public function promoteSessionInteractions(
        string $sessionId,
        int $customerId,
        string $customerName,
        string $customerEmail,
        ?string $yearMonth = null
    ): int {
        return $this->promoteInteractions($sessionId, $customerId, $customerName, $customerEmail, null, $yearMonth);
    }

    private function deleteDirectoryRecursive(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }

        $items = @scandir($dir);
        if ($items === false) {
            return;
        }

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->deleteDirectoryRecursive($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }

        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressAuthorizationUrlBuilderInterface;

final class AliExpressAuthorizationUrlBuilder implements AliExpressAuthorizationUrlBuilderInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $appKey,
        private readonly string $authorizeEndpoint = 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/oauth/authorize'
    ) {}

    public function build(string $redirectUri, string $state): string
    {
        $query = [
            'response_type' => 'code',
            'force_auth'    => 'true',
            'redirect_uri'  => $redirectUri,
            'client_id'     => trim($this->appKey),
        ];
        if ($state !== '') {
            $query['state'] = trim($state);
        }

        return rtrim($this->authorizeEndpoint, '/') . '?' . http_build_query($query);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/OAuth/ConfigOAuthTokenRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\OAuthTokenRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AtomicConfigStorage;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects\AliExpressToken;

/**
 * Repositório de persistência de tokens no arquivo de configuração do DomainDrop (DIP).
 */
final class ConfigOAuthTokenRepository implements OAuthTokenRepositoryInterface
{
    private string $configFile;

    public function __construct(?string $basePath = null)
    {
        $root = $basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 5));
        $this->configFile = $root . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json';
    }

    public function store(AliExpressToken $token): void
    {
        $tokenData = $token->toArray();
        AtomicConfigStorage::update($this->configFile, function (array $config) use ($tokenData): array {
            $config['access_token'] = $tokenData['access_token'];
            if ($tokenData['refresh_token'] !== '') {
                $config['refresh_token'] = $tokenData['refresh_token'];
            }
            $config['access_token_expires_at'] = $tokenData['access_token_expires_at'];
            if ($tokenData['refresh_token_expires_at'] !== null) {
                $config['refresh_token_expires_at'] = $tokenData['refresh_token_expires_at'];
            }
            if ($tokenData['account'] !== '') {
                $config['oauth_account'] = $tokenData['account'];
            }
            return $config;
        });
    }

    public function load(): ?AliExpressToken
    {
        $config = AtomicConfigStorage::read($this->configFile);
        $at = trim((string)($config['access_token'] ?? ''));
        if ($at === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $expiresAt = (int)($config['access_token_expires_at'] ?? 0);
        $expiresIn = max(0, $expiresAt - time());

        $refreshExpiresAt = (int)($config['refresh_token_expires_at'] ?? 0);
        $refreshExpiresIn = max(0, $refreshExpiresAt - time());

        return new AliExpressToken(
            accessToken:      $at,
            refreshToken:     (string)($config['refresh_token'] ?? ''),
            expiresIn:        $expiresIn,
            refreshExpiresIn: $refreshExpiresIn,
            account:          (string)($config['oauth_account'] ?? ''),
            createdAt:        $expiresAt > 0 ? ($expiresAt - 2592000) : time()
        );
    }

    public function clear(): void
    {
        AtomicConfigStorage::update($this->configFile, function (array $config): array {
            unset(
                $config['access_token'],
                $config['refresh_token'],
                $config['access_token_expires_at'],
                $config['refresh_token_expires_at'],
                $config['oauth_account']
            );
            return $config;
        });
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function loadConfig(): array
    {
        return AtomicConfigStorage::read($this->configFile);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $config
     */
    private function saveConfig(array $config): void
    {
        AtomicConfigStorage::write($this->configFile, $config);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/OAuth/CurlHttpClient.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\IopHttpClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Exceptions\AliExpressApiException;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Cliente HTTP alternativo via cURL puro (LSP / DIP / Fallback de Alta Disponibilidade).
 * Utilizado como contingência quando o gateway IOP rejeita chamadas multipart padrão.
 */
final class CurlHttpClient implements IopHttpClientInterface
{
    private string $sdkVersion = 'iop-sdk-php-20220608';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $appKey,
        private readonly string $appSecret,
        private readonly string $gatewayUrl = 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/rest',
        private readonly int $timeout = 15
    ) {}

    public function call(string $endpoint, array $params): array
    {
        $appKey = trim($this->appKey);
        $appSecret = trim($this->appSecret);

        if ($appKey === '' || $appSecret === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('[CurlHttpClient] AppKey ou AppSecret não configurados.');
        }

        $cleanEndpoint = '/' . ltrim($endpoint, '/');

        // Documentação token_access.pdf alerta: NÃO enviar uuid
        $filteredParams = [];
        foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
            if ($k === 'uuid') {
                continue;
            }
            if ($v !== null && $v !== '') {
                $filteredParams[$k] = (string)$v;
            }
        }

        $msec = (string)(int)(microtime(true) * 1000);
        $sysParams = [
            'app_key'     => $appKey,
            'sign_method' => 'sha256',
            'timestamp'   => $msec,
            'method'      => $cleanEndpoint,
            'partner_id'  => $this->sdkVersion,
            'simplify'    => 'false',
            'format'      => 'json',
        ];

        $allParams = array_merge($filteredParams, $sysParams);
        ksort($allParams);

        $stringToBeSigned = $cleanEndpoint;
        foreach ($allParams as $k => $v) {
            $stringToBeSigned .= "{$k}{$v}";
        }

        $sign = strtoupper(hash_hmac('sha256', $stringToBeSigned, $appSecret));
        $sysParams['sign'] = $sign;

        $baseUrl = str_ends_with($this->gatewayUrl, '/sync')
            ? substr($this->gatewayUrl, 0, -5) . '/rest'
            : (str_ends_with($this->gatewayUrl, '/rest') ? $this->gatewayUrl : 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/rest');

        $requestUrl = rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '?' . http_build_query($sysParams);

        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $requestUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($filteredParams));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $this->timeout);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 5);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, $this->sdkVersion);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);

        $rawResponse = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $curlError = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($rawResponse === false) {
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[CurlHttpClient] Falha de conexão com gateway do AliExpress: {$curlError}", 0, 'CONNECTION_ERROR');
        }

        if ($httpCode < 200 || $httpCode >= 300) {
            $errDecoded = json_decode((string)$rawResponse, true);
            $errCode = (string)($errDecoded['code'] ?? "HTTP_{$httpCode}");
            $errMsg = (string)($errDecoded['message'] ?? 'Falha HTTP do gateway AliExpress.');
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[CurlHttpClient HTTP {$httpCode}] {$errMsg}", $httpCode, $errCode);
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$rawResponse, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("[CurlHttpClient] Resposta não-JSON recebida da API: {$rawResponse}");
        }

        if (isset($decoded['error_response']) && is_array($decoded['error_response'])) {
            $err = $decoded['error_response'];
            $errCode = (string)($err['sub_code'] ?? ($err['code'] ?? 'API_ERROR'));
            $msg = (string)($err['sub_msg'] ?? ($err['msg'] ?? 'Erro desconhecido da AliExpress API'));
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[AliExpress Gateway Error: {$errCode}] {$msg}", 0, $errCode);
        }

        if (isset($decoded['code']) && (string)$decoded['code'] !== '0' && (string)$decoded['code'] !== '200') {
            $codeStr = (string)$decoded['code'];
            $msg = (string)($decoded['message'] ?? ($decoded['msg'] ?? ($decoded['sub_msg'] ?? 'Erro retornado pela AliExpress API')));
            $subCode = (string)($decoded['sub_code'] ?? $codeStr);
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[AliExpress Gateway Error: {$codeStr}] {$msg}", 0, $subCode);
        }

        return $decoded;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OAuth;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\IopHttpClientInterface;

use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Cliente HTTP para o protocolo oficial IOP do AliExpress (DIP / Adapter Pattern).
 * Em conformidade com o documento oficial token_access.pdf e o IOP SDK.
 */
final class IopSdkHttpClient implements IopHttpClientInterface
{
    private string $sdkVersion = 'iop-sdk-php-20220608';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $appKey,
        private readonly string $appSecret,
        private readonly string $gatewayUrl = 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/rest',
        private readonly int $timeout = 15
    ) {}

    public function call(string $endpoint, array $params): array
    {
        $appKey = trim($this->appKey);
        $appSecret = trim($this->appSecret);

        if ($appKey === '' || $appSecret === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('[IopSdkHttpClient] AppKey ou AppSecret não configurados.');
        }

        $cleanEndpoint = '/' . ltrim($endpoint, '/');

        // Documentação token_access.pdf alerta: NÃO enviar uuid
        $filteredParams = [];
        foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
            if ($k === 'uuid') {
                continue;
            }
            if ($v !== null && $v !== '') {
                $filteredParams[$k] = (string)$v;
            }
        }

        $msec = (string)(int)(microtime(true) * 1000);
        $sysParams = [
            'app_key'     => $appKey,
            'sign_method' => 'sha256',
            'timestamp'   => $msec,
            'method'      => $cleanEndpoint,
            'partner_id'  => $this->sdkVersion,
            'simplify'    => 'false',
            'format'      => 'json',
        ];

        $allParams = array_merge($filteredParams, $sysParams);
        ksort($allParams);

        // Algoritmo oficial de assinatura REST IOP
        $stringToBeSigned = $cleanEndpoint;
        foreach ($allParams as $k => $v) {
            $stringToBeSigned .= "{$k}{$v}";
        }

        $sign = strtoupper(hash_hmac('sha256', $stringToBeSigned, $appSecret));
        $sysParams['sign'] = $sign;

        $baseUrl = str_ends_with($this->gatewayUrl, '/sync')
            ? substr($this->gatewayUrl, 0, -5) . '/rest'
            : (str_ends_with($this->gatewayUrl, '/rest') ? $this->gatewayUrl : 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/rest');

        $requestUrl = rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '?' . http_build_query($sysParams);

        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $requestUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($filteredParams));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $this->timeout);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 5);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, $this->sdkVersion);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);

        $rawResponse = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $curlError = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        (new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\ApiUsageTracker())->recordRequest();

        if ($rawResponse === false) {
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[IopSdkHttpClient] Falha de conexão com gateway do AliExpress: {$curlError}", 0, 'CONNECTION_ERROR');
        }

        if ($httpCode < 200 || $httpCode >= 300) {
            $errDecoded = json_decode((string)$rawResponse, true);
            $errCode = (string)($errDecoded['code'] ?? "HTTP_{$httpCode}");
            $errMsg = (string)($errDecoded['message'] ?? 'Falha HTTP do gateway AliExpress.');
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[IopSdkHttpClient HTTP {$httpCode}] {$errMsg}", $httpCode, $errCode);
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$rawResponse, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("[IopSdkHttpClient] Resposta não-JSON recebida da API: {$rawResponse}");
        }

        if (isset($decoded['error_response']) && is_array($decoded['error_response'])) {
            $err = $decoded['error_response'];
            $errCode = (string)($err['sub_code'] ?? ($err['code'] ?? 'API_ERROR'));
            $msg = (string)($err['sub_msg'] ?? ($err['msg'] ?? 'Erro desconhecido da AliExpress API'));
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[AliExpress Gateway Error: {$errCode}] {$msg}", 0, $errCode);
        }

        if (isset($decoded['code']) && (string)$decoded['code'] !== '0' && (string)$decoded['code'] !== '200') {
            $codeStr = (string)$decoded['code'];
            $msg = (string)($decoded['message'] ?? ($decoded['msg'] ?? ($decoded['sub_msg'] ?? 'Erro retornado pela AliExpress API')));
            $subCode = (string)($decoded['sub_code'] ?? $codeStr);
            throw new AliExpressApiException("[AliExpress Gateway Error: {$codeStr}] {$msg}", 0, $subCode);
        }

        return $decoded;
    }
}
