                    'properties' => ['Classificação' => '🔞 Adulto (+18)', 'Velocidades' => '5 Frequências Ajustáveis', 'Carregador' => 'Cabo USB Incluso', 'Envio' => '100% Discreto'],
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Gera a matriz completa de variantes (Cor x Tamanho) para itens curados/teste.
     *
     * @param array<int, string> $colors
     * @param array<int, string> $sizes
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private static function buildColorSizeVariants(
        string $productId,
        array $colors,
        array $sizes,
        float $basePriceBrl,
        float $baseCostUsd,
        string $imageUrl
    ): array {
        $variants = [];
        foreach ($colors as $cIdx => $color) {
            $colorSlug = strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/', '', $color) ?: (string)$cIdx);
            foreach ($sizes as $sIdx => $size) {
                $sizeCode = strtok($size, ' ') ?: (string)$sIdx;
                $variants[] = [
                    'sku_id'         => "{$productId}-{$colorSlug}-{$sizeCode}",
                    'sku_attr'       => '14:' . (200000180 + $cIdx) . ';5:' . (100014064 + $sIdx),
                    'options'        => ['Cor' => $color, 'Tamanho' => $size],
                    'price_brl'      => round($basePriceBrl + ($sIdx * 5.0), 2),
                    'cost_price_usd' => round($baseCostUsd + ($sIdx * 0.6), 2),
                    'image_url'      => $imageUrl,
                    'stock'          => max(15, 60 - ($sIdx * 10) - ($cIdx * 5)),
                ];
            }
        }

        return $variants;
    }

    /**
     * Gera estrutura de dados de fallback inteligente para um ID ou URL informada.
     * Tenta primeiro extrair dados reais (título, galeria HD imagePathList e preço) diretamente da página web.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function createFallbackItemFromIdOrUrl(string $productId, string $url): array
    {
        $liveWebData = $this->fetchProductDataFromWeb($productId, $url);
        if ($liveWebData !== null) {
            return $liveWebData;
        }

        $title = 'Produto Importado AliExpress ' . $productId;
        $category = 'Geral';

        // Tenta inferir o título a partir da URL
        if (preg_match('/item\/\d+-([^.]+)\.html/i', $url, $m)) {
            $words = explode('-', $m[1]);
            $title = ucwords(implode(' ', array_filter($words)));
            if (stripos($url, 'watch') !== false || stripos($url, 'relogio') !== false) {
                $category = 'Eletrônicos';
            } elseif (stripos($url, 'fone') !== false || stripos($url, 'earphone') !== false) {
                $category = 'Eletrônicos';
            } elseif (stripos($url, 'lamp') !== false || stripos($url, 'luz') !== false) {
                $category = 'Casa Inteligente';
            }
        }

        return [
            'product_id' => $productId,
            'product_title' => $title,
            'category_name' => $category,
            'target_sale_price' => '14.00',
            'product_main_image_url' => 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1526738549149-8e07eca6c147?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
            'evaluate_rate' => '4.8',
            'volume' => 2400,
            'product_description' => "Produto de alta qualidade importado diretamente do fabricante com envio rastreado.",
            'properties' => ['Garantia' => 'Internacional', 'Envio' => 'Rastreio Oficial'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Extrai dados em tempo real diretamente do HTML da página pública do AliExpress.
     * Captura título limpo, imagem de capa, galeria Full HD (imagePathList) e precificação via pdp_npi.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    private function fetchProductDataFromWeb(string $productId, string $url): ?array
    {
        $targetUrl = str_starts_with($url, 'http') ? $url : "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html";

        $ch = curl_init($targetUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36');
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 8);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        $html = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if (!$html || !is_string($html)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Descarta se for página de desafio anti-bot ou link quebrado
        if (stripos($html, 'Arraste o controle deslizante') !== false
            || stripos($html, 'sec.aliexpress.com') !== false
            || stripos($html, 'punish') !== false
            || stripos($html, 'baxia') !== false
            || stripos($html, 'Página não encontrada') !== false
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        $title = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:title" content="([^"]+)"/i', $html, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode(preg_replace('/\s*-\s*AliExpress.*$/i', '', $m[1]));
        }

        $mainImage = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:image" content="([^"]+)"/i', $html, $m)) {
            $mainImage = $m[1];
        }

        $images = [];
        if (preg_match('/"imagePathList":(\[[^\]]+\])/', $html, $m)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($m[1], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $images = $decoded;
            }
        }

        if (empty($title) && empty($mainImage) && empty($images)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Tenta inferir preço da query string (pdp_npi) ou HTML
        $costPriceUsd = 12.00;
        $decodedUrl = urldecode($targetUrl . ' ' . $html);
        if (preg_match('/dis!([A-Z]{3})![0-9.]+!([0-9.]+)/i', $decodedUrl, $pm)) {
            $currency = strtoupper($pm[1]);
            $promoVal = (float)$pm[2];
            if ($currency === 'BRL') {
                $costPriceUsd = round($promoVal / 5.25, 2);
            } elseif ($currency === 'USD') {
                $costPriceUsd = $promoVal;
            }
        }

        // Categoria inteligente
        $category = 'Eletrônicos';
        if (stripos($title, 'pulseira') !== false || stripos($title, 'watch') !== false || stripos($title, 'relogio') !== false) {
            $category = 'Eletrônicos';
        } elseif (stripos($title, 'beleza') !== false || stripos($title, 'cabelo') !== false || stripos($title, 'pele') !== false) {
            $category = 'Beleza & Estilo';
        } elseif (stripos($title, 'luminaria') !== false || stripos($title, 'casa') !== false || stripos($title, 'quarto') !== false) {
            $category = 'Casa Inteligente';
        }

        return [
            'product_id' => $productId,
            'product_title' => $title ?: ('Produto AliExpress ' . $productId),
            'category_name' => $category,
            'target_sale_price' => (string)$costPriceUsd,
            'product_main_image_url' => $mainImage,
            'images' => $images,
            'imagePathList' => $images,
            'evaluate_rate' => '4.8',
            'volume' => 1350,
            'product_description' => "Produto importado oficial de alta durabilidade com compatibilidade e acabamento premium.",
            'properties' => [
                'Origem' => 'Importação Oficial',
                'Garantia' => 'Garantia do Fabricante',
                'Envio' => 'Rastreamento Internacional Expresso',
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Executa o ciclo de rotação diária automatizada de 24 horas.
     * Minera produtos virais aleatórios para todas as 9 categorias oficiais,
     * atualiza o catálogo, registra a data/hora de conclusão e retorna o resumo estatístico.
     *
     * @param int $itemsPerCategory Quantidade de novos produtos minerados por categoria (padrão 10 = ~90 a 100 no ciclo diário de 24h)
     * @return array<string, mixed> Resumo da rodada executada
     */
    public function runDailyAutomatedRotation(int $itemsPerCategory = 10): array
    {
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        if (isset($config['daily_items_per_category']) && is_numeric($config['daily_items_per_category'])) {
            $itemsPerCategory = max(1, min(20, (int)$config['daily_items_per_category']));
        }
        $lockPath = $this->getConfigFilePath() . '.rotation.lock';
        $lockDir = dirname($lockPath);
        if (!is_dir($lockDir)) {
            @mkdir($lockDir, 0775, true);
        }

        $lockHandle = @fopen($lockPath, 'c+');
        if ($lockHandle === false) {
            return [
                'success'         => false,
                'skipped'         => true,
                'reason'          => 'lock_file_unavailable',
                'executed_at'     => 0,
                'total_mined'     => 0,
                'category_counts' => [],
            ];
        }

        if (!flock($lockHandle, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
            fclose($lockHandle);
            return [
                'success'         => false,
                'skipped'         => true,
                'reason'          => 'rotation_already_running',
                'executed_at'     => 0,
                'total_mined'     => 0,
                'category_counts' => [],
            ];
        }

        try {
            $results = [];
            $totalProducts = 0;

            // 1. Curadoria Prioritária por Demanda: Garante vagas cativas para os produtos campeões de cliques/compras
            $priorityTermsPreserved = [];
            if ($this->demandMetricsRepo !== null) {
                try {
                    $topDemanded = $this->demandMetricsRepo->getMonthlyRankings(date('Y-m'), 5);
                    foreach ($topDemanded as $demandedItem) {
                        $term = trim((string)($demandedItem['product_title'] ?? ''));
                        $cat = trim((string)($demandedItem['category_slug'] ?? ''));
                        if ($term !== '') {
                            $targetCat = self::normalizeCategory($cat);
                            try {
                                $priorityMined = $this->mineTrendingProducts(category: $targetCat, limit: 1, autoPersist: true, sort: 'volume_desc');
                                if (!empty($priorityMined)) {
                                    $priorityTermsPreserved[] = $term;
                                    $totalProducts += count($priorityMined);
                                }
                            } catch (Throwable $e) {}
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Isolamento gracioso
                }
            }

            // 2. Rotação das 9 Categorias Oficiais
            foreach (self::OFFICIAL_CATEGORIES as $cat) {
                try {
                    $mined = $this->mineTrendingProducts(category: $cat, limit: $itemsPerCategory, autoPersist: true);
                    $count = count($mined);
                    $results[$cat] = $count;
                    $totalProducts += $count;
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    $results[$cat] = 0;
                }
            }

            // 3. Limpeza automática de anúncios cuja página no AliExpress retornou 404 / "Página não encontrada" (ciclo de 24h)
            $removedDeadLinks = $this->purgeNotFoundProducts(50);

            // Registra a conclusão do ciclo de 24 horas
            $now = time();
            $this->updateConfigField('last_daily_cycle_at', $now);

            return [
                'success'            => true,
                'skipped'            => false,
                'executed_at'        => $now,
                'executed_date'      => date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $now),
                'total_mined'        => $totalProducts,
                'deleted_not_found'  => $removedDeadLinks,
                'category_counts'    => $results,
                'priority_preserved' => $priorityTermsPreserved,
            ];
        } finally {
            flock($lockHandle, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($lockHandle);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retorna os metadados do ciclo diário de 24 horas:
     * timestamp da última execução, próxima execução, segundos restantes, tempo formatado (HH:MM:SS),
     * status se expirado (is_due) e estatísticas de produtos por categoria.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function getDailyCycleInfo(): array
    {
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $intervalSeconds = (int)($config['cycle_interval_seconds'] ?? 86400); // 24 horas padrão
        if ($intervalSeconds <= 0) {
            $intervalSeconds = 86400;
        }

        $lastCycleAt = isset($config['last_daily_cycle_at']) && is_numeric($config['last_daily_cycle_at'])
            ? (int)$config['last_daily_cycle_at']
            : 0;

        $now = time();
        $autoSyncEnabled = isset($config['price_sync_enabled'])
            ? !empty($config['price_sync_enabled'])
            : (!isset($config['auto_sync_enabled']) || !empty($config['auto_sync_enabled']));

        if ($lastCycleAt <= 0) {
            // Se nunca executou, marca como vencido para disparar a primeira rodada
            $nextCycleAt = $now;
            $secondsRemaining = 0;
            $isDue = true;
        } else {
            $nextCycleAt = $lastCycleAt + $intervalSeconds;
            $secondsRemaining = max(0, $nextCycleAt - $now);
            $isDue = ($secondsRemaining === 0);
        }

        $hours = (int)floor($secondsRemaining / 3600);
        $minutes = (int)floor(($secondsRemaining % 3600) / 60);
        $seconds = (int)($secondsRemaining % 60);
        $formatted = sprintf('%02d:%02d:%02d', $hours, $minutes, $seconds);

        return [
            'last_cycle_at'       => $lastCycleAt,
            'last_cycle_date'     => $lastCycleAt > 0 ? date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $lastCycleAt) : 'Pendente de primeira execução',
            'next_cycle_at'       => $nextCycleAt,
            'next_cycle_date'     => date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $nextCycleAt),
            'interval_seconds'    => $intervalSeconds,
            'seconds_remaining'   => $secondsRemaining,
            'formatted_remaining' => $formatted,
            'is_due'              => $isDue,
            'auto_sync_enabled'   => $autoSyncEnabled,
            'official_categories' => self::OFFICIAL_CATEGORIES,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Retorna os metadados da Sentinela de Preços e Estoque de 6 Horas.
     */
    public function getPriceSyncInfo(): array
    {
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $intervalSeconds = (int)($config['price_sync_interval_seconds'] ?? 21600); // 6 horas padrão (21600s)
        if ($intervalSeconds <= 0) {
            $intervalSeconds = 21600;
        }

        $lastSyncAt = isset($config['last_price_sync_at']) && is_numeric($config['last_price_sync_at'])
            ? (int)$config['last_price_sync_at']
            : 0;

        $now = time();
        $autoSyncEnabled = isset($config['price_sync_enabled'])
            ? !empty($config['price_sync_enabled'])
            : (!isset($config['auto_sync_enabled']) || !empty($config['auto_sync_enabled']));

        if ($lastSyncAt <= 0) {
            $nextSyncAt = $now;
            $secondsRemaining = 0;
            $isDue = true;
        } else {
            $nextSyncAt = $lastSyncAt + $intervalSeconds;
            $secondsRemaining = max(0, $nextSyncAt - $now);
            $isDue = ($secondsRemaining === 0);
        }

        $hours = (int)floor($secondsRemaining / 3600);
        $minutes = (int)floor(($secondsRemaining % 3600) / 60);
        $seconds = (int)($secondsRemaining % 60);
        $formatted = sprintf('%02d:%02d:%02d', $hours, $minutes, $seconds);

        return [
            'last_sync_at'        => $lastSyncAt,
            'last_sync_date'      => $lastSyncAt > 0 ? date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $lastSyncAt) : 'Pendente de primeira execução',
            'next_sync_at'        => $nextSyncAt,
            'next_sync_date'      => date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $nextSyncAt),
            'interval_seconds'    => $intervalSeconds,
            'seconds_remaining'   => $secondsRemaining,
            'formatted_remaining' => $formatted,
            'is_due'              => $isDue,
            'auto_sync_enabled'   => $autoSyncEnabled,
            'volatility_percent'  => (float)($config['volatility_index_percent'] ?? 12.0),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Executa a varredura da Sentinela de Preços e Estoque a cada 6 horas:
     * Consulta o fornecedor no AliExpress, aplica o Índice de Correção de Volatilidade (12%)
     * e ajusta preços de venda em R$ ou pausa produtos esgotados.
     *
     * @param int $batchLimit Quantidade máxima de produtos verificados por rodada
     * @return array<string, mixed> Relatório estatístico da varredura
     */
    public function runPriceAndStockSync(int $batchLimit = 50): array
    {
        $lockPath = $this->getConfigFilePath() . '.price_sync.lock';
        $lockDir = dirname($lockPath);
        if (!is_dir($lockDir)) {
            @mkdir($lockDir, 0775, true);
        }

        $lockHandle = @fopen($lockPath, 'c+');
        if ($lockHandle === false) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'skipped' => true,
                'reason'  => 'lock_file_unavailable',
                'executed_at' => 0,
            ];
        }

        if (!flock($lockHandle, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
            fclose($lockHandle);
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'skipped' => true,
                'reason'  => 'sync_already_running',
                'executed_at' => 0,
            ];
        }

        try {
            $config = $this->loadConfig();
            $volatility = (float)($config['volatility_index_percent'] ?? 12.0);
            $markup = (float)($config['default_markup_percent'] ?? 100.0);
            $products = $this->repository->list(['status' => 'published'], $batchLimit, 0);

            $checked = 0;
            $adjusted = 0;
            $paused = 0;
            $deletedNotFound = 0;
            $unchanged = 0;

            foreach ($products as $prod) {
                $checked++;
                try {
                    $aeId = (string)$prod->aliexpressId;
                    if ($aeId === '') {
                        continue;
                    }

                    // 0. Verifica disponibilidade real do link (mesmo em modo teste e mesmo com imagem já indexada)
                    // Se o anúncio no fornecedor retornou 404 / "Página não encontrada" (ex: promo relâmpago encerrada), exclui o card automaticamente.
                    if ($this->isProductLinkConfirmedNotFound($aeId)) {
                        if ($prod->id !== null && $prod->id > 0) {
                            $this->repository->delete((int)$prod->id);
                            $deletedNotFound++;
                        }
                        continue;
                    }

                    // 1. Tenta obter o preço atualizado via API oficial do AliExpress
                    $remoteData = null;
                    try {
                        $remoteData = $this->apiClient->getProductDetails($aeId);
                    } catch (Throwable $e) {
                        $remoteData = null;
                    }

                    $newCostUsd = null;
                    $newCostBrl = null;

                    if (!empty($remoteData) && is_array($remoteData)) {
                        $baseInfo = $remoteData['ae_item_base_info_dto'] ?? ($remoteData['result']['ae_item_base_info_dto'] ?? []);
                        if (!empty($baseInfo['target_sale_price'])) {
                            $newCostUsd = (float)$baseInfo['target_sale_price'];
                        }
                    }

                    // 2. Se a API remota não trouxer, consulta o Scraper
                    if ($newCostUsd === null || $newCostUsd <= 0.0) {
                        try {
                            $scraped = $this->linkScraper->scrape($aeId);
                            if ($scraped !== null) {
                                if (!empty($scraped->attributes['cost_price_brl'])) {
                                    $newCostBrl = (float)$scraped->attributes['cost_price_brl'];
                                } elseif ($scraped->costPriceUsd > 0.0) {
                                    $newCostUsd = $scraped->costPriceUsd;
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (Throwable $e) {
                            // Silencioso
                        }
                    }

                    // 3. Aplica o recálculo com o Índice de Volatilidade de 12%
                    $currentSalePrice = (float)$prod->salePriceBrl;
                    $calculatedPrice = 0.0;

                    if ($newCostBrl !== null && $newCostBrl > 0.0) {
                        $calculatedPrice = $this->currencyConverter->calculateSalePriceFromBrl($newCostBrl, $markup, $volatility);
                    } elseif ($newCostUsd !== null && $newCostUsd > 0.0) {
                        $calculatedPrice = $this->currencyConverter->calculateSalePrice($newCostUsd, $markup, null, $volatility);
                    } else {
                        $calculatedPrice = $this->currencyConverter->calculateSalePrice($prod->costPriceUsd, $markup, null, $volatility);
                    }

                    // Se a variação de preço for maior que R$ 0,50, atualiza o produto
                    if ($calculatedPrice > 0.0 && abs($calculatedPrice - $currentSalePrice) >= 0.50) {
                        $updatedAttrs = $prod->attributes;
                        $updatedAttrs['last_price_sync_at'] = time();
                        $updatedAttrs['volatility_index_applied'] = $volatility;
                        $updatedAttrs['previous_sale_price_brl'] = $currentSalePrice;

                        $updatedDto = new DropshipProductDto(
                            aliexpressId: $prod->aliexpressId,
                            title: $prod->title,
                            slug: $prod->slug,
                            costPriceUsd: $newCostUsd ?? $prod->costPriceUsd,
                            salePriceBrl: $calculatedPrice,
                            mainImageUrl: $prod->mainImageUrl,
                            images: $prod->images,
                            category: $prod->category,
                            description: $prod->description,
                            rating: $prod->rating,
                            ordersCount: $prod->ordersCount,
                            attributes: $updatedAttrs,
                            id: $prod->id,
                            status: $prod->status
                        );

                        $this->repository->save($updatedDto);
                        $adjusted++;
                    } else {
                        $unchanged++;
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Isolamento de falha individual por produto
                }
            }

            $now = time();
            $this->updateConfigField('last_price_sync_at', $now);

            return [
                'success'             => true,
                'executed_at'         => $now,
                'executed_date'       => date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $now),
                'products_checked'    => $checked,
                'prices_adjusted'     => $adjusted,
                'unchanged_prices'    => $unchanged,
                'paused_out_of_stock' => $paused,
                'deleted_not_found'   => $deletedNotFound,
                'volatility_applied'  => $volatility,
            ];
        } finally {
            flock($lockHandle, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($lockHandle);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Consulta o SDK oficial do AliExpress (`aliexpress.ds.product.get`) para saber se o produto
     * existe ('alive'), foi removido/não encontrado ('not_found') ou está sem credenciais/indeterminado ('unknown').
     */
    public static function checkAvailabilityViaApiClient(AliExpressApiClientInterface $apiClient, string $aliexpressId): string
    {
        $aeId = trim($aliexpressId);
        if ($aeId === '') {
            return 'unknown';
        }

        try {
            $remote = $apiClient->getProductDetails($aeId);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return self::classifyApiExceptionAvailability($e);
        }

        return self::classifyApiDetailsAvailability($remote);
    }

    public static function classifyApiExceptionAvailability(Throwable $e): string
    {
        $msg = strtolower($e->getMessage());
        $type = '';
        if ($e instanceof \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Exceptions\AliExpressApiException) {
            $type = strtolower($e->type);
        }

        // 1. Erros de Autenticação / Permissão / Token / Chaves / Assinatura (NUNCA exclui produtos)
        $authMarkers = [
            'access_token',
            'missingparameter',
            'invalidsession',
            'illegalaccesstoken',
            'invalidappkey',
            'incompletesignature',
            'signature',
            'unauthorized',
            'forbidden',
            'auth_required',
            'needs_reauth',
            'session_expired',
            'session',
            'invalidcode',
            'illegalrefreshtoken',
            'invalid_token',
        ];
        foreach ($authMarkers as $marker) {
            if (str_contains($msg, $marker) || ($type !== '' && str_contains($type, $marker))) {
                return 'sdk_auth_required';
            }
        }

        // 2. Erros de Quota / Limite de Requisições / Rate Limiting (NUNCA exclui produtos)
        $rateLimitMarkers = [
            'appcallquotaexceeded',
            'quota_exceeded',
            'quota',
            'ratelimit',
            'rate limit',
            'too many requests',
            'throttle',
            'busy',
            'concurrent',
        ];
        foreach ($rateLimitMarkers as $marker) {
            if (str_contains($msg, $marker) || ($type !== '' && str_contains($type, $marker))) {
                return 'rate_limited';
            }
        }

        // 3. Erros de Rede, Conexão, DNS, Timeout, Gateway HTTP (NUNCA exclui produtos)
        $networkMarkers = [
            'timeout',
            'timed out',
            'connection refused',
            'curl',
            'resolve',
            'dns',
            'gateway',
            'serviceunavailable',
            'service unavailable',
            'maintenance',
            'internal error',
            'system error',
            'connection_error',
            'http_500',
            'http_502',
            'http_503',
            'http_504',
            'ssl',
        ];
        foreach ($networkMarkers as $marker) {
            if (str_contains($msg, $marker) || ($type !== '' && str_contains($type, $marker))) {
                return 'network_or_system_error';
            }
        }

        // 4. Somente marcadores específicos de PRODUTO/ITEM inexistente ou despublicado pelo fornecedor
        $specificNotFoundMarkers = [
            'item_not_found',
            'item_not_exist',
            'product_not_found',
            'product_not_exist',
            'item does not exist',
            'product does not exist',
            'invalid item id',
            'invalid product id',
            'item_id_not_found',
            'item-not-exist',
            'all sku unsaleable',
            'product offline',
            'item offline',
        ];
        foreach ($specificNotFoundMarkers as $marker) {
            if (str_contains($msg, $marker) || ($type !== '' && str_contains($type, $marker))) {
                return 'not_found';
            }
        }

        return 'unknown';
    }

    /**
     * @param mixed $remote
     */
    public static function classifyApiDetailsAvailability(mixed $remote): string
    {
        if (!is_array($remote) || empty($remote)) {
            return 'unknown';
        }

        $baseInfo = $remote['ae_item_base_info_dto']
            ?? ($remote['result']['ae_item_base_info_dto']
            ?? ($remote['aliexpress_ds_product_get_response']['result']['ae_item_base_info_dto'] ?? null));
        if (is_array($baseInfo)) {
            $statusType = strtolower(trim((string)($baseInfo['product_status_type'] ?? '')));
            if (in_array($statusType, ['offline', 'deleted', 'auditing_failed'], true)) {
                return 'not_found';
            }
            if (!empty($baseInfo['subject']) || !empty($baseInfo['product_id'])) {
                return 'alive';
            }
        }

        return 'unknown';
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se a página do produto no fornecedor foi confirmada como inexistente (404 / "Página não encontrada").
     * Prioriza o SDK oficial do AliExpress (sem captcha) e usa o scraper apenas como fallback quando o SDK estiver indisponível.
     */
    private function isProductLinkConfirmedNotFound(string $aliexpressId): bool
    {
        $sdkStatus = self::checkAvailabilityViaApiClient($this->apiClient, $aliexpressId);
        if ($sdkStatus === 'not_found') {
            return true;
        }
        if ($sdkStatus === 'alive') {
            return false;
        }

        if (method_exists($this->linkScraper, 'checkAvailability')) {
            return $this->linkScraper->checkAvailability($aliexpressId) === 'not_found';
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Varre anúncios publicados e exclui automaticamente cards cujo link no AliExpress
     * retornou "Página não encontrada" / 404 (ex.: promoção relâmpago encerrada).
     */
    public function purgeNotFoundProducts(int $batchLimit = 50): int
    {
        $deleted = 0;
        $products = $this->repository->list(['status' => 'published'], $batchLimit, 0);
        foreach ($products as $prod) {
            $aeId = (string)$prod->aliexpressId;
            if ($aeId === '' || $prod->id === null || $prod->id <= 0) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                if ($this->isProductLinkConfirmedNotFound($aeId)) {
                    if ($this->repository->delete((int)$prod->id)) {
                        $deleted++;
                    }
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Isolamento de falha por item
            }
        }
        return $deleted;
    }

    /**
     * Verifica ao vivo (no clique do botão Comprar) se o anúncio ainda existe no fornecedor
     * e consulta o estoque atual via SDK do AliExpress quando disponível.
     *
     * @return array{available: bool, reason: string, message: string, stock: ?int, stock_source: string}
     */
    public function checkLiveProductAvailability(DropshipProductDto $product, string $skuId = ''): array
    {
        $aeId = trim((string)$product->aliexpressId);

        // 1. Consulta o SDK oficial do AliExpress uma única vez (disponibilidade + estoque)
        $remote = null;
        $sdkStatus = 'unknown';
        if ($aeId !== '') {
            try {
                $remote = $this->apiClient->getProductDetails($aeId);
                $sdkStatus = self::classifyApiDetailsAvailability($remote);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $sdkStatus = self::classifyApiExceptionAvailability($e);
            }
        }

        if ($sdkStatus === 'not_found'
            || ($sdkStatus === 'unknown' && $aeId !== '' && method_exists($this->linkScraper, 'checkAvailability') && $this->linkScraper->checkAvailability($aeId) === 'not_found')
        ) {
            if ($product->id !== null && $product->id > 0) {
                $this->repository->delete((int)$product->id);
            }
            return [
                'available'    => false,
                'reason'       => 'not_found',
                'message'      => 'O estoque deste produto já acabou e o anúncio não está mais disponível no fornecedor.',
                'stock'        => 0,
                'stock_source' => $sdkStatus === 'not_found' ? 'aliexpress_sdk' : 'supplier_page',
            ];
        }

        // 2. Extrai estoque atual real a partir da mesma resposta do SDK do AliExpress
        $sdkStock = null;
        if (is_array($remote) && !empty($remote)) {
                    $sdkNode = $remote['ae_item_sku_info_dtos']['ae_item_sku_info_d_t_o']
                        ?? ($remote['result']['ae_item_sku_info_dtos']['ae_item_sku_info_d_t_o'] ?? null);
                    if (is_array($sdkNode) && !empty($sdkNode)) {
                        $skuList = isset($sdkNode['sku_id']) || isset($sdkNode['id']) ? [$sdkNode] : $sdkNode;
                        $matchedStock = null;
                        $totalStock = 0;
                        $hasNumericStock = false;
                        foreach ($skuList as $sku) {
                            if (!is_array($sku)) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            if (isset($sku['sku_available_stock']) || isset($sku['sku_stock'])) {
                                $sVal = max(0, (int)($sku['sku_available_stock'] ?? $sku['sku_stock']));
                                $hasNumericStock = true;
                                $totalStock += $sVal;
                                $curSkuId = (string)($sku['sku_id'] ?? ($sku['id'] ?? ''));
                                if ($skuId !== '' && $curSkuId === $skuId) {
                                    $matchedStock = $sVal;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if ($matchedStock !== null) {
                            $sdkStock = $matchedStock;
                        } elseif ($hasNumericStock) {
                            $sdkStock = $totalStock;
                        }
                    }

                    if ($sdkStock === null) {
                        $baseInfo = $remote['ae_item_base_info_dto'] ?? ($remote['result']['ae_item_base_info_dto'] ?? []);
                        if (is_array($baseInfo) && (isset($baseInfo['total_available_stock']) || isset($baseInfo['stock']))) {
                            $sdkStock = max(0, (int)($baseInfo['total_available_stock'] ?? $baseInfo['stock']));
                        }
                    }
        }

        if ($sdkStock !== null) {
            if ($sdkStock <= 0) {
                return [
                    'available'    => false,
                    'reason'       => 'out_of_stock',
                    'message'      => 'O estoque deste produto já acabou no momento.',
                    'stock'        => 0,
                    'stock_source' => 'aliexpress_sdk',
                ];
            }

            return [
                'available'    => true,
                'reason'       => 'in_stock',
                'message'      => "Estoque atual confirmado: {$sdkStock} unidade(s) disponíveis.",
                'stock'        => $sdkStock,
                'stock_source' => 'aliexpress_sdk',
            ];
        }

        // 3. Fallback para estoque local da variante selecionada (caso SDK não retorne contagem)
        if ($skuId !== '') {
            $variant = $product->findVariantBySku($skuId);
            if ($variant !== null) {
                if ($variant->stock <= 0) {
                    return [
                        'available'    => false,
                        'reason'       => 'out_of_stock',
                        'message'      => 'O estoque da variação selecionada já acabou.',
                        'stock'        => 0,
                        'stock_source' => 'catalog_variant',
                    ];
                }
                return [
                    'available'    => true,
                    'reason'       => 'in_stock',
                    'message'      => "Estoque disponível: {$variant->stock} unidade(s).",
                    'stock'        => $variant->stock,
                    'stock_source' => 'catalog_variant',
                ];
            }
        }

        return [
            'available'    => true,
            'reason'       => 'available',
            'message'      => 'Produto disponível para compra.',
            'stock'        => null,
            'stock_source' => 'catalog',
        ];
    }

    private function getConfigFilePath(): string
    {
        if ($this->configFilePath !== null) {
            return $this->configFilePath;
        }
        $root = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4);
        return $root . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json';
    }

    private function loadConfig(): array
    {
        $file = $this->getConfigFilePath();
        if (file_exists($file)) {
            $content = @file_get_contents($file);
            if ($content !== false) {
                $data = json_decode($content, true);
                if (is_array($data)) {
                    return $data;
                }
            }
        }
        return [
            'enabled'                => true,
            'auto_sync_enabled'      => true,
            'cycle_interval_seconds' => 86400,
        ];
    }

    private function updateConfigField(string $key, mixed $value): void
    {
        $file = $this->getConfigFilePath();
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $config[$key] = $value;
        $dir = dirname($file);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
        }
        @file_put_contents($file, json_encode($config, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/SellerMediationService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Contracts\EmailSenderInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Serviço de Intermediação de Reclamações com Fornecedor (1 clique no admin).
 * Mantém português para fornecedores brasileiros e traduz para chinês simplificado (zh-CN)
 * quando o fornecedor for da China/Internacional.
 */
class SellerMediationService
{
    /** @var callable|null */
    private $translatorCallback;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface $disputeRepo,
        private readonly ?EmailSenderInterface $mailer = null,
        ?callable $translatorCallback = null
    ) {
        $this->translatorCallback = $translatorCallback;
    }

    /**
     * Monta, traduz (se chinês) e registra/envia a intermediação ao vendedor em 1 chamada.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $order
     * @param array<string, mixed> $dispute
     * @param string $baseUrl
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function sendMediation(array $order, array $dispute, string $baseUrl = ''): array
    {
        $sellerOrigin = strtoupper(trim((string)($dispute['seller_origin'] ?: ($order['seller_origin'] ?? 'CN'))));
        if ($sellerOrigin !== 'BR') {
            $sellerOrigin = 'CN';
        }

        $language = $sellerOrigin === 'BR' ? 'pt-BR' : 'zh-CN';
        $message = $this->composeMessage($order, $dispute, $language, $baseUrl);

        $sellerEmail = trim((string)($dispute['seller_email'] ?: ($order['seller_email'] ?? '')));
        $channel = 'aliexpress_mediation_log';
        $emailDispatched = false;

        if ($sellerEmail !== '' && filter_var($sellerEmail, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false && $this->mailer !== null) {
            $subject = $language === 'zh-CN'
                ? '[售后订单协助] 订单 ' . (string)($order['order_ref'] ?? '') . ' 客户反馈处理'
                : '[Mediação de Pedido] ' . (string)($order['order_ref'] ?? '') . ' - Reclamação de Cliente';
            try {
                $this->mailer->send($sellerEmail, $subject, $message);
                $channel = 'email';
                $emailDispatched = true;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Registra como disponível no painel sem interromper a operação do administrador.
                $channel = 'email_fallback_log';
            }
        }

        $disputeId = (int)($dispute['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($disputeId > 0) {
            $this->disputeRepo->markMediationSent($disputeId, $language, $message, $channel);
        }

        return [
            'success'           => true,
            'dispute_id'        => $disputeId,
            'seller_origin'     => $sellerOrigin,
            'seller_language'   => $language,
            'channel'           => $channel,
            'email_dispatched'  => $emailDispatched,
            'translated_message'=> $message,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Gera a mensagem completa de intermediação no idioma do fornecedor.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $order
     * @param array<string, mixed> $dispute
     */
    public function composeMessage(array $order, array $dispute, string $language, string $baseUrl = ''): string
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($order['order_ref'] ?? '');
        $aeOrderId = (string)($order['aliexpress_order_id'] ?? 'N/A');
        $trackingCode = (string)($order['tracking_code'] ?? 'N/A');
        $reasonCode = (string)($dispute['reason'] ?? 'produto_danificado');
        $descriptionPt = trim((string)($dispute['description'] ?? ''));
        $attachments = is_array($dispute['attachments'] ?? null) ? $dispute['attachments'] : [];
        $disputeId = (int)($dispute['id'] ?? 0);

        $attachmentLines = [];
        foreach ($attachments as $att) {
            if (!is_array($att)) {
                continue;
            }
            $file = (string)($att['filename'] ?? '');
            $orig = (string)($att['original_name'] ?? $file);
            if ($file === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $url = rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '/dropship/disputes/attachment/' . $disputeId . '/' . rawurlencode($file);
            $attachmentLines[] = "- {$orig}: {$url}";
        }
        $evidenceText = $attachmentLines !== []
            ? implode("\n", $attachmentLines)
            : ($language === 'zh-CN' ? '暂无附件' : 'Nenhum arquivo anexado.');

        if ($language === 'pt-BR') {
            $reasonPt = $this->reasonLabelPt($reasonCode);

            return implode("\n", [
                "Prezado Fornecedor (Brasil),",
                "Encaminhamos uma solicitação de intermediação de pós-venda aberta pelo cliente comprador.",
                "",
                "Pedido Loja: {$orderRef}",
                "Pedido AliExpress: {$aeOrderId}",
                "Código de Rastreio: {$trackingCode}",
                "Motivo: {$reasonPt}",
                "",
                "Descrição do Problema (Cliente):",
                $descriptionPt,
                "",
                "Evidências / Fotos / PDF:",
                $evidenceText,
                "",
                "Solicitamos retorno com orientação de reembolso, troca ou solução amigável dentro do prazo de garantia.",
            ]);
        }

        $translatedProblem = $this->translatePortugueseToChinese($descriptionPt);
        $reasonZh = $this->reasonLabelZh($reasonCode);

        return implode("\n", [
            "尊敬的供应商您好：",
            "我们收到买家的售后服务/退款沟通请求，请协助核实并处理以下订单问题：",
            "",
            "店铺订单号 (Loja): {$orderRef}",
            "速卖通订单号 (AliExpress Order ID): {$aeOrderId}",
            "物流追踪号 (Tracking): {$trackingCode}",
            "问题类型: {$reasonZh}",
            "",
            "问题详情（中文翻译）:",
            $translatedProblem,
            "",
            "客户原始反馈 (Original PT-BR):",
            $descriptionPt,
            "",
            "买家提供的凭证（图片 / PDF 文件）:",
            $evidenceText,
            "",
            "请告知补发、部分退款或全额退款方案，谢谢您的配合！",
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Traduz frases e termos comuns de reclamação PT-BR para Chinês Simplificado (zh-CN).
     */
    public function translatePortugueseToChinese(string $text): string
    {
        if ($this->translatorCallback !== null) {
            $custom = (string)call_user_func($this->translatorCallback, $text);
            if (trim($custom) !== '') {
                return $custom;
            }
        }

        $normalized = trim($text);
        if ($normalized === '') {
            return '买家反馈商品存在问题，请协助核实。';
        }

        $dictionary = [
            'produto danificado'       => '商品损坏',
            'chegou com dano'          => '到货时已损坏',
            'chegou quebrado'          => '到货时已破损',
            'veio quebrado'            => '收到时已破损',
            'embalagem violada'        => '外包装破损',
            'embalagem amassada'       => '包装严重变形',
            'entrega atrasada'         => '物流严重延迟',
            'atraso na entrega'        => '配送超时延迟',
            'nao chegou'               => '尚未收到包裹',
            'não chegou'               => '尚未收到包裹',
            'pacote perdido'           => '包裹疑似丢失',
            'produto errado'           => '发错商品',
            'item errado'              => '商品与下单不符',
            'cor errada'               => '颜色错误',
            'tamanho errado'           => '尺寸/尺码错误',
            'nao funciona'             => '无法正常使用',
            'não funciona'             => '无法正常使用',
            'com defeito'              => '存在功能缺陷',
            'faltando peças'           => '缺少零件或配件',
            'faltando acessorios'      => '缺少配件',
            'faltando acessórios'      => '缺少配件',
            'solicito reembolso'       => '申请退款',
            'quero reembolso'          => '要求全额退款',
            'reembolso total'          => '全额退款',
            'troca do produto'         => '申请换货/补发',
            'em anexo'                 => '详见附件照片/PDF',
            'segue foto'               => '已附实拍照片',
            'segue pdf'                => '已附PDF证明文件',
            'vidro quebrado'           => '玻璃已碎裂',
            'tela trincada'            => '屏幕破裂',
            'arranhado'                => '表面有划痕',
            'molhado'                  => '商品受潮进水',
        ];

        $lower = mb_strtolower($normalized, 'UTF-8');
        $matchedSegments = [];
        foreach ($dictionary as $pt => $zh) {
            if (str_contains($lower, $pt)) {
                $matchedSegments[] = $zh;
            }
        }

        $unique = array_values(array_unique($matchedSegments));
        if ($unique !== []) {
            return '核心问题：' . implode('；', $unique) . '。';
        }

        return '买家反馈订单存在售后问题，请结合附件图片/PDF与原始葡语说明核实处理。';
    }

    private function reasonLabelPt(string $reason): string
    {
        return match ($reason) {
            'produto_danificado' => 'Produto Danificado / Avaria',
            'entrega_atrasada'   => 'Entrega em Atraso / Extravio',
            'item_errado'        => 'Produto Diferente / Incompleto',
            'arrependimento'     => 'Devolução / Garantia 7 a 15 Dias',
            default              => 'Solicitação de Suporte / Reembolso',
        };
    }

    private function reasonLabelZh(string $reason): string
    {
        return match ($reason) {
            'produto_danificado' => '商品损坏 / 运输受损',
            'entrega_atrasada'   => '物流延迟 / 包裹疑丢失',
            'item_errado'        => '错发 / 漏发商品',
            'arrependimento'     => '退货退款申请 (7-15天无理由/售后)',
            default              => '订单售后协商 / 退款请求',
        };
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain_drop/Services/SessionGuardedDemandTracker.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandMetricsRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandTrackerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DemandEvent;

/**
 * Rastreia cliques com proteção anti-ruído baseada na sessão (SRP).
 */
final class SessionGuardedDemandTracker implements DemandTrackerInterface
{
    /**
     * Debounce mínimo (em segundos) apenas para prevenir duplo-clique acidental de mouse.
     * Permite auditoria imediata no exato tempo de cada interação do visitante.
     */
    private const DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS = 2;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly DemandMetricsRepositoryInterface $repository,
        private readonly ?SessionManagerInterface $session = null,
        private readonly int $debounceSeconds = self::DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS,
        private readonly ?\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DemandLogStorageInterface $logStorage = null
    ) {
    }

    public function recordInteraction(DemandEvent $event): bool
    {
        $productId = trim($event->productId);
        if ($productId === '') {
            return false;
        }

        // Valida duplicação na sessão (evita F5 e cliques repetidos inflarem o placar)
        if ($this->isDuplicate($productId, $event->actionType)) {
            return false;
        }

        // 1. Registra no arquivo JSON mensal (sem poluir o banco de dados)
        if ($this->logStorage !== null) {
            $this->logStorage->appendInteraction($event);
        }

        // 2. Incrementa a métrica consolidada agregada no banco de dados
        $this->repository->incrementMetric(
            $productId,
            $event->productTitle,
            $event->categorySlug,
            $event->actionType,
            $event
        );

        return true;
    }

    public function promoteSession(
        string $sessionId,
        int $customerId,
        string $customerName,
        string $customerEmail,
        ?string $ipAddress = null
    ): int {
        $ip = $ipAddress ?: DemandEvent::resolveClientIp();
        $promoted = 0;

        if ($this->logStorage !== null) {
            $promoted += $this->logStorage->promoteInteractions(
                $sessionId,
                $customerId,
                $customerName,
                $customerEmail,
                $ip
            );
        }

        if ($this->repository instanceof DemandMetricsRepositoryInterface) {
            $promoted += $this->repository->promoteInteractions(
                $sessionId,
                $customerId,
                $customerName,
                $customerEmail,
                $ip
            );
        }

        return $promoted;
    }

    private function isDuplicate(string $productId, string $actionType): bool
    {
        if ($this->session === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Conversões de venda real nunca são barradas por trava de clique
        if ($actionType === 'conversion') {
            return false;
        }

        $sessionKey = 'tracked_drop_' . $actionType . '_' . md5($productId);
        $lastRecorded = (int)$this->session->get($sessionKey, 0);
        $now = time();

        if ($lastRecorded > 0 && ($now - $lastRecorded) < $this->debounceSeconds) {
            return true;
        }

        $this->session->set($sessionKey, $now);
        return false;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain_drop/ValueObjects/AliExpressToken.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\ValueObjects;

use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Value Object imutável representando o Token OAuth2 do AliExpress (SRP).
 */
final class AliExpressToken
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $accessToken,
        public readonly string $refreshToken,
        public readonly int $expiresIn,
        public readonly int $refreshExpiresIn,
        public readonly string $sellerId = '',
        public readonly string $accountId = '',
        public readonly string $accountPlatform = '',
        public readonly string $account = '',
        public readonly int $createdAt = 0
    ) {}

    /**
     * Desembrulha respostas com envelopes arbitrários (IOP SDK, simplify=false, gateways rest).
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $r
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function unwrapPayload(array $r): array
    {
        $current = $r;
        $knownKeys = [
            'data',
            'resp_result',
            'result',
            'aliexpress_open_token_create_response',
            '/auth/token/create_response',
            '/auth/token/refresh_response',
            '/wl/gray/first_response',
            'aliexpress_ds_text_search_response',
        ];

        for ($i = 0; $i < 4; $i++) {
            $unwrapped = false;
            foreach ($knownKeys as $k) {
                if (isset($current[$k]) && is_array($current[$k])) {
                    $current = array_merge($current, $current[$k]);
                    $unwrapped = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!$unwrapped && count($current) === 1) {
                $firstKey = (string)array_key_first($current);
                if ((str_ends_with($firstKey, '_response') || str_starts_with($firstKey, '/')) && is_array($current[$firstKey])) {
                    $current = array_merge($current, $current[$firstKey]);
                    $unwrapped = true;
                }
            }
            if (!$unwrapped) {
                break;
            }
        }

        return $current;
    }

    /**
     * Constrói o objeto a partir da resposta decodificada da API AliExpress.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $r
     */
    public static function fromApiResponse(array $r): self
    {
        $data = self::unwrapPayload($r);

        $accessToken = trim((string)($data['access_token'] ?? ''));
        if ($accessToken === '') {
            $raw = json_encode($r, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PARTIAL_OUTPUT_ON_ERROR);
            error_log("[AliExpressToken] Resposta do AliExpress sem access_token válido: {$raw}");
            throw new RuntimeException("Resposta do AliExpress não trouxe access_token válido.");
        }

        // Normalização de expiração: prioriza expires_in (segundos relativos)
        if (isset($data['expires_in']) && (int)$data['expires_in'] > 0) {
            $expiresInSeconds = (int)$data['expires_in'];
        } elseif (isset($data['expire_time'])) {
            $rawExpires = (int)$data['expire_time'];
            if ($rawExpires > 100000000000) {
                $expiresInSeconds = max(60, (int)round(($rawExpires / 1000) - time()));
            } elseif ($rawExpires > 1000000000) {
                $expiresInSeconds = max(60, $rawExpires - time());
            } else {
                $expiresInSeconds = max(60, $rawExpires);
            }
        } else {
            $expiresInSeconds = 2592000;
        }

        // Normalização de expiração do refresh token
        if (isset($data['refresh_expires_in']) && (int)$data['refresh_expires_in'] > 0) {
            $refreshSeconds = (int)$data['refresh_expires_in'];
        } elseif (isset($data['refresh_token_valid_time'])) {
            $rVal = (int)$data['refresh_token_valid_time'];
            if ($rVal > 100000000000) {
                $refreshSeconds = max(0, (int)round(($rVal / 1000) - time()));
            } elseif ($rVal > 1000000000) {
                $refreshSeconds = max(0, $rVal - time());
            } else {
                $refreshSeconds = max(0, $rVal);
            }
        } else {
            $refreshSeconds = 0;
        }

        $account = (string)($data['account'] ?? ($data['user_nick'] ?? ''));

        return new self(
            accessToken:      $accessToken,
            refreshToken:     (string)($data['refresh_token'] ?? ''),
            expiresIn:        $expiresInSeconds,
            refreshExpiresIn: $refreshSeconds,
            sellerId:         (string)($data['seller_id'] ?? ''),
            accountId:        (string)($data['account_id'] ?? ''),
            accountPlatform:  (string)($data['account_platform'] ?? ''),
            account:          $account,
            createdAt:        time()
        );
    }

    public function isExpired(): bool
    {
        if ($this->createdAt <= 0 || $this->expiresIn <= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        return time() >= ($this->createdAt + $this->expiresIn);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'access_token'             => $this->accessToken,
            'refresh_token'            => $this->refreshToken,
            'expires_in'               => $this->expiresIn,
            'refresh_expires_in'       => $this->refreshExpiresIn,
            'seller_id'                => $this->sellerId,
            'account_id'               => $this->accountId,
            'account_platform'         => $this->accountPlatform,
            'account'                  => $this->account,
            'created_at'               => $this->createdAt,
            'access_token_expires_at'  => $this->createdAt + $this->expiresIn,
            'refresh_token_expires_at' => $this->refreshExpiresIn > 0 ? ($this->createdAt + $this->refreshExpiresIn) : null,
        ];
    }
}

    function filterActivityLogs(filterType, btn) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.btn-act-filter').forEach(function(b) {
            b.style.background = '#0f172a';
            b.style.color = '#94a3b8';
            b.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
        });
        btn.style.background = '#3b82f6';
        btn.style.color = '#fff';
        btn.style.borderColor = '#3b82f6';

        document.querySelectorAll('.activity-row').forEach(function(row) {
            if (filterType === 'all') {
                row.style.display = '';
            } else if (filterType === 'logged') {
                row.style.display = row.classList.contains('row-logged') ? '' : 'none';
            } else if (filterType === 'anon') {
                row.style.display = row.classList.contains('row-anon') ? '' : 'none';
            }
        });
    }
    </script>

    <script>
    (function() {
        var adminRemSeconds = <?= $adminRemSeconds ?>;
        var hElem = document.getElementById('adminTimerH');
        var mElem = document.getElementById('adminTimerM');
        var sElem = document.getElementById('adminTimerS');
        var form = document.getElementById('formRunDailyCycle');
        var btn = document.getElementById('btnRunDailyCycle');

        if (form && btn) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.style.opacity = '0.7';
                btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Minerando 6 Categorias no AliExpress...';
            });
        }

        var adminAutoTickFired = false;
        function triggerAdminAutoCycle() {
            if (adminAutoTickFired) return;
            adminAutoTickFired = true;
            fetch('<?= $baseUrl ?>/dropship/cron-tick', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            })
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                if (data && typeof data.seconds_remaining === 'number' && data.seconds_remaining > 0) {
                    adminRemSeconds = data.seconds_remaining;
                    if (data.rotated) {
                        window.location.reload();
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(function() {});
        }

        setInterval(function() {
            if (adminRemSeconds <= 0) {
                if (hElem) hElem.textContent = '00';
                if (mElem) mElem.textContent = '00';
                if (sElem) sElem.textContent = '00';
                triggerAdminAutoCycle();
                return;
            }
            adminRemSeconds--;
            var h = Math.floor(adminRemSeconds / 3600);
            var m = Math.floor((adminRemSeconds % 3600) / 60);
            var s = adminRemSeconds % 60;
            if (hElem) hElem.textContent = String(h).padStart(2, '0');
            if (mElem) mElem.textContent = String(m).padStart(2, '0');
            if (sElem) sElem.textContent = String(s).padStart(2, '0');
        }, 1000);
    })();
    </script>

    <script>
        const systemExchangeRate = <?= (float)$rate ?>;
        const baseAdminUrl = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/dropship';

        function openPriceModal(id, title, costUsd, costBrl, saleBrl) {
            document.getElementById('modalProductId').value = id;
            document.getElementById('modalProductTitle').innerText = title;
            document.getElementById('modalProductTitle').title = title;
            document.getElementById('priceEditForm').action = baseAdminUrl + '/product/' + id + '/price';

            document.getElementById('modalCostBrl').value = parseFloat(costBrl).toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value = parseFloat(saleBrl).toFixed(2);

            recalcMargin();
            var modal = document.getElementById('priceEditModal');
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closePriceModal() {
            var modal = document.getElementById('priceEditModal');
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closePriceModal();
                closeImagesModal();
            }
        });

        const priceModalEl = document.getElementById('priceEditModal');
        if (priceModalEl) {
            priceModalEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === this) closePriceModal();
            });
        }

        const imagesModalEl = document.getElementById('imagesEditModal');
        if (imagesModalEl) {
            imagesModalEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === this) closeImagesModal();
            });
        }

        function recalcMargin() {
            const costBrl = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modalCostBrl').value) || 0;
            const saleBrl = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value) || 0;

            const costUsd = (systemExchangeRate > 0) ? (costBrl / systemExchangeRate) : 0;
            document.getElementById('modalCostUsdHint').innerText = '$' + costUsd.toFixed(2);

            const profit = saleBrl - costBrl;
            const margin = saleBrl > 0 ? ((profit / saleBrl) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;

            const profitEl = document.getElementById('modalProfitBrl');
            const marginEl = document.getElementById('modalMarginPercent');

            profitEl.innerText = (profit >= 0 ? '+R$ ' : '-R$ ') + Math.abs(profit).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
            profitEl.style.color = profit >= 0 ? '#5cd67d' : '#ef4444';

            marginEl.innerText = margin + '%';
            marginEl.style.color = margin >= 0 ? '#45f3ff' : '#ef4444';
        }

        function applyMarkup(percent) {
            const costBrl = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modalCostBrl').value) || 0;
            if (costBrl > 0) {
                const newSale = costBrl * (1 + (percent / 100));
                document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value = newSale.toFixed(2);
                recalcMargin();
            }
        }

        function roundTo90() {
            let sale = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value) || 0;
            if (sale > 0) {
                let rounded = Math.floor(sale) + 0.90;
                if (rounded < sale && (sale - rounded) > 0.4) {
                    rounded += 1;
                }
                document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value = rounded.toFixed(2);
                recalcMargin();
            }
        }

        function handlePriceSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const form = document.getElementById('priceEditForm');
            const id = document.getElementById('modalProductId').value;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnSavePrice');
            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Salvando...';

            const formData = new FormData(form);
            formData.append('ajax', '1');

            fetch(form.action, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: formData
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                if (data && data.success) {
                    // Atualiza os valores visuais no card na hora
                    const saleEl = document.getElementById('prod-sale-brl-' + id);
                    if (saleEl) saleEl.innerText = data.sale_formatted;

                    const costBrlEl = document.getElementById('prod-cost-brl-' + id);
                    if (costBrlEl) costBrlEl.innerText = data.cost_formatted;

                    const costUsdEl = document.getElementById('prod-cost-usd-' + id);
                    if (costUsdEl) costUsdEl.innerText = '$' + parseFloat(data.cost_price_usd).toFixed(2);

                    closePriceModal();
                    alert(data.message);
                } else {
                    alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha ao salvar preço.');
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                // Fallback para envio padrão se fetch falhar
                form.submit();
            });
        }

                mainImageUrl: item.mainImageUrl,
                images: Array.isArray(item.images) ? item.images.slice() : []
            };

            document.getElementById('imagesModalTitle').textContent = activeImagesState.title;
            document.getElementById('imagesModalTitle').title = activeImagesState.title;

            document.getElementById('imagesModalAeLink').href = isRealId
                ? 'https://www.aliexpress.com/item/' + encodeURIComponent(activeImagesState.aliexpressId) + '.html'
                : 'https://www.aliexpress.com/wholesale?SearchText=' + encodeURIComponent(activeImagesState.title);
            document.getElementById('imagesModalNewUrl').value = '';
            setImagesModalStatus('', 'info');
            renderImagesModalGrid();

        }

        function renderImagesModalGrid() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('imagesModalGrid');
            if (!grid) return;
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            if (!activeImagesState.images.length) {
                const empty = document.createElement('div');
                empty.style.cssText = 'grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: 26px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 8px; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 13px;';
                empty.textContent = 'Nenhuma imagem cadastrada ainda. Clique em "Sincronizar do AliExpress" ou cole uma URL abaixo.';
                grid.appendChild(empty);
                return;
            }

            activeImagesState.images.forEach(function(url, idx) {
                const isMain = (url === activeImagesState.mainImageUrl);

                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.style.cssText = 'background: #0b0f17; border: 1px solid ' + (isMain ? '#fbbf24' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)') + '; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column;';

                const thumbWrap = document.createElement('div');
                thumbWrap.style.cssText = 'position: relative; width: 100%; height: 120px; background: #070a10;';

                const img = document.createElement('img');
                img.src = url;
                img.alt = 'Foto ' + (idx + 1);
                img.style.cssText = 'width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;';
                thumbWrap.appendChild(img);

                if (isMain) {
                    const badge = document.createElement('span');
                    badge.style.cssText = 'position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 6px; background: #fbbf24; color: #0b0f17; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;';
                    badge.textContent = 'CAPA';
                    thumbWrap.appendChild(badge);
                }

                const openLink = document.createElement('a');
                openLink.href = url;
                openLink.target = '_blank';
                openLink.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
                openLink.title = 'Abrir imagem em tamanho original';
                openLink.style.cssText = 'position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); color: #45f3ff; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 11px; text-decoration: none;';
                openLink.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i>';

                const actions = document.createElement('div');

                coverBtn.disabled = isMain;
                coverBtn.style.cssText = 'flex: 1; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 4px; cursor: ' + (isMain ? 'default' : 'pointer') + '; border: 1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.35); background: ' + (isMain ? 'rgba(251,191,36,0.18)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)') + '; color: ' + (isMain ? '#fbbf24' : '#cbd5e1') + ';';
                coverBtn.textContent = isMain ? 'Capa Atual' : 'Definir Capa';

                    activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = url;

                };

                const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
                delBtn.type = 'button';
                delBtn.title = 'Remover foto da galeria';
                delBtn.style.cssText = 'padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.35); background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); color: #ef4444;';
                delBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-trash-alt"></i>';
                delBtn.onclick = function() {
                    activeImagesState.images.splice(idx, 1);
                    if (activeImagesState.mainImageUrl === url) {
                        activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = activeImagesState.images[0] || '';

                    renderImagesModalGrid();

                actions.appendChild(coverBtn);
