        function addManualImageUrl() {
            const input = document.getElementById('imagesModalNewUrl');
            const raw = (input ? input.value : '').trim();
            if (!/^https?:\/\/\S+$/i.test(raw)) {
                setImagesModalStatus('Informe uma URL válida começando com http:// ou https://', 'error');
                return;
            }
            if (!activeImagesState.images.includes(raw)) {
                activeImagesState.images.push(raw);
            }
            if (!activeImagesState.mainImageUrl) {
                activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = raw;
            }
            input.value = '';
            setImagesModalStatus('Imagem adicionada à prévia. Clique em "Salvar Galeria" para gravar.', 'info');
            renderImagesModalGrid();
        }

        function updateCardImagesUi(id, mainUrl, imagesList) {
            const imgEl = document.getElementById('prod-main-img-' + id);
            if (imgEl && mainUrl) {
                imgEl.src = mainUrl;
            }
            const badge = document.getElementById('prod-imgs-badge-' + id);
            const countEl = document.getElementById('prod-imgs-count-' + id);
            const count = Array.isArray(imagesList) ? imagesList.length : 0;
            if (countEl) countEl.textContent = String(count);
            if (badge) badge.style.display = count > 1 ? 'flex' : 'none';

            if (dropshipProductsMedia[String(id)]) {
                dropshipProductsMedia[String(id)].mainImageUrl = mainUrl;
                dropshipProductsMedia[String(id)].images = imagesList.slice();
            }
        }

        function syncImagesNow() {
            if (!activeImagesState.id) return;
            const id = activeImagesState.id;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnSyncImagesNow');
            const origHtml = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Sincronizando...';
            setImagesModalStatus('Consultando fotos oficiais direto do AliExpress...', 'info');

            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('csrf_token', dropshipCsrfToken);
            fd.append('ajax', '1');

            fetch(baseAdminUrl + '/product/' + id + '/sync-images', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: fd
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
                if (data && data.success) {
                    activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = data.main_image_url || '';
                    activeImagesState.images = Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : [];
                    renderImagesModalGrid();
                    updateCardImagesUi(id, activeImagesState.mainImageUrl, activeImagesState.images);
                    setImagesModalStatus(data.message || 'Imagens sincronizadas com sucesso!', 'success');
                } else {
                    setImagesModalStatus((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'O AliExpress bloqueou a coleta automática neste item. Você pode adicionar URLs de fotos manualmente abaixo.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
                setImagesModalStatus('Erro de comunicação ao sincronizar imagens.', 'error');
            });
        }

        function handleImagesSave() {
            if (!activeImagesState.id) return;
            const id = activeImagesState.id;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnSaveImagesGallery');
            const origHtml = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Salvando...';

            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('csrf_token', dropshipCsrfToken);
            fd.append('ajax', '1');
            fd.append('main_image_url', activeImagesState.mainImageUrl || '');
            fd.append('images_json', JSON.stringify(activeImagesState.images || []));

            fetch(baseAdminUrl + '/product/' + id + '/images', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: fd
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
                if (data && data.success) {
                    activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = data.main_image_url || '';
                    activeImagesState.images = Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : [];
                    renderImagesModalGrid();
                    updateCardImagesUi(id, activeImagesState.mainImageUrl, activeImagesState.images);
                    setImagesModalStatus(data.message || 'Galeria salva com sucesso!', 'success');
                } else {
                    setImagesModalStatus((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha ao salvar galeria.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
                setImagesModalStatus('Erro de comunicação ao salvar galeria.', 'error');
            });
        }

        // ========================================================
        // FILA DE SINCRONIZAÇÃO EM LOTE COM BARRA DE STATUS
        // ========================================================
        let batchSyncQueue = [];
        let batchSyncRunning = false;
        let batchSyncCancelled = false;
        let batchSyncedCount = 0;
        let batchSkippedCount = 0;
        let batchFailedCount = 0;

        function escapeBatchHtml(str) {
            if (str === null || str === undefined) return '';
            return String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) {
                return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[m];
            });
        }

        function openBatchMediaSyncModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('batchSyncModal');
            if (!modal) return;
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
            resetBatchSyncUI();

            appendBatchLog('Carregando inventário de produtos do catálogo...', 'info');
            fetch(baseAdminUrl + '/sync-queue')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data && data.success && Array.isArray(data.items)) {
                        batchSyncQueue = data.items;
                        document.getElementById('batchCountTotal').textContent = data.total;
                        document.getElementById('batchCountSingle').textContent = data.single_or_empty_count;
                        document.getElementById('batchStatTotal').textContent = data.total;
                        appendBatchLog('Inventário carregado: ' + data.total + ' produtos (' + data.single_or_empty_count + ' precisam de galeria completa).', 'success');
                    } else {
                        appendBatchLog('Aviso: Não foi possível carregar a lista de produtos.', 'warning');
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    appendBatchLog('Erro ao carregar fila: ' + err.message, 'error');
                });
        }

        function closeBatchSyncModal() {
            if (batchSyncRunning) {
                if (!confirm('A sincronização está em andamento. Deseja realmente interromper e fechar?')) {
                    return;
                }
                batchSyncCancelled = true;
            }
            const modal = document.getElementById('batchSyncModal');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function resetBatchSyncUI() {
            batchSyncRunning = false;
            batchSyncCancelled = false;
            batchSyncedCount = 0;
            batchSkippedCount = 0;
            batchFailedCount = 0;

            document.getElementById('batchStatSynced').textContent = '0';
            document.getElementById('batchStatSkipped').textContent = '0';
            document.getElementById('batchStatFailed').textContent = '0';
            document.getElementById('batchProgressBar').style.width = '0%';
            document.getElementById('batchProgressPercent').textContent = '0%';
            document.getElementById('batchProgressLabel').textContent = 'Pronto para iniciar';
            document.getElementById('batchSyncStatusBadge').textContent = 'Aguardando';
            document.getElementById('batchSyncStatusBadge').style.color = '#94a3b8';

            const logBox = document.getElementById('batchSyncLogConsole');
            logBox.innerHTML = '';

            document.getElementById('batchSyncConfigSection').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncAction').style.display = 'inline-flex';
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncAction').innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-play"></i> Iniciar Sincronização';
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncAction').disabled = false;
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncDone').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncCancel').textContent = 'Cancelar / Fechar';
        }

        function appendBatchLog(text, type = 'info') {
            const logBox = document.getElementById('batchSyncLogConsole');
            if (!logBox) return;
            const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            const line = document.createElement('div');
            
            let color = '#cbd5e1';
            let icon = 'ℹ️';
            if (type === 'success') { color = '#10b981'; icon = '✅'; }
            else if (type === 'warning' || type === 'skip') { color = '#f59e0b'; icon = '⏭️'; }
            else if (type === 'error') { color = '#ef4444'; icon = '❌'; }
            else if (type === 'active') { color = '#38bdf8'; icon = '⏳'; }

            line.style.color = color;
            line.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#64748b;">[${time}]</span> ${icon} ${escapeBatchHtml(text)}`;
            logBox.appendChild(line);
            logBox.scrollTop = logBox.scrollHeight;
        }

        async function startBatchSync() {
            if (batchSyncRunning) return;
            if (!batchSyncQueue.length) {
                alert('A fila de produtos ainda não foi carregada. Tente novamente em instantes.');
                return;
            }

            const modeRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="batchSyncMode"]:checked');
            const mode = modeRadio ? modeRadio.value : 'incomplete';

            batchSyncRunning = true;
            batchSyncCancelled = false;
            batchSyncedCount = 0;
            batchSkippedCount = 0;
            batchFailedCount = 0;

            document.getElementById('batchSyncConfigSection').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncAction').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncAction').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncCancel').textContent = 'Pausar / Interromper';
            document.getElementById('batchSyncStatusBadge').textContent = 'Executando em fila...';
            document.getElementById('batchSyncStatusBadge').style.color = '#38bdf8';

            const headerIcon = document.getElementById('batchSyncHeaderIcon');
            if (headerIcon) headerIcon.classList.add('fa-spin');

            const total = batchSyncQueue.length;
            appendBatchLog(`🚀 Fila iniciada no modo: ${mode === 'incomplete' ? 'Apenas galerias incompletas' : 'Todos os produtos'}. Total: ${total} itens.`, 'info');

            for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
                if (batchSyncCancelled) {
                    appendBatchLog('⏸️ Sincronização interrompida pelo usuário.', 'warning');
                    break;
                }

                const item = batchSyncQueue[i];
                const stepNum = i + 1;
                const percent = Math.round((stepNum / total) * 100);

                // Se o modo for apenas incompletos e o produto já tem mais de 1 imagem, verifica disponibilidade antes de preservar!
                if (mode === 'incomplete' && item.images_count > 1) {
                    let wasDeleted = false;
                    if (item.aliexpress_id && /^\d{10,20}$/.test(item.aliexpress_id)) {
                        try {
                            const chkRes = await fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl . '/api/drop/check-availability', JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?>, {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
                                body: JSON.stringify({ product_id: item.id })
                            });
                            const chkData = await chkRes.json();
                            if (chkData && chkData.available === false && chkData.reason === 'not_found') {
                                wasDeleted = true;
                                appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] 🗑️ Produto #${item.id} (${item.title}): Página Não Encontrada no fornecedor — excluído automaticamente!`, 'warning');
                                const cardEl = document.querySelector(`[data-product-id="${item.id}"]`);
                                if (cardEl) cardEl.remove();
                            }
                        } catch (e) {}
                    }
                    if (!wasDeleted) {
                        batchSkippedCount++;
                        document.getElementById('batchStatSkipped').textContent = batchSkippedCount;
                        appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] Produto #${item.id} (${item.title}): Já possui ${item.images_count} fotos. Preservado!`, 'skip');
                        updateBatchProgress(stepNum, total, percent, `Preservado: #${item.id} (${item.images_count} fotos)`);
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                // Valida se possui identificador oficial numérico
                if (!item.aliexpress_id || !/^\d{10,20}$/.test(item.aliexpress_id)) {
                    batchSkippedCount++;
                    document.getElementById('batchStatSkipped').textContent = batchSkippedCount;
                    appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] Produto #${item.id} (${item.title}): ID do fornecedor simulado ou inválido (${item.aliexpress_id}). Ignorado.`, 'warning');
                    updateBatchProgress(stepNum, total, percent, `Ignorado: #${item.id}`);
                    continue;
                }

                // Executa a requisição assíncrona unitária para este produto
                updateBatchProgress(stepNum, total, percent, `Sincronizando #${item.id}: ${item.title}...`);
                appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] Sincronizando Produto #${item.id} com o AliExpress (${item.aliexpress_id})...`, 'active');

                try {
                    const formData = new FormData();
                    formData.append('csrf_token', dropshipCsrfToken);
                    formData.append('ajax', '1');

                    const res = await fetch(baseAdminUrl + '/product/' + item.id + '/sync-images', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                            'Accept': 'application/json'
                        },
                        body: formData
                    });

                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data && data.deleted) {
                        appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] 🗑️ Produto #${item.id}: ${data.message || 'Página Não Encontrada — excluído automaticamente.'}`, 'warning');
                        const cardEl = document.querySelector(`[data-product-id="${item.id}"]`);
                        if (cardEl) cardEl.remove();
                    } else if (data && data.temporary_block) {
                        batchSkippedCount++;
                        document.getElementById('batchStatSkipped').textContent = batchSkippedCount;
                        appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] ${data.message || 'Captcha temporário do AliExpress — produto preservado.'}`, 'skip');
                    } else if (res.ok && data.success) {
                        batchSyncedCount++;
                        item.images_count = data.count || (Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images.length : 1);
                        document.getElementById('batchStatSynced').textContent = batchSyncedCount;
                        const priceLog = data.sale_formatted ? ` • Preço Venda: ${data.sale_formatted}` : '';
                        appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] Produto #${item.id} atualizado com sucesso! ${item.images_count} fotos${priceLog}`, 'success');
                        updateCardImagesUi(item.id, data.main_image_url || '', data.images || []);
                    } else {
                        batchFailedCount++;
                        document.getElementById('batchStatFailed').textContent = batchFailedCount;
                        appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] Falha no Produto #${item.id}: ${(data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Erro na requisição'}`, 'error');
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    batchFailedCount++;
                    document.getElementById('batchStatFailed').textContent = batchFailedCount;
                    appendBatchLog(`[${stepNum}/${total}] Erro de rede no Produto #${item.id}: ${err.message}`, 'error');
                }

                // Pausa suave de 250ms entre produtos para estabilidade da conexão
                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
            }

            // Finalização
            batchSyncRunning = false;
            if (headerIcon) headerIcon.classList.remove('fa-spin');

            document.getElementById('batchProgressBar').style.width = '100%';
            document.getElementById('batchProgressPercent').textContent = '100%';
            document.getElementById('batchProgressLabel').textContent = 'Sincronização 100% Concluída!';
            document.getElementById('batchSyncStatusBadge').textContent = 'Concluído 100%';
            document.getElementById('batchSyncStatusBadge').style.color = '#10b981';

            appendBatchLog(`🎉 Processo 100% finalizado! Atualizados: ${batchSyncedCount} | Preservados: ${batchSkippedCount} | Falhas: ${batchFailedCount}.`, 'success');

            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncDone').style.display = 'inline-flex';
            document.getElementById('btnBatchSyncCancel').textContent = 'Fechar';
        }

        function updateBatchProgress(current, total, percent, statusText) {
            document.getElementById('batchProgressBar').style.width = percent + '%';
            document.getElementById('batchProgressPercent').textContent = percent + '%';
            document.getElementById('batchProgressLabel').textContent = `[${current}/${total}] ${statusText}`;
        }

        function cancelBatchSync() {
            if (batchSyncRunning) {
                batchSyncCancelled = true;
            } else {
                closeBatchSyncModal();
            }
        }

        function finishAndReload() {
            window.location.reload();
        }
    </script>

<?php
/**
 * View Administrativa: Gestão de Pedidos, Barra Regressiva de SLA e Intermediação com Fornecedores
 *
 * @var array<int, array<string, mixed>> $orders
 * @var string $csrfToken
 * @var string $baseUrl
 * @var string|null $flashType
 * @var string|null $flashMsg
 * @var string $status
 * @var string $search
 */
$e = static fn (mixed $v): string => htmlspecialchars((string)$v, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

$totalOrders = count($orders);
$okDeliveredCount = 0;
$delayedCount = 0;
$disputeCount = 0;
$registeredCount = 0;

foreach ($orders as $ordItem) {
    $st = $ordItem['sla']['state'] ?? '';
    if ($st === 'ok_delivered') {
        $okDeliveredCount++;
    } elseif ($st === 'delayed_awaiting_customer') {
        $delayedCount++;
    } elseif ($st === 'complaint_open') {
        $disputeCount++;
    }
    if (!empty($ordItem['is_registered_customer'])) {
        $registeredCount++;
    }
}
?>

                <a href="<?= $e($baseUrl) ?>/admin/dropship" style="color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
                    <i class="fas fa-satellite-dish"></i> DomainDrop
                </a>
                <span style="color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size: 12px;">/</span>
                <span style="color: #ff4747; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;">Pedidos, SLA &amp; Mediação</span>
            </div>
            <h1 style="margin: 0; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;">
                <i class="fas fa-shipping-fast" style="color: #ff4747;"></i>
                Pedidos Dropshipping, Prazo Regressivo &amp; Intermediação
            </h1>
            <p style="margin: 6px 0 0 0; color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size: 13px;">
                Barra regressiva de entrega por cliente cadastrado (7 dias Brasil / 25 dias China), checagem de entrega via SDK e botão único de intermediação multilíngue (PT-BR / zh-CN).
            </p>
        </div>

        <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
            <a href="<?= $e($baseUrl) ?>/admin/dropship" class="btn" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.15)); color: #fff; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                <i class="fas fa-boxes"></i> Ver Catálogo
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- KPI Cards -->
    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px;">
        <div style="background: var(--bg-panel, #1d2327); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">Total / Cadastrados</div>
            <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-top: 4px;"><?= $totalOrders ?> <span style="font-size: 13px; color: #F0D060;">(<?= $registeredCount ?> cad.)</span></div>
        </div>
        <div style="background: var(--bg-panel, #1d2327); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.28); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #6ee7b7; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">Tudo Ok! Entregues</div>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var btnTest = document.getElementById('btnTestAliExpressConn');
        var resultBox = document.getElementById('connResultBox');
        var badge = document.getElementById('connBadge');
        var iconBadge = document.getElementById('connIconBadge');
        var title = document.getElementById('connTitle');

        if (!btnTest) return;

        btnTest.addEventListener('click', function() {
            var appKeyInput = document.querySelector('input[name="app_key"]');
            var appSecretInput = document.querySelector('input[name="app_secret"]');
            var accessTokenInput = document.querySelector('input[name="access_token"]');
            var csrfInput = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]');

            var originalHtml = btnTest.innerHTML;
            btnTest.disabled = true;
            btnTest.style.opacity = '0.7';
            btnTest.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Testando Conexão...';

            resultBox.style.display = 'block';
            resultBox.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.08)';
            resultBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.25)';
            resultBox.style.color = '#cbd5e1';
            resultBox.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sync fa-spin" style="color: #45f3ff;"></i> Enviando pacote criptográfico assinado com HMAC-SHA256 para o gateway api-sg.aliexpress.com...';

            var formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('csrf_token', csrfInput ? csrfInput.value : '');
            formData.append('app_key', appKeyInput ? appKeyInput.value : '');
            formData.append('app_secret', appSecretInput ? appSecretInput.value : '');
            formData.append('access_token', accessTokenInput ? accessTokenInput.value : '');
            formData.append('ajax', '1');

            fetch('<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/dropship/test-connection', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: {
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                }
            })
            .then(function(res) {
                return res.json().catch(function() {
                    return { success: false, status: 'error', message: 'Erro na resposta HTTP (' + res.status + ')' };
                });
            })
            .then(function(data) {
                btnTest.disabled = false;
                btnTest.style.opacity = '1';
                btnTest.innerHTML = originalHtml;

                if (data.status === 'ok' || data.success === true) {
                    // ✔️ Conexão OK
                    badge.textContent = '✔️ Conectado & Operante';
                    badge.style.background = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.2)';
                    badge.style.color = '#5cd67d';
                    badge.style.border = '1px solid rgba(40,167,69,0.4)';

                    iconBadge.style.background = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.2)';
                    iconBadge.style.borderColor = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.4)';
                    iconBadge.style.color = '#5cd67d';
                    iconBadge.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i>';

                    resultBox.style.background = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.12)';
                    resultBox.style.border = '1px solid #28a745';
                    resultBox.style.color = '#5cd67d';
                    resultBox.innerHTML = '<div style="font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 14px;">✔️ Sucesso: Sincronização Estabelecida!</div>' + ddEscHtml(data.message);
                } else if (data.status === 'warning') {
                    // ⚠️ Modo Test / Access Token
                    badge.textContent = '⚠️ Modo Test / Requer Token';
                    badge.style.background = 'rgba(234,179,8,0.2)';
                    badge.style.color = '#facc15';
                    badge.style.border = '1px solid rgba(234,179,8,0.4)';

                    iconBadge.style.background = 'rgba(234,179,8,0.2)';
                    iconBadge.style.borderColor = 'rgba(234,179,8,0.4)';
                    iconBadge.style.color = '#facc15';
                    iconBadge.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>';

                    resultBox.style.background = 'rgba(234,179,8,0.1)';
                    resultBox.style.border = '1px solid #eab308';
                    resultBox.style.color = '#fef08a';
                    resultBox.innerHTML = '<div style="font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 14px;">⚠️ Servidor Alcançado — Ação Requerida</div>' + 
                        ddEscHtml(data.message) + 
                        '<div style="margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 3px solid #eab308;">' +
                        '<strong>Dica:</strong> Se sua aplicação já foi aprovada em <em>Apply Online</em>, gere o <em>Access Token</em> permanente no console do AliExpress e cole-o no campo de token abaixo antes de salvar.' +
                        '</div>';
                } else {
                    // ❌ Erro de Chave / Token / Rede
                    badge.textContent = '❌ Falha de Autenticação';
                    badge.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)';
                    badge.style.color = '#f87171';
                    badge.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.4)';

                    iconBadge.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)';
                    iconBadge.style.borderColor = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.4)';
                    iconBadge.style.color = '#f87171';
                    iconBadge.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times-circle"></i>';

                    resultBox.style.background = 'rgba(220,50,50,0.12)';
                    resultBox.style.border = '1px solid #dc3232';
                    resultBox.style.color = '#fca5a5';
                    resultBox.innerHTML = '<div style="font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 14px;">❌ Erro de Ligação com o Servidor</div>' + 
                        ddEscHtml(data.message || 'Falha ao validar credenciais com o servidor do AliExpress.') +
                        '<div style="margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 3px solid #dc3232;">' +
                        '<strong>Solução:</strong> Verifique se digitou o <em>AppKey</em> e o <em>App Secret</em> corretamente sem espaços ou acesse seu painel em <strong>openservice.aliexpress.com</strong> para redefinir as credenciais.' +
                        '</div>';
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btnTest.disabled = false;
                btnTest.style.opacity = '1';
                btnTest.innerHTML = originalHtml;

                badge.textContent = '❌ Erro de Rede';
                badge.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)';
                badge.style.color = '#f87171';

                resultBox.style.background = 'rgba(220,50,50,0.12)';
                resultBox.style.border = '1px solid #dc3232';
                resultBox.style.color = '#fca5a5';
                resultBox.innerHTML = '❌ Falha de comunicação de rede: ' + ddEscHtml(err && err.message ? err.message : 'Erro desconhecido');
            });
        });
    });

    function ddEscHtml(str) {
        var div = document.createElement('div');
        div.textContent = String(str || '');
        return div.innerHTML;
    }

    function ddToggleSecret(id, btn) {
        var input = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!input) return;
        var show = input.type === 'password';
        input.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
        btn.textContent = show ? '🙈' : '👁️';
        btn.style.transform = show ? 'scale(1.15)' : 'scale(1)';
    }
    </script>

</div>

<script>
function toggleAddressEditForm() {
    var c = document.getElementById('address_edit_container');
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn_toggle_address_form');
    if (!c) return;
    if (c.style.display === 'none' || c.style.display === '') {
        c.style.display = 'block';
        if (btn) btn.innerText = '✕ Fechar Formulário';
    } else {
        c.style.display = 'none';
        if (btn) btn.innerText = '✏️ Alterar Endereço';
    }
}

function formatAccountCepAndSearch(input) {
    var v = input.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (v.length > 8) v = v.slice(0, 8);
    if (v.length > 5) {
        input.value = v.slice(0, 5) + '-' + v.slice(5);
    } else {
        input.value = v;
    }

    var fb = document.getElementById('acc_cep_feedback');
    if (v.length === 8) {
        if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color: #45f3ff;">🔍 Buscando endereço nos Correios (ViaCEP)...</span>';
        fetch('https://viacep.com.br/ws/' + v + '/json/')
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                if (data.erro) {
                    if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color: #f87171;">⚠️ CEP não encontrado na base dos Correios. Digite o endereço manualmente.</span>';
                    return;
                }
                var addrEl = document.getElementById('acc_shipping_address');
                var neighEl = document.getElementById('acc_shipping_neighborhood');
                var cityEl = document.getElementById('acc_shipping_city');
                var ufEl = document.getElementById('acc_shipping_state');
                var numEl = document.getElementById('acc_shipping_number');

                if (addrEl && data.logradouro) addrEl.value = data.logradouro;
                if (neighEl && data.bairro) neighEl.value = data.bairro;
                if (cityEl && data.localidade) cityEl.value = data.localidade;
                if (ufEl && data.uf) ufEl.value = data.uf;

                if (fb) {
                    fb.textContent = '';
                    var okSpan = document.createElement('span');
                    okSpan.style.color = '#00d284';
                    okSpan.textContent = '✅ Endereço localizado: ' + (data.logradouro || '') + ' - ' + (data.localidade || '') + '/' + (data.uf || '');
                    fb.appendChild(okSpan);
                }
                if (numEl) numEl.focus();
            })
            .catch(function() {
                if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color: #fbbf24;">⚠️ Não foi possível consultar o CEP automaticamente. Digite seu endereço abaixo.</span>';
            });
    } else if (fb) {
        fb.innerHTML = 'Digite o CEP de 8 dígitos para preenchimento automático de Rua, Bairro e Cidade via ViaCEP.';
    }
}

function formatAccountPhone(input) {
    var v = input.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (v.length > 11) v = v.slice(0, 11);
    if (v.length > 10) {
        input.value = '(' + v.slice(0, 2) + ') ' + v.slice(2, 7) + '-' + v.slice(7);
    } else if (v.length > 6) {
        input.value = '(' + v.slice(0, 2) + ') ' + v.slice(2, 6) + '-' + v.slice(6);
    } else if (v.length > 2) {
        input.value = '(' + v.slice(0, 2) + ') ' + v.slice(2);
    } else if (v.length > 0) {
        input.value = '(' + v;
    } else {
        input.value = '';
    }
}

function formatAccountCpf(input) {
    var v = input.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (v.length > 11) v = v.slice(0, 11);
    if (v.length > 9) {
        input.value = v.slice(0, 3) + '.' + v.slice(3, 6) + '.' + v.slice(6, 9) + '-' + v.slice(9);
    } else if (v.length > 6) {
        input.value = v.slice(0, 3) + '.' + v.slice(3, 6) + '.' + v.slice(6);
    } else if (v.length > 3) {
        input.value = v.slice(0, 3) + '.' + v.slice(3);
    } else {
        input.value = v;
    }
}
</script>

<script>
function ddTogglePass(id, btn) {
    var input = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!input) return;
    var show = input.type === 'password';
    input.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
    btn.textContent = show ? '🙈' : '👁️';
    btn.style.color = show ? '#F0D060' : '#94a3b8';
}
function ddMaskCpf(el) {
    var d = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
    if (d.length > 9) el.value = d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{1,2})/, '$1.$2.$3-$4');
    else if (d.length > 6) el.value = d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{1,3})/, '$1.$2.$3');
    else if (d.length > 3) el.value = d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{1,3})/, '$1.$2');
    else el.value = d;
}
function ddMaskPhone(el) {
    var d = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
    if (d.length > 10) el.value = d.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{5})(\d{4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
    else if (d.length > 6) el.value = d.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{4})(\d{1,4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
    else if (d.length > 2) el.value = d.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{1,5})/, '($1) $2');
    else el.value = d;
}
</script>

<?php
/**
 * View Pública da Página Dedicada do Produto (/produto/{slug})
 *
 * @var \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto $product
 * @var string $checkoutUrl
 * @var string $baseUrl
 */
$refPrice = $product->salePriceBrl * 1.35;
$sellerInfo = $product->getSellerInfo();
$allImages = !empty($product->images) ? array_values(array_filter($product->images)) : [];
if ($product->hasVariants()) {
    foreach ($product->getVariants() as $v) {
        if ($v->isAvailable() && !empty($v->imageUrl) && !in_array($v->imageUrl, $allImages, true)) {
            $allImages[] = $v->imageUrl;
        }
    }
}
if (empty($allImages) && !empty($product->mainImageUrl)) {
    $allImages = [$product->mainImageUrl];
}
$isAdult = str_contains($product->category, '+18') || stripos($product->category, 'sex shop') !== false;
$productWeightGrams = method_exists($product, 'getEstimatedWeightInGrams') ? $product->getEstimatedWeightInGrams() : 200;
$productExpressPrice = method_exists($product, 'calculateExpressShippingPrice') ? $product->calculateExpressShippingPrice(1) : 19.90;
$productFormattedWeight = method_exists($product, 'getFormattedWeight') ? $product->getFormattedWeight(1) : '200g';
$eanCode = method_exists($product, 'getEanCode') ? $product->getEanCode() : '';

$schemaOffers = [
    '@type'           => 'Offer',
    'url'             => (str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'http') ? $baseUrl : 'https://' . ($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? 'localhost') . $baseUrl) . '/produto/' . $product->slug,
    'priceCurrency'   => 'BRL',
    'price'           => number_format($product->salePriceBrl, 2, '.', ''),
    'priceValidUntil' => date('Y-12-31', strtotime('+1 year')),
    'itemCondition'   => 'https://schema.org/NewCondition',
    'availability'    => $product->status === 'published' ? 'https://schema.org/InStock' : 'https://schema.org/OutOfStock',
    'seller'          => [
        '@type' => 'Organization',
        'name'  => $sellerInfo['store_name'] ?? 'Loja Oficial',
    ],
];

$schemaData = [
    '@context'    => 'https://schema.org/',
    '@type'       => 'Product',
    'name'        => $product->title,
    'image'       => $allImages,
    'description' => strip_tags(method_exists($product, 'getEnrichedDescription') ? ($product->getEnrichedDescription() ?: $product->description) : $product->description),
    'sku'         => (string)($product->id ?? $product->aliexpressId),
    'brand'       => [
        '@type' => 'Brand',
        'name'  => $product->attributes['brand'] ?? ($sellerInfo['store_name'] ?? 'Marca Original'),
    ],
    'offers'      => $schemaOffers,
];

if ($eanCode !== '') {
    $schemaData['gtin13'] = $eanCode;
}
?>
<!-- Dados Estruturados Schema.org / Google Shopping & Rich Snippets -->
<script type="application/ld+json">
<?= json_encode($schemaData, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) ?>
</script>

<div class="domain-drop-product-page" style="max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px 15px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: #cbd5e1; box-sizing: border-box;">

    <!-- Breadcrumbs -->
    <nav style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/" style="color: #94a3b8; text-decoration: none;">Início</a>
        <span>/</span>
        <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/loja" style="color: #94a3b8; text-decoration: none;">Loja</a>
        <span>/</span>
        <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/loja?cat=<?= urlencode($product->category) ?>" style="color: #ff6b6b; text-decoration: none;">
            <?= htmlspecialchars($product->category) ?>
        </a>
        <span>/</span>

<script>
var productGalleryImages = <?= json_encode($allImages, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?>;
var currentActiveImageIndex = 0;

function selectProductImage(index, url) {
    currentActiveImageIndex = index;
    var mainImg = document.getElementById('main-product-img');
    if (mainImg) {
        mainImg.style.opacity = '0.3';
        setTimeout(function() {
            mainImg.src = url;
            mainImg.style.opacity = '1';
        }, 120);
    }
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-thumb-item').forEach(function(el, i) {
        if (i === index) {
            el.classList.add('active');
            el.style.borderColor = '#D4AF37';
        } else {
            el.classList.remove('active');
            el.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
        }
    });
}

function openVisualBookLightbox(index) {
    if (!productGalleryImages || productGalleryImages.length === 0) return;
    currentActiveImageIndex = (index >= 0 && index < productGalleryImages.length) ? index : 0;
    updateLightbox();
    var lb = document.getElementById('visualBookLightbox');
    if (lb) {
        lb.style.display = 'flex';
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
}

function closeVisualBookLightbox() {
    var lb = document.getElementById('visualBookLightbox');
    if (lb) {
        lb.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
}

function navigateLightbox(step) {
    if (!productGalleryImages || productGalleryImages.length <= 1) return;
    currentActiveImageIndex = (currentActiveImageIndex + step + productGalleryImages.length) % productGalleryImages.length;
    updateLightbox();
}

function updateLightbox() {
    var imgEl = document.getElementById('lightboxActiveImg');
    var counterEl = document.getElementById('lightboxCounter');
    if (imgEl && productGalleryImages[currentActiveImageIndex]) {
        imgEl.src = productGalleryImages[currentActiveImageIndex];
    }
    if (counterEl) {
        counterEl.textContent = 'Foto ' + (currentActiveImageIndex + 1) + ' de ' + productGalleryImages.length;
    }
}

// Controle de Quantidade na página de detalhes do produto
var productUnitPriceBrl = <?= json_encode((float)$product->salePriceBrl) ?>;
var productUnitWeightInGrams = <?= (int)$productWeightGrams ?>;
var productCheckoutBaseUrl = <?= json_encode($checkoutUrl, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?>;

function calcProductExpressShipping(qty) {
    var totalWeight = productUnitWeightInGrams * Math.max(1, qty);
    if (totalWeight <= 300) return 19.90;
    if (totalWeight <= 1000) return 29.90;
    if (totalWeight <= 2000) return 39.90;
    var extraKg = Math.ceil((totalWeight - 2000) / 1000);
    return Math.round((39.90 + (extraKg * 10.00)) * 100) / 100;
}

function getProductFormattedWeight(qty) {
    var totalGrams = productUnitWeightInGrams * Math.max(1, qty);
    if (totalGrams >= 1000) {
        var kg = totalGrams / 1000;
        return (totalGrams % 1000 === 0 ? kg.toFixed(0) : kg.toFixed(1)).replace('.', ',') + ' kg';
    }
    return totalGrams + 'g';
}

// Matriz de Variações e SKUs (Padrão SKU Matrix / AliExpress SDK)
var productVariants = <?= json_encode(array_map(fn($v) => $v->toArray(), $product->getVariants()), JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>;
var productVariationAxes = <?= json_encode($product->getVariationAxes(), JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>;
var selectedVariationOptions = {};
var activeProductSku = null;

function selectVariantOption(axis, value) {
    if (!axis || !value) return;

    // Impede seleção de opções desativadas ou sem estoque
    var isAllowed = false;
    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-variant-chip').forEach(function(btn) {
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-axis') === axis && btn.getAttribute('data-value') === value) {
            if (btn.disabled || btn.getAttribute('data-in-stock') === '0') {
                isAllowed = false;
            } else {
                isAllowed = true;
            }
        }
    });
    if (!isAllowed) return;

    selectedVariationOptions[axis] = value;

    // Atualiza o rótulo da opção selecionada (sem usar CSS.escape para compatibilidade total)
    document.querySelectorAll('.axis-selected-label').forEach(function(el) {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-axis') === axis) {
            el.textContent = value;
        }
    });

    // Atualiza os estilos visuais dos botões do mesmo eixo (mantendo os desativados/esgotados apagados)
    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-variant-chip').forEach(function(btn) {
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-axis') === axis) {
            var inStock = (btn.getAttribute('data-in-stock') !== '0') && !btn.disabled;
            if (!inStock) {
                btn.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.01)';
                btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
                btn.style.color = '#64748b';
                btn.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                return;
            }

            if (btn.getAttribute('data-value') === value) {
                btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212,175,55,0.3) 0%, rgba(240,208,96,0.2) 100%)';
                btn.style.borderColor = '#D4AF37';
                btn.style.color = '#F0D060';
                btn.style.boxShadow = '0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,0.35)';
            } else {
                btn.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)';
                btn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)';
                btn.style.color = '#fff';
                btn.style.boxShadow = 'none';
            }
        }
    });

    // Localiza e aplica a variante correspondente
    findAndApplyMatchingVariant();
}

function findAndApplyMatchingVariant() {
    if (!productVariants || productVariants.length === 0) return;

    var matched = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < productVariants.length; i++) {
        var v = productVariants[i];
        var isMatch = true;
        for (var axis in selectedVariationOptions) {
            if (v.options && v.options[axis] !== selectedVariationOptions[axis]) {
                isMatch = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (isMatch) {
            matched = v;
            break;
        }
    }

    var summaryEl = document.getElementById('active-variant-summary');
    var priceDisplayEl = document.getElementById('product-display-price');

    if (matched) {
        activeProductSku = matched.sku_id;

        // Se tiver imagem específica da SKU, atualiza o palco principal
        if (matched.image_url) {
            var mainImg = document.getElementById('main-product-img');
            if (mainImg) {
                mainImg.src = matched.image_url;
            }
        }

        // Se tiver preço diferenciado na variação, atualiza o valor
        if (matched.price_brl && matched.price_brl > 0) {
            productUnitPriceBrl = parseFloat(matched.price_brl);
            if (priceDisplayEl) {
                priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'R$ ' + productUnitPriceBrl.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            }
        }

        // Atualiza o resumo visual da combinação
        if (summaryEl) {
            var optsStr = [];
            for (var ax in matched.options) {
                optsStr.push(matched.options[ax]);
            }
            summaryEl.textContent = optsStr.join(' / ') + ' • ' + (matched.stock > 0 ? (matched.stock + ' em estoque') : 'Pronta Entrega');
            summaryEl.style.color = '#4ade80';
        }
    } else {
        activeProductSku = null;
        if (summaryEl) {
            summaryEl.textContent = 'Selecione todas as opções';
            summaryEl.style.color = '#f59e0b';
        }
    }

    syncProductQuantity();
}

function initProductVariants() {
    if (productVariationAxes && Object.keys(productVariationAxes).length > 0) {
        for (var axis in productVariationAxes) {
            var preferredVal = null;
            // Procura o primeiro chip deste eixo que tem estoque ativo e não está disabled
            var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.btn-variant-chip');
            for (var c = 0; c < chips.length; c++) {
                var chip = chips[c];
                if (chip.getAttribute('data-axis') === axis && !chip.disabled && chip.getAttribute('data-in-stock') === '1') {
                    preferredVal = chip.getAttribute('data-value');
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (preferredVal) {
                selectVariantOption(axis, preferredVal);
            } else {
                var opts = productVariationAxes[axis];
                if (opts && opts.length > 0) {
                    selectVariantOption(axis, opts[0]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

function syncProductQuantity() {
    var input = document.getElementById('product-qty-input');
    var buyBtn = document.getElementById('btn-buy-now');
    var subtotalEl = document.getElementById('product-qty-subtotal');
    if (!input) return;

    var qty = parseInt(input.value, 10);
    if (isNaN(qty) || qty < 1) qty = 1;
    if (qty > 50) qty = 50;
    input.value = qty;

    if (buyBtn) {
        var checkoutUrl = productCheckoutBaseUrl + '?qty=' + qty;
        if (activeProductSku) {
            checkoutUrl += '&sku=' + encodeURIComponent(activeProductSku);
        }
        var currentCep = '';
        try {
            var cepField = document.getElementById('shipping-cep-input');
            if (cepField && cepField.value) {
                currentCep = cepField.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
            } else {
                currentCep = localStorage.getItem('rachidd_user_shipping_cep') || '';
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        if (currentCep && currentCep.length === 8) {
            checkoutUrl += '&shipping_zip=' + encodeURIComponent(currentCep);
        }
        buyBtn.href = checkoutUrl;
    }
    if (subtotalEl) {
        if (qty > 1) {
            var total = (productUnitPriceBrl * qty).toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            subtotalEl.textContent = qty + ' unid. • Total: R$ ' + total;
            subtotalEl.style.display = 'inline-block';
        } else {
            subtotalEl.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    // Atualiza dinamicamente o badge de peso e preço do frete Sedex para a quantidade selecionada
    var weightBadge = document.getElementById('product-shipping-weight-badge');
    var expressBadge = document.getElementById('product-shipping-express-badge');
    if (weightBadge) {
        var formattedWeight = getProductFormattedWeight(qty);
        var totalGrams = productUnitWeightInGrams * qty;
        if (qty > 1) {
            weightBadge.textContent = qty + 'x ' + productUnitWeightInGrams + 'g (' + formattedWeight + ')';
        } else {
            weightBadge.textContent = formattedWeight;
        }
    }
    if (expressBadge) {
        var dynamicExpressPrice = calcProductExpressShipping(qty);
        var totalGrams = productUnitWeightInGrams * qty;
        var extraNote = '';
        if (totalGrams > 2000) {
            var extraKg = Math.ceil((totalGrams - 2000) / 1000);
            extraNote = ' (+' + extraKg + 'kg extra)';
        } else if (totalGrams > 300 && productUnitWeightInGrams <= 300) {
            extraNote = ' (peso acumulado)';
        }
        expressBadge.textContent = '+ R$ ' + dynamicExpressPrice.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + extraNote;
    }
}

function changeProductQuantity(delta) {
    var input = document.getElementById('product-qty-input');
    if (!input) return;
    var current = parseInt(input.value, 10) || 1;
    input.value = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, current + delta));
    syncProductQuantity();
}

// Atalhos de teclado no Lightbox (ESC fecha, Setas navegam)
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    var lb = document.getElementById('visualBookLightbox');
    if (lb && lb.style.display === 'flex') {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeVisualBookLightbox();
        if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') navigateLightbox(-1);
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') navigateLightbox(1);
    }
});

// Disparo Inteligente de Demanda (Beacon/Keepalive)
var productTrackingData = {
    product_id: <?= json_encode((string)($product->aliexpressId ?: (string)$product->id)) ?>,
    title: <?= json_encode((string)$product->title) ?>,
    category: <?= json_encode((string)$product->category) ?>
};

function trackProductAction(actionType) {
    if (!productTrackingData.product_id) return;
    var base = <?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?>;
    var endpoint = (base ? base.replace(/\/+$/, '') : '') + '/api/drop/track-demand';
    var payload = JSON.stringify({
        product_id: productTrackingData.product_id,
        title: productTrackingData.title,
        category: productTrackingData.category,
        action: actionType,
        timestamp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
    });

    try {
        if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
            var blob = new Blob([payload], { type: 'application/json' });
            navigator.sendBeacon(endpoint, blob);
        } else {
            fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: payload,
                keepalive: true
            }).catch(function() {});
        }
    } catch (e) {
        try {
            fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: payload,
                keepalive: true
            }).catch(function() {});
        } catch (err) {}
    }
}

// Dispara inicialização de variações e evento 'view_details' ao carregar a página de detalhes
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    initProductVariants();
    trackProductAction('view_details');

    // Recupera CEP previamente consultado
    try {
        var cachedCep = localStorage.getItem('rachidd_user_shipping_cep');
        var cepInput = document.getElementById('shipping-cep-input');
        if (cachedCep && cachedCep.length === 8 && cepInput) {
            cepInput.value = cachedCep.substring(0, 5) + '-' + cachedCep.substring(5);
            calculateProductShipping(false);
        }
    } catch(e) {}
});

function formatShippingCep(input) {
    var v = input.value.replace(/\D/g, '').substring(0, 8);
    if (v.length > 5) {
        input.value = v.substring(0, 5) + '-' + v.substring(5);
    } else {
        input.value = v;
    }
}

function calculateProductShipping(shouldFocus) {
    var input = document.getElementById('shipping-cep-input');
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn-calc-shipping');
    var resultBox = document.getElementById('shipping-result-box');
    var locText = document.getElementById('shipping-location-text');
    if (!input || !resultBox || !locText) return;

    var cleanCep = input.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (cleanCep.length !== 8) {
        input.style.borderColor = '#ef4444';
        return;
    }
    input.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';

    var originalBtnText = btn.innerHTML;
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Calculando...';

    fetch('https://viacep.com.br/ws/' + cleanCep + '/json/')
        .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = originalBtnText;

            if (data.erro) {
                locText.innerHTML = '❌ CEP não encontrado. Verifique os dígitos informados.';
                locText.style.color = '#f87171';
                resultBox.style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }

            var localStr = (data.bairro ? data.bairro + ' - ' : '') + (data.localidade || '') + '/' + (data.uf || '');
            locText.textContent = '📍 Entrega para: ';
            var strongEl = document.createElement('strong');
            strongEl.textContent = localStr;
            locText.appendChild(strongEl);
            locText.style.color = '#38bdf8';
            resultBox.style.display = 'block';

            try {
                localStorage.setItem('rachidd_user_shipping_cep', cleanCep);
            } catch(e) {}

            syncProductQuantity();
        })
        .catch(function() {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = originalBtnText;
            locText.innerHTML = '📍 Frete Padrão com Rastreio <strong>GRÁTIS</strong> disponível para todo o Brasil!';
            locText.style.color = '#00d284';
            resultBox.style.display = 'block';
        });
}

var _buyCheckInProgress = false;
function handleBuyNowClick(event, btn) {
    if (event) event.preventDefault();
    if (!btn || btn.getAttribute('data-sold-out') === '1' || _buyCheckInProgress) {
        return false;
    }

    _buyCheckInProgress = true;
    var targetHref = btn.href;
    var origHtml = btn.innerHTML;
    var fbBox = document.getElementById('buy-availability-feedback');
    btn.style.opacity = '0.8';
    btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳ Verificando estoque...</span>';

    var payload = {
        product_id: <?= (int)($product->id ?? 0) ?>,
        slug: <?= json_encode((string)($product->slug ?? ''), JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>,
        sku: activeProductSku || ''
    };

    fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl . '/api/drop/check-availability', JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?>, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
        _buyCheckInProgress = false;
        if (data && data.available === false) {
            btn.setAttribute('data-sold-out', '1');
            btn.style.opacity = '0.55';
            btn.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
            btn.style.background = '#334155';
            btn.style.color = '#cbd5e1';
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>Estoque Esgotado</span>';
            if (fbBox) {
                fbBox.style.display = 'block';
                fbBox.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.14)';
                fbBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.45)';
                fbBox.style.color = '#fca5a5';
                fbBox.textContent = '⚠️ ' + (data.message || 'O estoque deste produto já acabou no momento.');
            }
            return;
        }

        if (fbBox && data && typeof data.stock === 'number' && data.stock > 0) {
            fbBox.style.display = 'block';
            fbBox.style.background = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
            fbBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35)';
            fbBox.style.color = '#6ee7b7';
            fbBox.textContent = '✅ Estoque atual confirmado: ' + data.stock + ' unidade(s) disponíveis.';
        }

        btn.style.opacity = '1';
        btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
        trackProductAction('buy_click');
        window.location.href = targetHref;
    })
    .catch(function() {
        _buyCheckInProgress = false;
        btn.style.opacity = '1';
        btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
        trackProductAction('buy_click');
        window.location.href = targetHref;
    });

    return false;
}
</script>

<script>
window.smoothScrollToProducts = function() {
    var target = document.getElementById('produtos') || document.getElementById('storeDynamicStage') || document.querySelector('.store-combobox-toolbar');
    if (!target) return;
    var header = document.querySelector('.site-header');
    var headerHeight = header ? header.offsetHeight : 80;
    var targetTop = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - (headerHeight + 15);
    window.scrollTo({
        top: Math.max(0, targetTop),
        behavior: 'smooth'
    });
};

window.applyStoreSort = function(sortVal) {
    try {
        var current = new URL(window.location.href);
        if (sortVal && sortVal.trim() !== '') {
            current.searchParams.set('sort', sortVal.trim());
        } else {
            current.searchParams.delete('sort');
        }
        current.hash = '#produtos';
        window.filterCatalogDynamically(current.toString(), true, false);
    } catch (e) {
        window.filterCatalogDynamically('<?= $baseUrl ?>/loja' + (sortVal ? '?sort=' + encodeURIComponent(sortVal) : ''), true, false);
    }
};

function normalizeFilterStr(str) {
    return String(str || '')
        .toLowerCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .trim();
}

window.filterCatalogDynamically = function(url, updateUrl, shouldScroll) {
    if (typeof updateUrl === 'undefined') updateUrl = true;
    if (typeof shouldScroll === 'undefined') shouldScroll = false;
    var stage = document.getElementById('storeDynamicStage');
    if (!stage) {
        window.location.href = url;
        return;
    }

    var targetUrlObj;
    var fetchUrlObj;
    try {
        targetUrlObj = new URL(url, window.location.origin);
        fetchUrlObj = new URL(targetUrlObj.href);
        // Remove qualquer fragmento (#produtos) antes de anexar ajax=1
        fetchUrlObj.hash = '';
        fetchUrlObj.searchParams.set('ajax', '1');
    } catch (e) {
        var cleanUrl = String(url).split('#')[0];
        fetchUrlObj = cleanUrl + (cleanUrl.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') + 'ajax=1';
    }

    // Feedback visual suave no próprio palco sem pular a página
    stage.style.opacity = '0.35';
    stage.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

    fetch(fetchUrlObj.toString(), {
        headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
    })
    .then(function(res) {
        if (!res.ok) {
            throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
        }
        return res.json();
    })
    .then(function(data) {
        if (data && typeof data.html === 'string') {
            stage.innerHTML = data.html;
            if (updateUrl && window.history.pushState && targetUrlObj) {
                window.history.pushState(null, '', targetUrlObj.pathname + targetUrlObj.search + targetUrlObj.hash);
            }

            // Sincroniza o combobox de Categorias comparando searchParams decodificados (+ e %20 tratados igual)
            var catSelect = document.getElementById('storeCategoryCombobox');
            var selectedCatNorm = normalizeFilterStr(data.selectedCategory || '');
            if (catSelect) {
                if (!selectedCatNorm) {
                    catSelect.selectedIndex = 0;
                } else {
                    var matchedIndex = 0;
                    for (var i = 0; i < catSelect.options.length; i++) {
                        try {
                            var optUrl = new URL(catSelect.options[i].value, window.location.origin);
                            var optCatNorm = normalizeFilterStr(optUrl.searchParams.get('cat') || '');
                            if (optCatNorm && (optCatNorm === selectedCatNorm || selectedCatNorm.indexOf(optCatNorm) !== -1 || optCatNorm.indexOf(selectedCatNorm) !== -1)) {
                                matchedIndex = i;
                                break;
                            }
                        } catch (err) {}
                    }
                    catSelect.selectedIndex = matchedIndex;
                }
            }

            // Sincroniza o combobox de Ordenação
            var sortSelect = document.getElementById('storeSortCombobox');
            if (sortSelect) {
                sortSelect.value = data.sort || '';
            }

            // Sincroniza o botão Limpar Filtros da barra
            var clearBtn = document.getElementById('btnClearStoreFilters');
            if (clearBtn) {
                var hasActiveFilter = Boolean(data.selectedCategory || data.search || data.sort);
                clearBtn.style.display = hasActiveFilter ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
            }

            // Sincroniza o item ativo dentro do Menu Hambúrguer (Drawer) e Quick Chips do Header
            if (window.syncHeaderFilterActiveState) {
                window.syncHeaderFilterActiveState(data.selectedCategory || '', data.sort || '', data.search || '');
            }

            if (shouldScroll && window.smoothScrollToProducts) {
                setTimeout(window.smoothScrollToProducts, 100);
            }

            if (window.initAgeGateModal) {
                window.initAgeGateModal();
            }
        }
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
        console.error('Falha no carregamento dinâmico:', err);
        window.location.href = url;
    })
    .finally(function() {
        stage.style.opacity = '1';
        stage.style.pointerEvents = '';
    });
};

window.initAgeGateModal = function() {
    var modal = document.getElementById('ageGateModal');
    var btnConfirm = document.getElementById('btnConfirmAge18');
    if (modal && !localStorage.getItem('age_verified_18')) {
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        if (btnConfirm && !btnConfirm.dataset.boundAgeGate) {
            btnConfirm.dataset.boundAgeGate = '1';
            btnConfirm.addEventListener('click', function() {
                localStorage.setItem('age_verified_18', 'true');
                modal.style.display = 'none';
            });
        }
    }
};

window.addEventListener('popstate', function() {
    filterCatalogDynamically(window.location.href, false);
});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    window.initAgeGateModal();
    if (window.location.hash === '#produtos' || (window.location.search && window.location.search.indexOf('cat=') !== -1)) {
        setTimeout(function() {
            if (window.smoothScrollToProducts) {
                window.smoothScrollToProducts();
            }
        }, 300);
    }
});
</script>
